title: TikTok & Instagram Short-Form Video Editor — UGC & Social Content
description:
# TikTok & Instagram Short-Form Video Editor — UGC & Social Content



I’m looking for a **creative, reliable short-form video editor** who understands how to turn raw clips into engaging TikTok and Instagram Reels.



This is **not a long-form editing position**. I’m specifically looking for someone who understands short-form content, can work from references, and knows how to **combine different clips together to create a complete, natural-flowing video**.



## What You’ll Be Editing



My content can vary, but it will primarily include:



* School/education-related content

* Trading/finance-related content

* Websites and online tools

* UGC-style videos

* Talking-head clips

* Screen recordings and website demonstrations

* Short-form promotional/content videos



I have a folder with **pre-recorded clips that you can use**, including:



* Different intros/hooks

* Middle clips showing websites or other content

* Several outro clips

* UGC-style templates I regularly record



For example, I have a recurring video format where I introduce **3 websites that people have been gatekeeping**, and then show the websites throughout the video.



If I need a **specific clip, intro, or outro** that isn't already in the folder, I can record it and provide it to you.



## Working From Inspiration



This is a **very important part of the role**.



I’ll provide you with **accounts and specific videos that I want my content to feel similar to**.



Your job is to study the references and do your best to replicate the **editing style, pacing, structure, captions, transitions, and overall feel** while applying it to my own footage.



I don't expect an exact copy. I want you to understand the creative direction and make the best version possible with the footage available.



Ideally, I want to be able to send:



**My clips + an inspiration video/account + basic instructions**



…and have you put everything together without needing me to explain every individual cut.



## Editing Style



I’m looking for editing that feels **native to TikTok/Reels** and keeps people watching.



You should understand how to use:



* Strong hooks

* Fast but natural cuts

* Removing unnecessary pauses

* Punch-ins and zooms

* Screen recordings

* B-roll

* Images and graphics

* Pattern interrupts

* Sound effects

* Music when appropriate

* Creative transitions

* Good pacing and retention



A major part of the job will be **making separate clips gel together naturally** so the final video feels like one cohesive piece of content.



### Captions



Captions are important and need to be clean and properly timed.



My supervisors require captions to generally be formatted at **2–3 words per line**, rather than large blocks of text.



Captions should be easy to read, visually engaging, and consistent throughout the video.



## What I’m Looking For



I’m not just looking for someone who knows how to use CapCut or Premiere Pro.



I want someone who has a **creative eye** and can look at my footage and figure out how to make it more engaging.



You should be:



* Creative

* Reliable and responsive

* Fast and efficient

* Good at following references

* Comfortable making your own editing decisions

* Good at combining different clips

* Familiar with TikTok/Reels editing

* Detail-oriented

* Able to meet quick deadlines



## Workflow & Availability



I’ll provide the footage through an **organized Google Drive folder** with the available clips, hooks, website footage, outros, and templates.



I typically need around **4–5 videos per day**, although this can vary depending on the workload.



I generally need videos returned within **10–12 hours**, or faster whenever possible, because I need to submit them to my supervisors for approval.



The workload can range around **30–40 hours per week**, depending on how many videos need to be completed.



## Pay & Long-Term Opportunity



The starting rate is **$4 USD per completed video**.



I’m looking for someone who can potentially work with me **long term** and become familiar with my content style.



The goal is to eventually make the process very simple:



**Clips + inspiration + instructions → Finished TikTok/Reel**



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your short-form editing portfolio

2. **3–5 of your BEST TikTok/Reels/UGC edits**

3. Your editing software

4. Typical turnaround time

5. Availability

6. How many videos you can realistically edit per day/week

7. Confirmation that you’re comfortable with **$4 USD per completed video**



**Please don’t send 50+ videos.** Send the **3–5 edits that best demonstrate your ability to create engaging, creative short-form content.**



I’m looking for someone who can take my existing clips, understand the style I’m going for, and **turn them into content that actually feels like it belongs on TikTok.**

title: Cinematic Video Editor / Motion Designer / 3D 2D Animator
description:
Job Description



About the Role



We are launching a high-quality, faceless YouTube channel focused on Finance, Explanatory Documentaries, and Historical True Crime. We are looking for a reliable, highly skilled video editor and motion designer for a long-term collaboration.



We aim to replicate the dark, immersive, high-retention cinematic style of channels like MagnatesMedia, Fern, and Lemmino. If you love storytelling through smooth camera movements, 3D space editing, and deep sound design, this is the role for you.



What You Will Receive From Us



We do 50% of the heavy lifting for you. For every project, you will be provided with:



A fully finalized, professional Voiceover (VO) track.

A complete Script synchronized with the audio.

A detailed Scene-by-Scene Prompt Blueprint outlining exactly what visuals, B-roll, maps, or data graphics should appear on screen for every single sentence.

Your Responsibilities



Assemble and edit long-form videos (20–25 minutes long) based on the provided visual blueprint.

Manipulate flat historical assets using 2.5D/3D parallax effects, custom camera panning, and multi-layer depth to create cinematic scenes.

Apply clean kinetic typography, smooth asset transitions, textures, and rich sound design (SFX) to maximize viewer retention.

Deliver 2 high-quality videos per month while strictly adhering to deadlines.

Provide a brief progress update every 3–4 days on active projects (a quick message is fine — we just want to avoid radio silence).

Requirements



Expert proficiency in Adobe After Effects paired with Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve).

Strong understanding of After Effects 3D space, Z-axis camera tracking, and motion graphics. (Full 3D software experience like Blender or Cinema 4D is a plus, but not required.)

Not an AE-level motion designer but a strong Premiere/Resolve editor? Apply anyway and let us know — we may be able to pair you with a separate motion designer for the animated sequences.

Experience using AI generation tools (Midjourney, Leonardo, Runway, etc.) to creatively generate historical scenes or conceptual art when standard stock footage is unavailable.

Important: any AI-generated depiction of a real person must remain stylized/non-photorealistic — no likeness that could be mistaken for an actual identifiable individual. This is a legal/editorial requirement, not a style preference.

A stable, high-speed internet connection for downloading/uploading large video projects.

Please note: we are finalizing our stock footage setup. Mention in your application if you have your own active subscription to Envato Elements, Storyblocks, or Motion Array.



How to Apply



To confirm you've read this entire post, please begin your proposal with the word "BLUEPRINT" in all caps. Applications without this keyword will be automatically declined.



Please include:



A link to your portfolio or 2–3 specific examples showing your best cinematic motion design or faceless documentary edits.

A brief description of your current editing setup (PC specs and software).

Confirmation of your availability to deliver 2 long-form videos per month.

title: Accountant

title: Customer Retention Agent
description:
We're looking for a motivated individual to join our customer retention team. When a customer calls to cancel, you're the person who turns that conversation around — building value in our company and our services, addressing their concerns, and keeping them as a happy, active customer.



These are inbound calls. Successful agents are confident communicators who are comfortable using their sales skills to re-establish the value of our service and win the customer back. When call volume spikes, you'll also step in to help our customer service team handle overflow.



This is not an entry-level role. You must have prior customer retention experience to be considered.



What You'll Do

Take inbound calls from customers who want to cancel their pest control subscription and work to "save" the account

Understand the customer's reason for cancelling and use your communication and sales skills to build value in our company and services

Confidently overcome objections and re-sell the value of the service while keeping the relationship positive

Accurately log interactions, outcomes, and customer notes in our CRM. 

Provide CSR overflow support during busy periods — answering general customer questions, scheduling, billing inquiries, and resolving basic issues.



This is a commission + salary role. 



Requirements

Previous experience in a customer retention role. Bonus if prior experience includes pest control.

title: Virtual Assistant / Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator – Cleaning Company
description:
We are an established window cleaning and exterior cleaning company based in Southern California looking for a **highly reliable, experienced Virtual Assistant** to help manage our day-to-day customer communication, scheduling, quoting, and administrative operations.



This is not just a basic data-entry VA position. We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of our team and help keep the business organized and running smoothly.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Answer incoming customer phone calls

* Respond to missed calls, texts,
s, and website inquiries

* Provide customers with pricing and estimates using our established pricing system

* Schedule and reschedule cleaning appointments

* Manage our calendar and technician schedules

* Follow up with customers and leads

* Contact previous customers for repeat service

* Confirm upcoming appointments

* Communicate schedule changes with customers and technicians

* Enter and update customer information in our CRM

* Help resolve basic customer service issues

* Perform general administrative tasks

* Communicate regularly with the owner and other team members through Slack/WhatsApp



We currently use **Housecall Pro**, so previous experience with Housecall Pro or another home-service CRM such as Jobber, ServiceTitan, or similar software is strongly preferred.



## Cleaning / Home Service Experience Preferred



We strongly prefer someone who has previously worked remotely for a:



* Window cleaning company

* House cleaning company

* Pressure washing company

* Landscaping company

* Plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, pest control, or other home-service business



Experience **scheduling technicians or cleaning crews and communicating directly with customers** is especially valuable.



## Spoken English Requirement



Because you will regularly speak with customers in the United States, **excellent spoken English is required**.



We are specifically looking for someone with:



* Fluent conversational English

* Clear pronunciation

* Strong listening skills

* Natural, friendly communication

* A **neutral, Western, or American-sounding English accent**

* Confidence speaking with American customers over the phone



You must be comfortable answering calls, giving estimates, explaining services, and scheduling appointments without relying on scripts for every conversation.



**Applicants will be asked to submit a short voice recording as part of the application process.**



## Reliability Is Extremely Important



This is one of the most important requirements for this position.



We need someone who can consistently show up for their scheduled shift and who takes attendance and communication seriously.



You should have:



* A dependable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Backup internet such as mobile data or a secondary connection

* A charged phone and reliable method of communication

* A backup plan for internet or power outages whenever reasonably possible

* A quiet professional environment for customer phone calls



Emergencies happen, and we understand that. However, **unexplained absences, repeatedly oversleeping, disappearing during scheduled work hours, or failing to communicate when you cannot work will not be acceptable.**



If something prevents you from working, we expect you to communicate with us as soon as reasonably possible.



## The Person We're Looking For



You would probably be a great fit if you are:



* Extremely dependable

* Organized

* Proactive

* Friendly and personable

* Comfortable talking to customers

* Good at multitasking

* Able to make decisions without constantly asking for instructions

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at managing schedules and solving scheduling conflicts

* Able to stay calm when customers are frustrated or plans suddenly change



We especially value someone who thinks:



**"How can I solve this?"**



rather than waiting for the owner to tell them what to do every step of the way.



## Preferred Experience



Strong candidates will ideally have:



* 2+ years of Virtual Assistant or customer service experience

* Experience answering U.S. customer phone calls

* Experience scheduling employees, technicians, or cleaning crews

* Previous cleaning or home-service industry experience

* CRM experience

* Housecall Pro experience

* Sales or lead-follow-up experience

* Experience working remotely with a U.S.-based small business



## Schedule



This position will work during **U.S. Pacific Time business hours**.



Applicants must be comfortable consistently working the agreed-upon schedule.



## To Apply



Please include the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your work experience.

2. Describe any experience you have working for a cleaning or home-service company.

3. Describe your experience scheduling technicians, cleaners, or appointments.

4. Tell us which CRM or scheduling systems you have used.

5. Send a **30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your previous job experience.**

6. Describe your primary internet connection and backup internet connection.

7. Explain what you would do if your electricity or internet went out during your scheduled shift.

8. Tell us about your computer/laptop specifications.

9. Tell us what hours you are available to work in Pacific Time.

10. Answer this scenario:



**You go on your lunch break at 12:00 PM and unexpectedly become unable to return to work. What would you do?**



Please begin your application with the words **"Reliable VA"** so we know you carefully read the entire job posting.

title: Content Operations & Social Media Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing online fitness coaching company with over 1 million followers across all platforms and are looking for a highly organised and proactive Content Operations & Social Media Manager.



This is a part-time position of approximately 2–3 hours per day, Monday to Sunday.



You will work directly with the founders and coordinate with our video editors located across different countries.



Your main responsibility is to make sure our content production runs smoothly without the founders needing to constantly manage editors, corrections and posting.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage and communicate with our short-form and long-form video editors

• Review Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube videos

• Send clear corrections and follow up until edits are completed

• Check spelling, subtitles, text placement, formatting and general quality

• Make sure editors meet deadlines and deliver content in advance

• Keep track of videos that are editing, awaiting corrections, approved or ready to post

• Create simple Reel cover images

• Make stories on instagram

• Prepare captions and calls to action

• Schedule social media posts correctly

• Maintain and organise the content calendar

• Make sure several days of content are always prepared in advance

• Flag delays or problems before they affect the posting schedule



YOUTUBE



You will also communicate with our long-form YouTube editors.



This includes reviewing first cuts, sending corrections, following up on revisions and making sure videos are completed before their scheduled upload date.



You do not need to be a professional video editor yourself, but you should be able to recognise mistakes and understand whether an edit matches the brief.



WORKING HOURS

Experience with Canva, Skool, content scheduling tools, Notion is a bonus.

Eventually, we want you to be able to tell us:



“The next few days of content are approved and scheduled, the YouTube videos are on track, two edits are waiting for revisions, and every editor already knows what they need to do next.”

title: Remote Survey CAD Drafter — NYC ALTA, Title, Topographic & As-Built Surveys-Full Time-Long Term
description:
About Rampa

Rampa is a tech-driven land surveying firm serving New York City and the surrounding metro area. We are seeking a highly capable, detail-oriented remote CAD Drafter for a long-term position supporting our licensed survey team.



What You’ll Do



Prepare and revise survey drawings from field notes, field data, sketches, photos, title documents, and markups.



Draft ALTA/NSPS Land Title Surveys, title surveys, boundary surveys, topographic surveys, as-built surveys, and survey exhibits.



Plot legal descriptions, easements, rights-of-way, improvements, utilities, and other title-related information as directed.



Follow Rampa CAD standards, QC comments, file-naming procedures, and turnaround deadlines.



Coordinate with our team through ClickUp, Google Workspace, and video calls.



Required Experience



3+ years of land-survey CAD drafting experience.



Demonstrated experience drafting NYC or New York metro-area surveys. This is very important.



Direct experience with ALTA/NSPS, title, boundary, topographic, and as-built drawings.



Ability to read and work from deeds/legal descriptions, title commitments, recorded maps, easements, field notes, and surveyor markups.



Proficiency in Autodesk products such as AutoCAD and/or Civil 3D. Experience with Carlson Survey is strongly preferred.



Strong written English, attention to detail, dependable internet, and ability to work independently.



Preferred / Major Plus



Experience with point clouds, LiDAR, drone data, scan-to-CAD, surfaces, contours, or digital terrain models.



Strong technical ability and comfort learning new technology, digital survey workflows, automation, and AI-assisted work tools.



Prior work with US surveying, civil engineering, construction, or real-estate due diligence firms.



Schedule



Fully remote, long-term role.



Must be available 9:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday–Friday.



Full-time preferred; qualified part-time applicants may be considered.



Important

This position supports licensed survey professionals. The drafter will not certify, sign, or represent themselves as a New York land surveyor.



Schedule

Full-time: 40 hours per week.



Monday through Friday.



You must maintain a regular schedule with at least 4–5 hours of overlap with New York / U.S. Eastern Time.



Please state your available work hours in Philippine Time in your application.



Compensation

USD 1,200–1,500 per month, depending on demonstrated experience with land-survey drafting, AutoCAD, and Civil 3D.



This is a long-term independent-contractor position.



You will begin with a paid 30-day probationary period.



Strong performance, accuracy, speed, dependability, and ability to work independently may lead to a compensation review after 60–90 days.



Please include your expected monthly salary in USD.



How to Apply

Use this exact subject line: “RAMPA NYC SURVEY CAD – [Your Name]”



Please include:



Your resume/CV.



A short description of your NYC/NY metro surveying experience.



Your experience with ALTA, title, topo, as-built, and boundary surveys.



Software used and proficiency level: AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Carlson, and any point-cloud tools.



Two or three sanitized work samples—remove all client names, addresses, and confidential information.



Your desired hourly rate and confirmation that you can work 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time.



Finalists will complete a short paid drafting test using sample, non-confidential data.



The requested experience is appropriate for the role: ALTA/title work routinely requires plotting title matters such as easements and property information, while survey CAD roles commonly include boundary, topographic, and as-built plans using AutoCAD Civil 3D/Carlson-style workflows.

title: Video Editor
description:
I currently run a philosophy channel and I’m looking to go with long format video. I am wanting to see what styles you can come up with and recreate consistently.



We would be looking for video length of 20 minutes or so. I would be able to supply scripting, voice over.



To apply can you please provide a 60 second video of Fredrick Nietzsche with the script provided.



[HOOK — 0–3 sec]

Nietzsche believed most people live inside a prison… without ever seeing the bars.



[3–10 sec]

The prison isn’t made of steel.

It’s made of other people’s expectations.



What you should believe.

What success should look like.

Who you’re supposed to become.



[10–20 sec]

Nietzsche warned that when you blindly follow the crowd, you slowly sacrifice the one thing that actually belongs to you:



Yourself.



He called this tendency “herd morality.”



[20–32 sec]

And escaping it isn’t comfortable.



Because the moment you start thinking for yourself…

people may call you strange.

Arrogant.

Wrong.



That’s the price of becoming an individual.



[32–43 sec]

Nietzsche wrote:



“Become who you are.”



Not who your parents expected.

Not who society rewards.

Not who gets the most approval.



Who YOU are.



[43–52 sec]

So ask yourself:



If nobody could judge you…

If nobody could laugh at you…

If nobody could be disappointed in you…



Would you still be living the same life?



[ENDING — 52–60 sec]

Because maybe the scariest prison…



is the one where the door was never locked.



Follow Philosophy Unpacked for philosophy that changes how you see your life.

title: Mid to Senior Level Accountant
description:
Mid to Senior Level Accountant



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: depending on experience and skill set



About Us



We are a fast-growing accounting firm that partners with ambitious business owners to provide hands-on accounting support, accurate financial reporting, and practical business insights.



Our team is dynamic, collaborative, and committed to delivering high-quality accounting services across a diverse portfolio of Australian businesses and industries.



As we continue to grow, we are looking for a highly capable Mid to Senior Level Accountant who can take ownership of client accounts, work independently, and provide reliable financial support and insights to business owners.



This role is ideal for an experienced accountant who is confident working with Australian businesses, has strong Xero expertise, understands BAS and compliance requirements, and can move beyond transaction processing to become a trusted accounting partner to clients.



The Role



As a Mid to Senior Level Accountant, you will be responsible for managing the accounting function for an assigned portfolio of clients.



You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, month-end processes, compliance requirements, financial reporting, and client communication while identifying opportunities to improve processes and provide greater value to clients.



You will work closely with the founder and senior team members and will be expected to demonstrate a high level of accuracy, accountability, initiative, and professional judgement.



Key ResponsibilitiesFinancial Accounting & Reporting



Manage end-to-end accounting functions for an assigned portfolio of clients.

Perform and review bank, credit card, cash, payroll, and balance sheet reconciliations.

Prepare and review monthly financial statements and management reports.

Complete month-end and year-end accounting procedures.

Prepare and post journals, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and other adjusting entries.

Analyse financial results, variances, trends, and key performance indicators.

Identify unusual transactions, discrepancies, and potential financial risks.

Ensure financial records are complete, accurate, and maintained in accordance with applicable accounting standards and client requirements.

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



Manage and oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.

Review and approve invoice processing and coding where required.

Monitor outstanding receivables and conduct debtor follow-ups.

Assist clients with cash-flow management and payment scheduling.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies relating to invoices, payments, and customer/supplier accounts.

Improve processes to ensure timely and accurate transaction processing.

Australian Tax & Compliance



Prepare and review Business Activity Statements (BAS).

Ensure GST transactions are correctly recorded and reconciled.

Prepare relevant compliance reports and supporting schedules.

Assist with tax preparation and year-end requirements as required.

Maintain accurate records and documentation to support compliance and audit requirements.

Liaise with clients and relevant stakeholders regarding accounting and compliance matters.

Client Management & Advisory



Manage and maintain strong relationships with an assigned portfolio of clients.

Act as a trusted point of contact for accounting and financial queries.

Communicate financial information clearly to clients who may not have an accounting background.

Provide meaningful commentary and insights rather than simply presenting financial reports.

Identify opportunities to improve client profitability, cash flow, financial controls, and accounting processes.

Proactively communicate issues, deadlines, risks, and opportunities to clients and the internal team.

Work directly with the founder and senior team members on client requirements and complex accounting matters.

Review, Quality Control & Process Improvement



Review accounting work for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Identify and correct errors before reports are provided to clients.

Establish and maintain efficient accounting processes and workflows.

Improve internal systems, procedures, and reporting processes.

Assist junior accountants and bookkeepers with technical questions and accounting issues.

Provide guidance, coaching, and quality reviews where required.

Take ownership of deadlines and ensure client deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

About You



We are looking for an accountant who is experienced, commercially minded, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership.



You will ideally have:



5+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, or related experience, with demonstrated experience handling multiple clients.

Strong experience working with Australian businesses and accounting requirements.

Advanced working knowledge of Xero.

Strong understanding of BAS, GST, reconciliations, AP/AR, and month-end accounting.

Experience preparing and analysing financial statements and management reports.

Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.

Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Confidence communicating directly with business owners and senior stakeholders.

Ability to explain financial information clearly and provide practical recommendations.

Strong time-management and organisational skills.

Ability to manage multiple clients, competing priorities, and deadlines independently.

High level of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and professionalism.

Formal qualifications in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Senior-Level Advantage



Candidates with the following experience will be highly regarded:



Experience managing a portfolio of Australian clients.

Experience in an Australian accounting or public practice firm.

Experience reviewing or supervising the work of junior accountants/bookkeepers.

Experience with payroll accounting and payroll reconciliations.

Experience with fixed assets and depreciation schedules.

Experience preparing cash-flow forecasts and financial analysis.

Experience with budgeting and forecasting.

Experience assisting with year-end financial statements and tax preparation.

Experience improving accounting systems, workflows, and internal controls.

Experience working with multiple entities or complex business structures.

Experience providing financial and commercial insights to business owners.

Key Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accuracy and completeness of client accounts.

Timely completion of BAS, month-end, and other compliance deadlines.

Quality and reliability of financial reporting.

Effective management of client accounts and relationships.

Reduction of accounting errors and outstanding reconciliations.

Timely resolution of AP/AR issues and discrepancies.

Ability to identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities.

Client satisfaction and retention.

Contribution to process improvements and operational efficiency.

Ability to work independently while maintaining strong communication with the wider team.

What We Offer



Competitive salary: depending on experience and skillset.

Fully remote working environment.

Flexible and autonomous work culture.

Opportunity to manage a diverse portfolio of Australian clients.

Direct exposure to business owners and senior management.

Opportunity to work closely with the founder and experienced accounting professionals.

Supportive and collaborative team environment.

Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

Exposure to a variety of industries and business models.

Opportunity to take on greater responsibility as the firm continues to grow.

Why Join Us?



This is more than a bookkeeping or transaction-processing position.



We are looking for someone who wants to own their client portfolio, understand the businesses behind the numbers, and become a trusted financial partner to our clients.



If you are an experienced accountant who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, analysing financial information, and helping businesses make better decisions, we would love to hear from you.



Apply Now

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor – Fishing & Storytelling Content
description:
I am seeking a reliable and experienced long-form YouTube video editor to work with me on my fishing channel, Stillwater Fishing.



This role is specifically for my talking, story-driven fishing videos. I am looking for an editor who can do more than simply cut footage together. The ideal candidate should understand how to use pacing, music, sound design, camera selection, and visual techniques to guide the viewer through the emotional progression of a video.



I am also an experienced editor, so I have a clear creative direction for my content and will be actively involved in the editing process.



Content Style



My videos typically include a combination of:



* DJI action-camera footage

* Insta360 / 360-degree footage

* Multiple camera angles

* Dialogue and direct-to-camera moments

* Fishing sequences

* Humorous moments

* High-energy moments such as hooksets and fish fights

* Relaxed sections focused on the overall fishing experience



Raw footage can be approximately 2 hours or more, with final videos typically ranging from 10–20 minutes.



One of the most important parts of my editing style is the intentional use of different camera perspectives.



For example, when I am speaking directly to the audience, the front-facing DJI footage is often the most appropriate choice. When I am casting, working a lure, moving around, fighting a fish, or demonstrating how I am fishing, the 360 footage is often used to create more dynamic and visually engaging sequences.



Experience working with 360-degree footage is strongly preferred.



Strong Storytelling Ability



The most important creative requirement for this position is an understanding of storytelling and emotional pacing.



I want the editing to support what is happening emotionally in each moment of the video.



If a scene is lighthearted or humorous, the music, timing, sound effects, zooms, and cuts should support that tone.



If I begin noticing signs that a fish may be biting, the edit should gradually build anticipation. This may involve:



* A subtle change in music

* A riser or tension-building sound effect

* More deliberate cuts

* A gradual crop or zoom

* A change in camera angle

* Allowing certain moments to breathe before the payoff



If I then set the hook and a fish is on, the edit should make that moment feel significant. Music, pacing, camera changes, and sound design can all be used to increase the energy of the scene.



Once that moment is over and the video returns to a more relaxed fishing sequence, the edit should also know how to bring the viewer back into a calmer pace.



The editor should be able to guide the viewer naturally through transitions such as:



Relaxed → Humorous → Curious → Tense → Exciting → Payoff → Relaxed



I will provide examples from my own YouTube videos so the selected editor can clearly understand the pacing, style, and overall feeling I am trying to achieve.



Adobe Premiere Pro Is Required



Applicants must edit in Adobe Premiere Pro.



Please do not apply if your primary workflow is based entirely in CapCut or another editing platform.



Because I also edit my own content, there may be times when I need access to the Premiere Pro project file so I can make small editorial changes, review the timeline, or continue working on the project myself.



Our editing workflows must therefore be compatible.



Reliable Internet Connection Is Required



This is a very important requirement.



My projects involve large 4K video files and 360-degree footage, which means editors must regularly download and upload large amounts of data.



Applicants must have a stable and reliable internet connection capable of handling large file transfers.



Repeated issues with downloading footage, uploading completed projects, or meeting deadlines due to internet limitations will make it difficult to maintain the workflow required for this position.



Communication Expectations



Strong and consistent communication is extremely important to me.



I am not looking for an editor who receives a project, works independently for several days without communication, and only sends the final version once the entire edit is complete.



I prefer a collaborative editing process.



Because I have editing experience myself, I can provide detailed creative direction and feedback throughout the project. I would like the editor to provide regular progress updates, share sections of the video when appropriate, and ask questions whenever there is uncertainty about a creative decision.



This allows me to provide feedback early in the process rather than waiting until the entire video is completed and potentially requesting significant revisions.



I am happy to coach and guide the right editor as they become more familiar with my editing style.



The ideal working relationship will involve consistent communication, collaboration, and creative feedback throughout the editing process.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal editor should:



* Edit professionally in Adobe Premiere Pro

* Have a stable and reliable internet connection

* Communicate consistently and proactively

* Be comfortable receiving detailed creative feedback

* Be able to work with large 4K video files

* Be comfortable working with Insta360 / 360-degree footage

* Understand long-form YouTube storytelling

* Understand pacing and viewer retention

* Know how to use music intentionally to support the emotion of a scene

* Understand sound design, including risers, impacts, transitions, and subtle sound effects

* Know when memes or humorous editing elements enhance a scene without overusing them

* Understand how to use zooms, crops, reframing, and camera positioning intentionally

* Recognize when a scene should feel relaxed, humorous, tense, exciting, or emotional

* Be capable of adapting to an established editing style

* Be dependable and capable of meeting agreed-upon deadlines



Workload and Compensation



I am currently looking for approximately 2–4 videos per month.



Compensation will generally range from $30–$75 USD per completed video, depending on experience, editing quality, project complexity, and the amount of work required.



There is potential for consistent long-term work for the right editor.



Paid Trial Edit



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a paid $10 trial edit using footage from one of my actual fishing videos.



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate:



* Storytelling ability

* Music selection

* Sound design

* Pacing

* Camera selection

* Use of 360 footage

* Ability to follow creative direction



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the word BASS so I know you have read the full job description.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

2. Your experience editing long-form YouTube content.

3. Confirmation that you edit using Adobe Premiere Pro.

4. Your experience working with Insta360 or other 360-degree footage, if applicable.

5. Links to 2–3 of your strongest long-form editing examples that demonstrate storytelling ability.

6. A brief description of your internet connection and your ability to reliably download and upload large video files.

7. Your response to the following editing scenario:



A fishing sequence begins calmly while I am speaking to the camera. I suddenly feel several small taps on my lure, become quiet, focus on what I am feeling, and say, “I think he is still there.” A few seconds later, I set the hook and a large fish is on.



Please briefly explain how you would approach this sequence using music, sound design, pacing, camera angles, and editing techniques to move the viewer from a relaxed moment into tension and ultimately into the payoff of the hookset.



There is no single correct answer. I am interested in understanding how you think creatively as an editor.



I am looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term part of the channel and who is interested in developing a strong working relationship over time.



If you are creative, dependable, communicative, and confident that you can match an established editing style, I would be interested in reviewing your application.

title: Amazon Store Manager
description:
I am looking for an experienced Amazon FBA virtual assistant who can operate and grow my Amazon seller account from A–Z.



My involvement should be limited to:



Approving and paying for inventory and necessary business expenses.

Signing important supplier or legal documents.

Completing identity verification when Amazon requires the account owner.

Giving final approval before inventory is purchased.



The VA will be responsible for everything else described below.



POSITION REQUIREMENTS



You must have proven experience managing a US Amazon Seller Central account. You must understand wholesale sourcing, online arbitrage, FBA, product restrictions, supplier verification, profitability analysis, inventory management and account health.



You must be able to communicate clearly in English, provide organized reports and work without constant supervision.



PRODUCT RESEARCH



You will be responsible for:



Finding profitable, replenishable products.

Searching for products from legitimate wholesalers, distributors and brands.

Checking the exact ASIN, UPC, variation, size, quantity and condition.

Confirming that my seller account is eligible to sell each product.

Identifying category, brand, ASIN and condition restrictions.

Checking whether Amazon sells the product.

Checking sales rank, estimated monthly sales and sales history.

Reviewing Keepa history, Buy Box history and price stability.

Checking the number of FBA and FBM sellers.

Checking whether the listing is dominated by Amazon, the brand or one seller.

Identifying possible intellectual-property, counterfeit or authenticity risks.

Checking expiration dates, hazmat status, meltable restrictions and special preparation requirements.

Avoiding products with unstable prices, excessive competition or frequent listing problems.

Avoiding products with high return rates or compliance risks.



Every product recommendation must include:



Product name and exact ASIN.

Amazon listing link.

Supplier name and product link.

Supplier’s contact information.

Unit purchase cost.

Minimum order quantity.

Shipping cost to Amazon or a preparation center.

Amazon referral and FBA fees.

Expected selling price.

Net profit per unit.

Profit margin.

ROI.

Estimated monthly sales.

Recommended order quantity.

Number of competing sellers.

Buy Box and price history.

Restrictions and risks.

Confirmation that my account can sell the exact product.

Screenshot or supporting evidence for important figures.



My preferred minimum targets are:



At least $5 estimated net profit per unit.

At least 25% ROI after all known costs.

Stable selling-price history.

Enough sales to support the recommended order quantity.

No purchase recommendation based only on temporary price spikes.



A product that meets these numbers is not automatically approved. You must wait for my written approval before placing any order.



SUPPLIER SOURCING AND COMMUNICATION



You will be responsible for:



Finding legitimate US brands, authorized wholesalers and distributors.

Verifying supplier contact information and business legitimacy.

Contacting suppliers by
 or telephone.

Opening wholesale accounts using information I authorize.

Completing applications for me to review and sign.

Requesting catalogs, price lists, invoices, authorization letters and account terms.

Negotiating prices, minimum orders and shipping terms when possible.

Confirming that the supplier permits resale on Amazon.

Maintaining professional relationships with suppliers.

Organizing supplier records, invoices and correspondence.

Following up with suppliers about inventory and pricing.

Never using fake, edited, purchased or unverifiable invoices.



You may prepare purchase orders, but you may not place or pay for an order without my written approval.



UNGATING AND COMPLIANCE



You will be responsible for:



Checking whether approval is required before recommending a product.

Identifying Amazon’s exact ungating requirements.

Obtaining legitimate invoices and supporting documents from authorized suppliers.

Preparing and submitting applications when authorized.

Monitoring applications and responding to Amazon’s requests.

Keeping copies of every document submitted.

Never altering invoices, documents or product photographs.

Never submitting false information to Amazon.

Never buying inventory until eligibility and documentation requirements have been reviewed.



LISTING MANAGEMENT



You will be responsible for:



Matching products to the correct existing ASIN.

Verifying that the physical product exactly matches the listing.

Creating and maintaining offers.

Setting SKUs, prices and fulfillment channels.

Preventing duplicate listings.

Monitoring suppressed, stranded and inactive listings.

Resolving listing errors and catalog problems.

Opening and following up on Seller Support cases.

Maintaining accurate inventory and pricing.

Never changing an existing product detail page in a misleading way.

Never creating bundles, multipacks or variations that violate Amazon policy.



FBA SHIPMENT MANAGEMENT



You will be responsible for:



Creating FBA shipment plans.

Preparing product, labeling and packaging instructions.

Coordinating with suppliers or a preparation center.

Confirming carton contents, weights and measurements.

Generating FNSKU and shipping labels.

Tracking shipments until they are received.

Investigating shortages, damaged inventory and receiving discrepancies.

Opening reimbursement cases when appropriate.

Monitoring stranded, unfulfillable and aged inventory.

Recommending removal or liquidation when necessary.



PRICING AND INVENTORY



You will be responsible for:



Monitoring Buy Box eligibility and price changes.

Managing repricing within approved minimum and maximum prices.

Protecting the account from selling below the required profit level.

Tracking inventory levels and sales velocity.

Preparing restock recommendations.

Preventing unnecessary storage and aged-inventory fees.

Identifying products that should be reordered, paused or discontinued.

Never ordering or committing to inventory without my approval.



ACCOUNT HEALTH AND CUSTOMER SERVICE



You will be responsible for:



Monitoring Account Health every business day.

Monitoring policy notifications, performance notifications and compliance requests.

Responding promptly to buyer messages.

Managing returns, refunds and customer-service issues according to Amazon policy.

Investigating negative feedback and requesting removal only when allowed.

Preparing responses and plans of action for my review when necessary.

Reporting serious account warnings to me immediately.

Keeping late-shipment, cancellation and defect metrics within Amazon’s requirements.

Never manipulating reviews, feedback, rankings or sales.

Never contacting customers for prohibited reasons.



FINANCIAL AND PERFORMANCE REPORTING



You will provide a weekly report showing:



Gross sales.

Amazon fees.

Cost of goods.

Shipping and preparation costs.

Refunds and returns.

Advertising expenses, if applicable.

Estimated net profit.

Profit by ASIN.

Inventory value.

Inventory in stock, inbound and stranded.

Recommended reorders.

Products losing money.

Account-health issues.

Supplier outreach completed.

New products researched.

Open Seller Support cases.

Tasks completed and tasks still pending.



All numbers must account for Amazon fees, product cost, inbound shipping, preparation, labeling, storage and other known expenses.



ACCOUNT ACCESS AND SECURITY



You will receive your own authorized Seller Central secondary-user access. You will not receive my primary login.



You must:



Use your own authorized user profile.

Enable two-step verification.

Keep all business information confidential.

Use only the permissions necessary for your job.

Never change the primary account owner.

Never change banking, deposit, tax, legal-entity or credit-card information.

Never add another user without my written approval.

Never share access with another person.

Never install software or connect third-party services without approval.

Never download or distribute customer information.

Never make purchases or transfer money.

Never represent yourself as the legal owner of the business.

Immediately report any suspected security issue.



Any unauthorized sharing of account information or access will result in immediate termination.



PROHIBITED METHODS



The following are strictly prohibited:



Fake, altered or borrowed invoices.

Counterfeit or questionable inventory.

Buying from unauthorized sources while claiming they are distributors.

Review manipulation.

Search manipulation or artificial orders.

Multiple-account schemes.

Using customer information outside Amazon.

Misrepresenting products or product condition.

Listing against the wrong ASIN.

Sending used, damaged or expired products as new.

Using black-hat tactics.

Making guarantees about profits or sales.

Purchasing inventory without my approval.

Hiding losses, warnings, suspensions or supplier problems.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



Please provide:



Number of years managing Amazon accounts.

Marketplaces you have managed.

Whether you specialize in wholesale, online arbitrage or private label.

Examples of products you researched and managed.

Tools you use, such as Keepa, SellerAmp, Jungle Scout or Helium 10.

An example of your product-analysis spreadsheet.

An example of a weekly performance report.

Your process for verifying suppliers.

Your process for checking restrictions and intellectual-property risks.

References from previous Amazon clients, if available.

Your requested hourly or monthly rate.

Your available working hours and time zone.

Confirmation that you will not subcontract the work without permission.



PAID TEST PROJECT



Before receiving ongoing account access, you will complete a small paid test.



The test will require you to:



Find three legitimate wholesale or replenishable product opportunities.

Verify the suppliers.

Check whether my account can sell the exact ASINs.

Provide complete cost, fee, sales, competition, profit and ROI calculations.

Contact at least one supplier professionally, if authorized.

Explain the major risks associated with each product.

Recommend whether I should buy or reject each product.



Passing the test does not guarantee long-term employment. Accuracy, honesty, communication and the quality of your research will determine whether you are hired.



WORKING EXPECTATIONS



Provide regular updates without being reminded.

Document all work in a shared spreadsheet or project-management system.

Keep supplier
s and documents organized.

Ask for approval before spending money or making a major account decision.

Notify me immediately about account-health or compliance issues.

Never hide mistakes.

Follow Amazon’s current policies at all times.

Protect long-term account health ahead of short-term sales.



When applying, begin your response with the words “AmazonStore Manager” so I know you read the complete requirements.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Coordinator – Excellent English + Sales Required
description:
# Virtual Medical Assistant / Patient Coordinator – MedSpa



We are a growing medical aesthetics and wellness practice in Texas looking for an exceptional **Virtual Medical Assistant / Patient Coordinator** to join our team long-term.



This is **NOT simply an administrative VA position.**



You will often be the **first person our potential patients speak with**, so your ability to communicate, build trust, provide outstanding customer service, and convert inquiries into booked appointments is extremely important.



We are looking for someone who is **warm, confident, highly organized, proactive, and sales-minded**.



## Your Responsibilities



* Answer incoming patient phone calls

* Respond to text messages and patient inquiries

* Follow up with new leads

* Convert inquiries into booked consultations and treatments

* Schedule and reschedule appointments

* Follow up with patients after consultations and treatments

* Re-engage leads who did not initially book

* Explain basic information about our aesthetic and wellness services

* Communicate professionally and warmly with patients

* Maintain accurate patient information

* Assist with EMR/CRM and administrative tasks

* Help ensure that no lead or patient inquiry is forgotten

* Provide an excellent, high-end customer experience



Our services include:



* Botox and neurotoxins

* Dermal fillers

* Skin treatments

* Laser treatments

* Medical weight loss / GLP-1 programs

* Hormone replacement therapy

* Peptides and wellness treatments



You do **not** need to know everything about these treatments before starting. We can train the right person.



## What We Care About Most



### 1. Excellent Spoken English



You must be comfortable speaking with American patients on the phone.



Your English should be clear, natural, professional, and easy to understand.



### 2. Excellent Customer Service



We want someone who genuinely enjoys talking with people and knows how to make patients feel welcomed, valued, and taken care of.



### 3. Sales Ability



You should understand that when a potential patient contacts us, your job is not simply to answer their question and end the conversation.



Your goal is to:



**Build trust → understand what they want → answer their concerns → recommend the next step → book the appointment.**



You should be comfortable following up with leads and asking for the appointment.



### 4. Confidence



You cannot be afraid of the phone.



We need someone who can confidently guide conversations rather than simply waiting for the patient to tell them what to do.



### 5. Reliability



We are looking for someone who wants a **long-term position**, takes ownership of their responsibilities, follows through, and does not require constant supervision.



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is a plus:



* Medical assistant

* Nurse or healthcare professional

* Medical virtual assistant

* Dental office

* MedSpa / aesthetics

* Plastic surgery

* Dermatology

* Patient coordinator

* Receptionist

* Customer service

* Appointment setting

* Sales

* Lead conversion



Healthcare experience is helpful, but **excellent communication, customer service, and sales ability are more important than having the perfect medical background.**



## How to Apply — VIDEO REQUIRED



**Do not send only a resume.**



To be considered, you MUST send a **2–3 minute video introduction**.



In your video, please answer:



1. Introduce yourself and briefly explain your professional background.

2. Why do you think you would be good at speaking with MedSpa patients?

3. Tell us about your customer service or sales experience.

4. Tell us about a time you successfully convinced a customer or patient to move forward with a purchase, appointment, or service.

5. Pretend you received this phone call:



> “Hi, I'm interested in Botox, but I'm just calling around to compare prices.”



Show us how you would respond and try to turn this caller into a booked consultation or appointment.



**Please speak naturally. Do not read your answers from a script.**



Your video is one of the most important parts of the application because this position requires frequent communication with patients.



Applications without a video will not be considered.



## In Your Written Application, Include:



* Your resume

* Your expected hourly rate

* Your availability

* Your timezone

* Your healthcare experience, if applicable

* Your customer service experience

* Your sales experience

* A link to your video introduction

* The word **“VIBE”** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job posting



## Schedule



We are looking for someone interested in a consistent, long-term position who can work during **U.S. Central Time business hours**.



## Who Will Succeed in This Role



You will probably love this position if you:



* Love talking with people

* Are naturally friendly and personable

* Enjoy sales and achieving goals

* Are comfortable following up multiple times

* Are highly organized

* Learn quickly

* Take initiative

* Pay attention to details

* Want to grow with one company instead of constantly changing clients



We are building a growing practice and are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the team.



If you are looking for a position where you can simply complete tasks quietly in the background, **this is probably not the right position for you.**



If you are confident, personable, competitive, organized, and enjoy turning conversations into happy patients and booked appointments, we would love to hear from you.

title: Software Specialist
description:
About the job

Company Description High School Gate (HSG) is a U.S.-based online private adult high school that enables learners aged 18 and above to complete their high school education from anywhere in the world. Designed specifically for adult learners, HSG offers flexible, competency-based programs delivered fully online through English and Arabic study pathways. The school’s mission is to remove barriers to education and make earning a U.S. high school diploma more accessible, affordable, and achievable for adults, including working professionals, immigrants, refugees, and lifelong learners. Students benefit from personalized academic support, career guidance, and assistance with college and university pathways, all aligned with Florida’s 18-credit ACCEL graduation framework. GATE stands for Global Access To Education, reflecting HSG’s commitment to opening educational opportunities regardless of a learner’s location or life circumstances.



Role Description The Software Specialist is a full-time remote role responsible for supporting, enhancing, and maintaining the software systems that power High School Gate’s online learning environment. In this position, the specialist will work on developing and configuring applications, implementing integrations, and troubleshooting technical issues related to the school’s learning management systems, databases, and student information systems. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing requirements, designing and updating software components, performing testing and quality checks, and collaborating with academic and operations teams to ensure platforms remain secure, reliable, and user-friendly. The role also involves documenting technical processes, monitoring system performance, and recommending improvements to support scalability, accessibility, and a smooth experience for learners and staff.



Qualifications:



Candidates should possess skills in Software Development and Software Design to build, configure, and improve educational technology solutions, like LMS

Candidates should possess Programming skills (e.g., modern web or backend languages) to implement new features and resolve technical issues efficiently.

Candidates should possess Databases skills, including experience with database design, queries, and performance optimization, to manage and maintain learner and system data.

Candidates should possess Testing skills to conduct functional, integration, and regression tests, ensuring software reliability and quality.

Additional beneficial qualifications include experience with learning management systems, cloud-based platforms, and APIs; familiarity with cybersecurity best practices; strong problem-solving abilities; and effective communication skills for collaborating with non-technical stakeholders.

A relevant bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.

Previous experience in education technology, online learning environments, or student information systems is an advantage.

title: Wholesale Coordinator
description:
The Role



You'll own the day-to-day of our wholesale channel — roughly half your time finding and opening new retail accounts, and half making sure every order that comes in gets entered, tracked, and shipped on time. This is a hands-on operator role: you'll be in the Faire brand portal and our Shopify wholesale store every day, sending outreach, entering orders, chasing reorders, and staying on top of what's still sitting unshipped. 



A meaningful share of our wholesale orders are for product that hasn't landed in the warehouse yet. Keeping those visible and shipping them the moment stock arrives is one of the most important parts of this job.



IMPORTANT: This role will be on the Toronto, Canada time zone for 5am to 1pm EST.



What You'll Do:



New account outreach (~50%)



- Build and maintain a prospect list of independent retailers who fit our brand — by category, region, and store profile — using Faire's retailer discovery, Instagram, Google Maps, and retailer directories

- Run personalized outreach through Faire messaging and direct
; write openers that reference the actual store, not a template blast

- Manage Faire Direct links and referrals to bring our own leads onto the platform at better terms

- Set up and send sample requests, line sheets, and lookbooks; follow up on a defined cadence rather than one-and-done

- Track every touch in our CRM/sheet: contacted, replied, sampled, ordered, dormant

- Keep a weekly scorecard: prospects added, outreach sent, reply rate, new accounts opened, first-order value



Order management & fulfillment (~50%)



- Process wholesale orders across both channels: fulfill Faire orders in the brand portal, and manage orders in our Shopify wholesale store

- Enter orders manually for retailers who send their order by
 or PDF — confirm SKUs, quantities, pricing, and terms back to the retailer before the order goes in, so there are no surprises at invoicing

- Own the ship-by date on every order. Confirm the timeline with the retailer at the point of order, and coordinate with our 3PL warehouses so orders leave when they're supposed to

- Manage the open/backorder book. Many orders are placed against inventory still in production or in transit from our manufacturing partners. You'll maintain a live view of what's on order vs. what's landed, know the expected arrival date for every incoming shipment, and release each order to the warehouse the moment its goods are received

- Proactively update retailers on delayed or partially fillable orders before they have to ask — including offering partial shipment where it makes sense

- Flag inventory risks early: if incoming stock won't cover committed orders, escalate with the numbers so we can d
 who gets allocated what

- Answer retailer messages within one business day — sizing, stock, lead times, MOQs, damages, returns

- Run reorder campaigns: flag accounts that haven't ordered in 60/90 days and reach out with a reason to buy (new colorways, seasonal restock, promo)

- Use Faire's Marketing tools —
 campaigns, automations, promotions — to keep the brand in front of retailers

- Maintain product listings, inventory counts, pricing, and imagery across Faire and the Shopify wholesale store so nothing oversells or goes stale

- Monitor sales and payouts; report monthly on wholesale revenue, top accounts, repeat rate, open order value, and average days-to-ship

- Support trade show follow-up (we exhibit at gift and home markets) — every badge scan becomes a tracked prospect



What You Need

- 2+ years in wholesale, B2B sales support, account management, or e-commerce operations — ideally for a consumer product brand

- Hands-on Faire experience from the brand side: you've worked in the brand portal, sent retailer outreach through it, managed orders and Faire Direct, and know how the commission and referral structure actually works

- Shopify order management experience, including creating and editing orders manually and working with draft orders

- Proven ability to run an open-order or backorder book — you can point to a system you used to make sure nothing sat unshipped and forgotten

- Excellent written English — your outreach and retailer replies go out under our brand name, so tone matters

- Comfortable with spreadsheets and a CRM; organized enough to run a follow-up cadence and an open-order tracker across hundreds of lines without dropping any

- Self-directed: you'll be the only person in this seat and won't be managed hour to hour

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and availability during the EST overlap window



Nice to have



- Experience with a 3PL (ShipHero or similar) and with inbound freight timelines

- Familiarity with apparel — sizing, colorways, seasonal buying calendars

- Background with kids', baby, maternity, or sustainable/organic brands

- Experience with other wholesale platforms (Abound, Bulletin, Tundra) or trade show follow-up
