title: Direct response video editor for DTC brand
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type:



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: Lead Generation & Deep Prospect Research Specialist(Find potential clients)
description:
# Lead Generation & Deep Prospect Research Specialist – Private Aviation



I am looking for an experienced **Lead Generation / Prospect Research Specialist** to complete a research project for a private aviation charter business.



**This is a project-based assignment, not an hourly position.** Compensation is based on completed, qualified contacts that meet the research requirements outlined below.



The **first required deliverable is 75 deeply researched, qualified contacts by Monday at 10:00 AM U.S. Central Time.**



This is intended to be the beginning of a much larger database. If the work is excellent, I would like to continue working with the same researcher on additional projects. **An exceptional researcher may also be considered for full-time work in the future as the business grows.**



# What I Need



I am building a high-quality database of potential **private jet charter clients, organizations, decision-makers, and travel influencers throughout the United States.**



This project requires **DEEP RESEARCH.**



I am **NOT** simply looking for obvious names, lists of celebrities, random CEOs, or information copied from basic Google searches.



I need someone who can research an organization, understand its structure, and determine **who within that organization is most likely responsible for arranging, managing, approving, coordinating, or influencing private/VIP travel.**



For example:



Instead of simply listing a professional sports agency, research the agency and identify the appropriate people within the organization who may coordinate or influence private travel for its athletes.



Instead of simply listing a famous athlete, determine who represents or manages that athlete and whether there is an agent, business manager, executive assistant, management company, or other professional who may actually handle travel arrangements.



Instead of simply listing a music management company or talent agency, identify the managers, business managers, tour managers, executive assistants, operations personnel, or other relevant decision-makers who may arrange travel for their clients.



Instead of simply listing a large corporation, determine **who actually handles or influences executive travel within that organization.**



**Finding the correct person within an organization is one of the most important parts of this project.**



# Industries & Organizations to Research



## Sports



Research should prioritize the major professional sports leagues and the **agencies, management companies, representation firms, teams, and professionals surrounding their athletes.**



Primary leagues include:



* **NFL — National Football League (American Football)**

* **NBA — National Basketball Association (Basketball)**

* **MLB — Major League Baseball (Baseball)**

* **NHL — National Hockey League (Hockey)**

* **MLS — Major League Soccer (Soccer/Football)**

* **WNBA — Women's National Basketball Association (Basketball)**



Research should include:



* Major sports agencies

* Athlete representation companies

* Sports agents

* Athlete managers

* Business managers

* Executive assistants

* Sports management companies

* Professional teams and organizations

* Team operations personnel

* Other professionals who may arrange or influence private travel for athletes



**Do not simply provide lists of professional athletes.**



The priority is identifying the **agencies, agents, managers, business managers, assistants, operations personnel, and other professionals who represent these athletes or may actually arrange, approve, coordinate, or influence their private travel.**



For clarity, MLS is the top-flight professional soccer league in the United States and Canada.



## Entertainment



Research should include:



* Music management companies

* Talent agencies

* Artist management companies

* Actor representation

* Model management and modeling agencies

* Business management firms serving entertainers

* Touring companies

* Tour management companies

* Film and television production companies

* Entertainment companies

* Organizations coordinating travel for musicians, actors, models, entertainers, and touring personnel



The goal is **not simply to produce a list of famous entertainers.**



I want to identify the **professionals and organizations behind the talent who may actually arrange or influence private travel.**



For example, this may include managers, agents, business managers, executive assistants, tour managers, operations personnel, and other professionals who coordinate travel for talent.



## Wealth Management / Financial Services / UHNW



Research should include:



* Family offices

* Multi-family offices

* Private wealth management firms

* Financial advisory firms serving UHNW clients

* Private banks

* Asset management firms

* Private equity firms

* Venture capital firms

* Investment banks

* Other organizations whose principals or clients may regularly use private aviation



I am particularly interested in professionals who have relationships with **ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNWIs)** and may be in a position to coordinate, recommend, or influence private aviation services.



The goal is to identify both organizations whose executives may personally have a need for private aviation and professionals who work directly with UHNW clients.



## Energy / Oil & Gas



Research should extend **beyond only the largest oil companies.**



Targets should include:



* Major oil & gas companies

* Large independent operators

* Exploration and production companies

* Oilfield service companies

* Energy trading companies

* Private energy companies

* Engineering / EPC firms

* Energy investment firms

* Energy executives

* Other substantial energy-related companies



I am particularly interested in organizations whose executives or personnel frequently travel between **offices, operating locations, projects, meetings, remote destinations, and different cities or states.**



Do not limit research only to globally recognized energy corporations. Research should also identify **smaller or privately held companies that are substantial enough to have executives, owners, clients, or personnel with a realistic need for private aviation.**



## Medical & Healthcare — Houston / Texas Priority



For the **medical and healthcare category specifically, research should primarily focus on Houston, Texas**, followed by other major markets throughout Texas.



**Houston should receive the highest priority for this category.**



Potential targets include:



* Major Houston-area hospital systems

* Major hospitals and healthcare systems throughout Texas

* Transplant centers and transplant programs

* **Organ transportation / transplant logistics organizations**

* **Organ procurement organizations**

* Medical transportation and logistics companies

* Air medical organizations where relevant

* Specialty medical institutions

* Specialty treatment centers

* International patient programs / international patient services

* Executive health programs

* Specialty physician groups

* Healthcare companies

* Healthcare executives

* Medical organizations

* Healthcare investors

* Medical conference/organization leadership

* Organizations coordinating transportation for specialized medical teams or other time-sensitive medical needs



For organ transplantation and medical transportation, research should focus exclusively on **appropriate professional and organizational contacts** involved in operations, logistics, transportation, aviation/vendor relationships, procurement, administration, or other relevant functions.



**No private patient, donor, or medical information should be collected.**



For this category, I do **not** simply want a list of hospitals or physicians.



Part of the researcher's responsibility is to investigate these organizations and determine **where a legitimate private aviation need may exist and who within the organization would be the appropriate professional to approach.**



Potential areas may include:



* Executive travel

* Organ transportation

* Transplant logistics

* Medical team transportation

* International patient services

* Specialty care

* Executive health

* Physician/specialist travel

* VIP patient coordination

* Development/donor relations

* Corporate operations

* Other areas where research indicates private aviation may be relevant



**Houston, Texas should be the primary geographic focus for medical/healthcare research, with the rest of Texas as the secondary focus.**



## Media & News



Research should include:



* Major television networks

* News organizations

* Local television stations in major markets

* Media companies

* Production companies

* Broadcast organizations

* Media executives

* Talent operations

* Organizations responsible for travel involving anchors, correspondents, executives, production teams, or other talent



Again, the objective is to identify **the people responsible for or involved with arranging travel**, rather than simply compiling the names of anchors, journalists, or executives.



## Universities & Higher Education



**Do not limit university research to athletics.**



Large universities may have private aviation needs involving senior leadership, athletics, major donors, fundraising, research, medical programs, government relations, special events, and other institutional activities.



Research should investigate opportunities involving:



* University presidents and chancellors

* Offices of the President / Chancellor

* Executive administration

* Boards of Regents / Trustees

* University foundations

* Advancement / Development

* Major donor relations

* Alumni relations

* Government relations

* Research leadership

* Medical schools and academic medical programs

* Major university events

* Athletic departments

* Athletic directors

* Major football programs

* Major basketball programs

* Team operations

* Athletic operations

* Team travel

* Other departments where research indicates frequent executive, VIP, donor, athletic, academic, or institutional travel



The goal is **not simply to collect university administrators or athletic directors.**



The researcher should determine **which departments have a realistic potential need for private aviation and who within those departments is responsible for arranging, approving, coordinating, or influencing travel.**



## Legal & Professional Services



Research should include:



* Major law firms

* Entertainment law firms

* Sports law firms

* Corporate law firms

* Consulting firms

* Accounting firms

* Business management firms

* Professional-service organizations serving UHNW individuals, corporations, athletes, entertainers, and executives



Research should prioritize individuals within these organizations who work closely with **high-value clients, firm leadership, or executives who may use private aviation.**



## Real Estate



Research should include:



* Large commercial real-estate developers

* Real-estate investment firms

* Luxury developers

* Major private developers

* Real-estate investment companies

* Executives who regularly travel between projects, properties, and markets



## Luxury / UHNW Services



Research should include:



* Luxury concierge companies

* Lifestyle-management companies

* Family-office service providers

* Celebrity business-management firms

* UHNW client-service companies

* Other organizations that coordinate services or travel for wealthy individuals and families



These organizations may be particularly valuable because **one professional relationship could potentially provide access to multiple private aviation clients.**



## Additional High-Value Industries



The researcher is encouraged to identify **additional industries, organizations, or prospect categories where there is a strong and logical need for private aviation.**



Potential areas may include:



* Private equity and investment firms

* Large construction/infrastructure companies

* Engineering firms

* Corporate event companies

* Touring/event production companies

* Luxury hospitality organizations

* High-level consulting firms

* Companies with executives who frequently travel to multiple locations

* Organizations serving UHNW individuals



I am open to additional prospect categories if the researcher can explain **why they represent a strong private aviation opportunity.**



# Who I Want You to Find



**Do not stop after identifying the company or organization.**



Research the organization and identify the **best person or people for me to contact regarding private travel.**



Depending on the organization, relevant titles may include:



* Executive Assistant

* Executive Business Partner

* Chief of Staff

* Travel Manager

* Corporate Travel Manager

* Travel Coordinator

* Director of Operations

* VP of Operations

* Business Manager

* Artist Manager

* Tour Manager

* Talent Manager

* Sports Agent

* Athlete Manager

* Director of Team Operations

* Athletic Operations

* Executive Operations

* Procurement / Strategic Sourcing

* Family Office Manager

* Client Services / Lifestyle Manager

* Executive Services

* Transportation / Logistics Manager

* Other roles that research indicates are responsible for or influence travel decisions



**Do not limit the research only to these titles.**



Part of this assignment is using your research skills and professional judgment to determine who the appropriate decision-maker or influencer is within each organization.



# Required Information for Each Contact



For each prospect, please provide **as much accurate and verified professional information as reasonably available**, including:



* Industry / Category

* Company / Organization

* Contact's full name

* Current job title / role

* City / State

* Verified professional/business

* Publicly available business phone/direct line, when available

* LinkedIn or relevant professional profile, when available

* Company website

* Research / verification source(s)

* Short explanation of **why the organization is a potential private aviation prospect**

* Short explanation of **why this specific person was selected as the appropriate contact**

* Any additional relevant notes



## Important Note About Available Information



I understand that **not every piece of information listed above will be publicly available for every contact.**



You are **not expected to provide information that cannot reasonably be found or verified.**



The expectation is that you conduct thorough research and provide **as much accurate, relevant, and verifiable professional information as reasonably possible for each contact.**



For example, if you identify an excellent decision-maker and can verify their position and professional
 address, but a direct business phone number is not publicly available, **the contact may still be included.** Simply indicate that the information was not publicly available rather than guessing or providing unverified information.



Similarly, some organizations may make it difficult to determine exactly who has responsibility for private or executive travel. In those situations, use your research and professional judgment to identify the **most relevant person or department available** and briefly explain your reasoning in the notes.



**Accuracy is more important than filling every field. Never guess, fabricate, or use questionable personal information simply to complete a column.**



The goal is to provide the **best and most complete information reasonably available for each qualified prospect.**



# Quality & Research Expectations



**Quality is more important than simply producing a large number of names.**



I do not want a database created by quickly scraping hundreds of obvious names.



I want research that answers:



**Who is this person?**



**What organization are they with?**



**Why could this organization reasonably have a need for private aviation?**



**Why is this particular individual the appropriate person for me to contact?**



For example, finding the CEO of a major entertainment company may be easy. Finding the person within that organization who actually oversees executive or talent travel requires deeper research.



**That second type of research is what I am looking for.**



# Compensation & Project Milestones



This is a **project-based assignment rather than an hourly position.**



Payment is based on completed, qualified contacts that meet the research requirements of this project.



The following amounts are **cumulative project totals:**



* **25 qualified contacts — $30 total**

* **50 qualified contacts — $60 total**

* **75 qualified contacts — $95 total**

* **100 qualified contacts — $120 total**



A contact is not considered complete simply because a person's name has been entered into the database.



Each qualified contact should demonstrate genuine research, appropriate decision-maker identification, verification of current employment, **as much professional contact information as reasonably available**, research sources, and an explanation of why both the organization and individual are relevant to private aviation.



Contacts that are duplicates, outdated, clearly irrelevant, fabricated, or do not demonstrate the required level of research may need to be corrected or replaced before being counted as completed qualified contacts.



# Required Deadline



The **first 75 deeply researched, qualified contacts must be completed and delivered by Monday at 10:00 AM U.S. Central Time.**



If the quality meets expectations, I would like to immediately continue to **100 contacts and potentially several hundred additional contacts.**



# Final Deliverables



Research must be delivered in **two formats: an editable spreadsheet and an organized PDF.**



## 1. Spreadsheet



The spreadsheet should be maintained throughout the project and include:



* Industry / Category

* Company / Organization

* Contact Name

* Job Title / Role

* City / State

* Verified Professional

* Public Business Phone / Direct Line, when available

* LinkedIn / Professional Profile, when available

* Company Website

* Research / Verification Source

* Why the organization is a potential private aviation prospect

* Why this specific person is an appropriate contact

* Additional relevant notes



The spreadsheet should be **clean, professional, easy to filter, and organized by industry.**



## 2. PDF



A professionally organized **PDF version of the contact database must be provided with the 75-contact delivery and subsequent major/final deliveries.**



The PDF should group contacts by industry so each prospect category can be easily reviewed separately.



Suggested sections include:



* Sports

* Entertainment

* Energy / Oil & Gas

* Medical & Healthcare — Houston / Texas

* Wealth Management / Family Offices / Financial Services

* Media & News

* Universities & Higher Education

* Real Estate

* Legal & Professional Services

* Luxury / UHNW Services

* Other Qualified Industries



# Future Opportunity



Although this assignment begins as a project-based role, I am looking for someone with whom I can develop a **long-term working relationship.**



I expect to need **hundreds of additional qualified contacts** as the database grows, along with future research, lead-generation, and business-development support.



Someone who consistently demonstrates **excellent research ability, accuracy, attention to detail, reliability, communication, initiative, and an understanding of the decision-makers I am targeting may be considered for full-time work in the future as the business grows.**



When Applying



Please answer the following:



1. What experience do you have with deep prospect research, lead generation, and contact list building?

2. What research/database tools do you use?

3. What tools or methods do you use to verify professional
 addresses and current employment?

4. Are you able to complete **75 deeply researched, qualified contacts by Monday at 10:00 AM U.S. Central Time?**

5. Please provide an example of a similar research/list-building project you have completed, if available.

6. Briefly explain how you would approach finding the **actual person responsible for or involved in travel decisions within an organization**, rather than simply finding the organization's most obvious executives.

7. Please confirm that you understand the project requires **deep organizational research**, not simply lists of companies or famous individuals.

8. Please confirm that you understand that **not every information field must be available for every prospect, but you are expected to research and provide as much accurate, verifiable information as reasonably possible.**

9. Please confirm that you understand the required deliverables include an **organized spreadsheet and a PDF grouped by industry.**



**Please read the entire posting before applying. I am specifically looking for deep research and accurate decision-maker identification — not basic web scraping or a generic lead list.**

title: Direct response video editor for e-commerce brand
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue 



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type: 



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage. 



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description:
We're looking for the person who opens our creative brief, reads what we wrote, and comes back with something better than what we asked for.



If your instinct on getting a brief is to fill the order exactly as written, this role will frustrate both of us. We want the editor who asks why the hook isn't landing and proposes a stronger one, who remembers the b-roll we shot two projects ago and pulls it into this week's Reel, and who sends us a trend on Tuesday that we hadn't seen yet.

We're hiring one person to do that across video and design.



Who we are

The Assist is a newsletter for professional women navigating the full complexity of career and life, reaching 300K+ engaged readers. We publish four editions a week (OG Tuesday, Wellness Wednesday, ThirstyThursday, and The Weekender), each built for a different moment in her week, and we're building out our Instagram presence to match what we've built in
. We're small, we move fast, and we care a lot about craft.



We give readers the specific move, not just the concept. Tactical guidance, honest perspective, whole-person support: written by women, for women, never corporate.



The role

You'll work as an embedded member of our creative team on a contract basis. You'll sit inside our process, know our brand as well as we do, and have opinions about it.



Two jobs in one seat:

Video (roughly 70% of the work). Cutting Instagram Reels, and building the template system that lets us produce them at volume.

Design (roughly 30%). Finishing our brand identity and building carousel templates our team can run without you. This is ideal but not required. 



What you'll deliver each month

8-10 Instagram Reels

Ongoing additions to our Reel and carousel template library

Proactive ideas: trends, formats, and hooks you think we should try



How our process works

Our campaigns live in a Notion database. Each campaign contains a creative brief for a Reel, and inside that brief you'll find b-roll, script ideas, and the preset templates we want used.

Raw footage and brand assets currently live in Google Drive, but we're just getting started with video, so you'll help us shape the process as we go.



You pull the brief, cut the Reel, and send it back. Along the way we expect you to talk to us:

“Can you shoot b-roll of X? It would make this opening land.”

“Have you seen the latest trend of X? You guys should try it.” 

“You used footage two campaigns ago that fits this. Want me to pull it in?”

“This hook isn't strong enough. Here are two alternates.”



The video work, specifically

We want our video brand identity to feel like our newsletter has come to life: fun, witty, and full of big-sister energy. We're here to motivate, teach, share, and collaborate. We're all learning together, and the editing should feel that way too.

We want videos that are in this kind of style:



Talking-head editing that stays natural while feeling finished. One locked-off shot, soft natural light, mic visible on purpose. The energy comes entirely from the cutting.

Invisible jump cuts. Tightening speech in-frame so the pace lifts without feeling choppy, fast and dense without ever feeling jarring.

L-cuts and J-cuts. Audio leading or trailing the picture so transitions land smoothly.

Headline typography as the scroll-stopper. Oversized, all-caps, stacked, centered, with color used intentionally to reinforce the point being made. This is the single most important skill for this role.

Caption styling with real taste in type. Something like a light serif set phrase-by-phrase, not the default karaoke preset most editing apps default to.

Screenshot and cutout overlays. Drop-shadowed, slightly rotated, clustered as visual evidence inside the frame.

Restraint with stickers and emoji. Sparse accents that punctuate a moment and then get out of the way.

Sound design that serves the edit. Little to no music bed, closer to wall-to-wall voiceover, with pace coming from the speech and the cutting rather than a track underneath it.



The design work, specifically

This role covers both finishing our brand identity and turning it into templates our team can run without you. That's two different skill sets, and we're looking for someone who can do both.



Brand strategy

Finish our brand identity. We're about 85% there. We have a couple of different brand guidelines in place that need to be merged into one cohesive document, with the judgment calls that requires (what stays, what goes, what's the actual system) rather than just formatting an existing decision.



Production

Build carousel templates. Reusable, on-brand, and simple enough that our interns and virtual assistants can produce from them without design training.

Create visual assets we can rebuild ourselves. Everything you make should be handed over in a form our team can edit and extend.



Tools

Required: Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Notion.

Also needed: After Effects, Descript, Canva, Illustrator, plus a willingness to bring in other tools we haven't discovered yet.



You should be

Fluent in short-form vertical video, with a portfolio of Reels or TikToks you cut yourself

Genuinely good with type. Most of this job is typography moving in time

Comfortable being told "here's the brief, make it better"

A self-starter who can help us see what's possible with video, since we don't know everything about it ourselves

A clear communicator in writing, since most of our back-and-forth will be async

Organized enough to build systems other people can use, and to hand over files in a state they can pick up

Active enough on social media that trends reach you before they reach us

Available on Slack with hours that overlap the Pacific Standard Time team, and open to the occasional quick scheduled video call when async isn't enough



You'll stand out if

You've built a template system that a team actually adopted and kept using

You've worked on a newsletter, media brand, or creator-led business

You have a point of view about our current Instagram and tell us what you'd change

You've helped shape a brand identity and can walk us through the thinking behind it

You send us an idea we hadn't thought of before we've even hired you



The arrangement

Independent contractor, month to month.

Monthly retainer depending on skillset and experience, tied to the deliverable goals above.

Work made for hire, standard ownership terms.

Either side can step away with 30 days' notice.



How to apply

Apply through this listing and reply with two or three Reels or TikToks you personally cut, ideally similar in style to what we're going for. If they're already visible on your profile or portfolio, feel free to just point us there instead of re-sending them.

title: Logistics & Inventory Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Logistics & Inventory Manager** to manage inventory planning, purchasing, Amazon FBA replenishment, domestic transportation, international freight, and customs coordination for a growing U.S. e-commerce company.



This is a hands-on position. We are looking for someone who has personally managed these functions, not someone whose experience is limited to shipment tracking or communicating with freight forwarders.



Our products are manufactured internationally, imported into the United States, stored in warehouses, and distributed through Amazon FBA and other sales channels.



## Responsibilities



### Inventory Forecasting & Planning



* Forecast inventory requirements using historical sales, current inventory, sales velocity, lead times, and expected demand.

* Determine when purchase orders need to be placed and how much inventory should be ordered.

* Maintain appropriate safety stock.

* Identify potential stockouts or excess inventory well in advance.

* Track inventory across factories, in-transit shipments, warehouses, and Amazon FBA.

* Prepare regular inventory forecasts and replenishment plans.



### Purchase Order Management



* Create and manage purchase orders with suppliers.

* Track production schedules, completion dates, deposits, balances, and shipping deadlines.

* Follow up with manufacturers to keep production on schedule.

* Maintain accurate records of open, completed, and upcoming purchase orders.

* Coordinate purchasing decisions with inventory forecasts and demand.



### Amazon FBA



* Create and manage Amazon FBA inbound shipments.

* Determine appropriate replenishment quantities for Amazon fulfillment centers.

* Coordinate shipments from warehouses or suppliers to Amazon.

* Monitor inbound shipments through delivery and receiving.

* Investigate shortages, receiving discrepancies, delays, and other FBA inbound issues.

* Monitor FBA inventory levels and ensure adequate replenishment.



### Domestic Freight



* Book and coordinate transportation throughout the United States.

* Manage LTL and FTL shipments.

* Request, compare, and negotiate freight quotes when appropriate.

* Schedule pickups and deliveries with warehouses, carriers, and Amazon.

* Track shipments and resolve transportation problems or delays.



### International Freight



* Manage international LCL and FCL ocean freight shipments.

* Coordinate with factories, freight forwarders, carriers, customs brokers, and warehouses.

* Request and compare international freight quotes.

* Review shipment schedules and shipping documentation.

* Track shipments from factory pickup through final delivery.

* Manage delays, port issues, and changes to shipment schedules.



### Customs Clearance



* Coordinate customs clearance with brokers and freight forwarders.

* Review commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and other import documentation.

* Work with HTS classifications and customs documentation.

* Coordinate duties, tariffs, and clearance requirements.

* Resolve customs holds, documentation issues, and clearance delays.



## Required Experience



Applicants should have strong hands-on experience with most or all of the following:



* Inventory forecasting and demand planning

* Inventory replenishment

* Purchase order management

* Amazon Seller Central

* Amazon FBA inbound shipments

* U.S. domestic LTL and FTL trucking

* International LCL and FCL ocean freight

* Freight forwarders

* Customs brokers

* U.S. customs clearance

* Commercial invoices

* Packing lists

* Bills of lading

* HTS codes

* International manufacturers

* Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

* Tracking inventory across multiple warehouses and fulfillment locations



Experience working with U.S.-based e-commerce companies and manufacturers in China or other Asian countries is strongly preferred.



## What We Are Looking For



We need someone who takes ownership of logistics and inventory operations.



The right candidate should be able to independently review inventory levels and determine:



* What products need to be reordered

* How much inventory needs to be ordered

* When purchase orders need to be placed

* When production needs to be completed

* When freight needs to be booked

* How inventory should be allocated between warehouses and Amazon FBA

* Whether the company is at risk of running out of inventory

* What action should be taken if production or transportation is delayed



You should be highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple shipments and purchase orders at the same time.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



## How to Apply



Please include your resume and a **5 to 8 minute video recording** answering the questions below.



The video does not need to be professionally edited. A simple recording from your computer or phone is fine. Please answer in your own words and do not read from a prepared script.



At the beginning of the video, please state **today's date and the city where you are currently located.**



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your most recent logistics or supply chain position and what you personally managed.

2. Explain how you forecast inventory and determine when to place a purchase order and how much to order.

3. Describe your experience managing Amazon FBA replenishment and inbound shipments.

4. Tell us about a shipment where you personally managed LTL, FTL, LCL, or FCL freight. What exactly were you responsible for?

5. Walk us through the process of importing a shipment into the United States, from the factory completing production through customs clearance and final warehouse delivery.

6. What international shipping and customs documents have you personally reviewed or prepared?

7. Tell us about a logistics or inventory problem that went wrong. What happened, and how did you resolve it?

8. If you discovered that one of our best-selling products would run out of inventory in six weeks, what steps would you take?



Please also include:



* Your expected monthly salary

* Your availability

* Your earliest possible start date



**Please do not apply if your logistics experience is primarily customer service, shipment tracking, or forwarding
s between suppliers, carriers, and freight forwarders. We are looking for someone with direct responsibility for inventory planning, purchasing, and logistics operations.**

# Graphic Designer — Health & Wellness Brand



## About the Role



We are a US based company looking for a talented, reliable, and highly independent **Graphic Designer** to join our health and wellness business on a long-term basis.



This is a great opportunity for someone who wants more than simply creating designs from templates. You will have the opportunity to help **develop and shape our visual brand from the ground up**, including contributing to the development of our brand identity, visual style, templates, and design standards.



We need someone who can take a project, understand the objective and instructions, and run with it without needing constant supervision.



**Your portfolio and actual design ability matter much more to us than how many years you've been designing.**



## What You'll Be Doing



You may work on a wide variety of creative assets, including:



* Social media graphics

*
 and Instagram advertisements

* YouTube thumbnails

* Website graphics

* Marketing materials

* Flyers and brochures

*
 graphics

* Presentations

* Product graphics and promotional materials

* Posters and banners

* Logos and branding materials

* Marketing campaign assets

* Other graphic design projects as needed



You will also help us develop a consistent visual identity and eventually establish a formal brand guide.



## What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has a **strong graphic design portfolio**

* Has excellent knowledge of the **Adobe Creative Suite**, especially Photoshop and Illustrator

* Can create professional designs from scratch rather than simply relying on templates

* Can take a concept or set of instructions and turn it into a polished finished product

* Can work independently and manage projects without constant supervision

* Has excellent attention to detail

* Is fast and efficient

* Communicates quickly and clearly

* Follows procedures and instructions carefully

* Can prioritize multiple projects when necessary

* Is comfortable asking questions when something isn't clear

* Can consistently meet weekly deadlines

* Has good design judgment and understands what makes marketing materials visually effective



**Figma is not required, but experience with Figma is a bonus.**



## AI & Modern Design Tools



We are also interested in someone who understands how to use **AI as a creative tool**.



You should be comfortable using AI image/design tools when appropriate to help brainstorm concepts, generate visual elements, explore ideas, or create unique design directions.



We don't want someone who simply generates an AI image and calls it finished. You should have the design skills to take AI-generated concepts or assets and turn them into professional, usable marketing materials.



## Work Schedule



This is a **full-time position with a very flexible schedule**.



We care much more about your ability to get the work done well and on time than about watching a clock.



You must be available to communicate and work during **U.S. Central Time** when needed.



Workload may vary from week to week. During slower periods, we are flexible with your schedule and time off. During busy periods, we may occasionally need an asset completed quickly, sometimes **the same day**.



Most projects will be planned ahead and completed on a weekly basis, but you should be comfortable handling an occasional urgent request.



## What Makes Someone Successful in This Role



The ideal person is someone who can receive a project like:



> "Here's the information and the goal. Please create a professional social media graphic and banner."



…and take ownership of the project from there.



You should be able to research, think creatively, make design decisions, produce the asset, and deliver a polished result without needing someone to walk you through every step.



**Speed, communication, independence, creativity, and reliability are extremely important to us.**



## Experience



We care more about **what you can actually produce than how many years you've worked as a designer**.



Whether you've been designing for 2 years or 10 years isn't nearly as important to us as the quality of your portfolio and your ability to execute.



## Application Process



Please include:



1. Your portfolio

2. A brief description of your graphic design experience

3. The Adobe programs you are most comfortable using

4. Any experience you have with AI design/image-generation tools

5. Your preferred working hours in U.S. Central Time

6. Your expected salary



### Design Test



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a **simple redesign exercise**.



We'll provide a basic poster and banner and ask you to redesign them.



This is not intended to be a complicated project. We simply want to see how you approach design, follow instructions, and turn a basic concept into something polished and professional.



**Please do not send generic AI-generated designs as your portfolio. We want to see your actual design ability.**



## Important



Please do not apply if you require constant supervision or need detailed instructions for every small task.



We're looking for someone who can become a trusted member of the team, take ownership of their work, communicate reliably, and consistently deliver high-quality designs.



If you're a talented designer who enjoys having creative freedom and wants to help build a health & wellness brand from the ground up, we'd love to see your work.

title: Content Strategist + Social Media Assistant
description:
Content Strategist + Social Media Assistant



**Part-Time | Long-Term | Remote**



Hi! I'm Jordynn, founder and creative director of Social Magic, a growing social media strategy and creative agency based in the United States.



We're looking for a smart, creative, internet-savvy person to join our team long-term and help us create genuinely GOOD social media for our clients.



And here's the important part:



Our clients aren't all trendy coffee shops, fashion brands or aesthetically perfect businesses.



We work with tree services, car washes, sports facilities, hospitality brands, wineries, technology companies and other businesses that are really good at what they do.



Our job is to figure out what makes them interesting and turn that into content people actually want to watch, read, save and share.



**That's the skill I'm looking for.**



## What you'll help with



You'll work directly with me to take our strategy and creative direction and turn it into finished content.



Depending on the client, that may include:



* Researching the business, industry, competitors and audience

* Brainstorming content concepts and strong hooks

* Turning my notes, voice memos and ideas into organized content

* Writing first drafts of social media copy and captions

* Creating carousels and graphics in Canva using our brand systems

* Finding great moments in our existing photo and video libraries

* Creating simple Reels from existing footage

* Organizing content calendars in Notion

* Scheduling approved content

* Keeping client assets and content organized

* Researching trends, conversations and opportunities relevant to our clients



You will **not** be expected to come in knowing exactly how Social Magic does everything. I'll train you on our clients, strategy, voice and creative standards.



What I can't teach as easily is curiosity.



If you're given a tree company, I need you to want to figure out why someone should care about tree work.



If you're given a car wash, I want you thinking about why people love the feeling of getting into a perfectly clean car.



If you're given a baseball training facility, I want you researching what parents, coaches and young athletes actually care about.



## You're probably a great fit if...



You genuinely enjoy social media and understand internet culture.



You're a strong writer and communicator in English.



You're naturally curious and good at research.



You have experience with Canva.



You're comfortable learning new industries.



You notice good hooks, interesting stories and small details other people overlook.



You can receive creative feedback without taking it personally.



You're organized enough to manage multiple brands without mixing them together.



You don't need every client to be "cool" before you can make cool work.



Agency or social media experience is great, but **how you think matters more to me than an impressive résumé.**



## Tools we use



Canva

Google Drive

Notion

Instagram


TikTok



Experience with scheduling platforms and simple video editing is a plus.



## Hours + Compensation



This is a part-time, long-term position with room to grow as Social Magic grows.



We'll start with approximately **20 hours per week**, with the potential for additional hours and responsibility over time.



Please include your desired hourly or monthly rate in your application.



## How to Apply



Please send me:



1. A short introduction about yourself and why this position interests you.

2. Your résumé and/or portfolio if you have one.

3. Links or examples of social media content you've created.

4. Your experience with Canva, social media management, writing and video editing.

5. Your desired hourly or monthly rate.

6. Your general working availability and timezone.



**And finally, answer this:**



Imagine one of our clients is a local tree service.



They've been in business for 30+ years. They do tree removal, trimming, storm cleanup and difficult jobs involving cranes. They're extremely experienced, professional and trusted locally.



**Give me THREE social media post ideas you would create for them.**



Don't overthink it. I'm much more interested in seeing how your brain works than getting a perfect answer.



Please start your application with the words **MAGIC MAKER** so I know you read the entire posting.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with us, learn how we approach creative strategy and eventually become an important part of the Social Magic team.

title: UK Cold Caller & Appointment Setter – Excellent English Required
description:
UK COLD CALLER & APPOINTMENT SETTER – EXCELLENT SPOKEN ENGLISH ESSENTIAL



WELLRANKED is a UK-focused digital growth and marketing company helping small and independent businesses improve their online presence, generate more enquiries and grow.



We are looking for a confident, energetic and highly articulate  Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to join our growing remote sales team.



Your main responsibility will be calling business owners across the United Kingdom, starting conversations, identifying potential opportunities and booking qualified appointments for our senior sales team.



 EXCELLENT SPOKEN ENGLISH IS ESSENTIAL



This is a telephone-based role speaking directly with British business owners every day.



You must have:



* Excellent, fluent spoken English

* A clear, natural and easily understood accent

* Strong understanding of **British English and different UK accents

* Excellent listening and comprehension skills

* Natural conversational ability , we do NOT want someone who simply reads from a script

* Confidence speaking with business owners and decision-makers

* The ability to think quickly and respond naturally during conversations



Previous experience speaking with **UK customers or businesses** is highly preferred.



Experience working for a UK call centre, sales company, appointment-setting company, telecoms provider, marketing agency or other UK-facing business would be a major advantage.



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



* Make outbound calls to UK businesses using leads provided by WELLRANKED

* Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers

* Introduce WELLRANKED and our services clearly and professionally

* Ask relevant questions to understand the business

* Identify businesses that could benefit from our services

* Handle common objections confidently

* Generate interest without being aggressive or overly scripted

* Book qualified appointments for our senior sales closer

* Accurately update calls, notes and outcomes in our CRM

* Follow up with prospects where required

* Meet daily and weekly activity and appointment targets

* Attend sales training and coaching sessions

* Continuously improve based on call reviews and feedback



**You are NOT expected to close the full sale.**



Your primary objective is to create a strong first impression, identify genuine opportunities and book qualified appointments for our senior sales team.



### WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We would particularly like to hear from candidates with experience in:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* UK outbound calling

* Appointment setting

* Lead generation

* Telemarketing

* Call centres

* Digital marketing or agency sales



However, exceptional communication ability, confidence and willingness to learn are more important to us than having the perfect CV.



### WORKING HOURS



This is a remote position working **40 hours per week**.



You must be available during **UK business hours**, Monday to Friday.



You will need:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A quiet professional working environment

* Reliable computer/laptop

* Good quality headset

* Stable electricity and backup arrangements where necessary



WELLRANKED will provide the calling systems, leads, scripts, CRM access, training and support required for the role.



### SALARY & PERFORMANCE BONUSES



**Base salary: $500 USD per month**



PLUS performance-based bonuses for achieving appointment and sales targets.



High-performing team members will have the opportunity to earn significantly more through bonuses and salary progression.



We are looking for people who want a **long-term position and the opportunity to grow with the company.**



### IMPORTANT – VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Because spoken communication is extremely important for this position, **every applicant must submit a voice recording.**



Applications without a voice recording will not progress to the next stage.



Please record yourself saying the following:



*"Hi, I'm calling from WELLRANKED. We work with independent businesses across the UK to help improve their online presence and generate more enquiries. I was hoping to speak with whoever looks after your website and Google presence. Would that be yourself?"*



Then imagine the business owner responds:



*"Yes, but we're actually happy with what we have at the moment."*



Continue the recording naturally for approximately **30–60 seconds**, responding as though you were genuinely speaking with the business owner.



**Do not use AI-generated or modified audio. We want to hear your natural speaking voice.**



Please include a link to your recording with your application.



### WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS



1. How many years of cold-calling or appointment-setting experience do you have?

2. Have you previously called UK customers or UK businesses? If yes, tell us about the role.

3. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day in your previous role?

4. What CRM and calling systems have you previously used?

5. What do you think makes a good cold call?

6. Are you comfortable working UK business hours Monday–Friday?

7. What is your current internet speed and do you have backup internet/electricity?

8. Please provide the link to your **voice recording** using the script above.



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application with the words **"WELLRANKED UK"** so we know you have read the full job description.



We are looking to hire soon and will invite the strongest applicants to a short interview.

title: Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager (Project Manager) is the operational “air-traffic controller” for active construction projects. You keep projects moving by coordinating communication, scheduling, documentation, purchasing support, inspections, and payment/change-order tracking—while protecting the production team’s time and maintaining clear client expectations. This is a remote role supporting California projects; you must work Pacific Time hours and coordinate across multiple stakeholders.



Core Responsibilities

• Project documentation & research: maintain complete project files, permit/inspection notes, plan sets, client communications, and internal logs

• Materials coordination: support ordering and delivery coordination; confirm site readiness; track lead times; flag risks early

• Stakeholder coordination: communicate with crews, subcontractors, and clients to ensure clarity, alignment, and next actions.

• Inspections scheduling: request and schedule city/municipal inspections as required; confirm prerequisites; communicate outcomes and next steps.

• Invoicing & payment tracking: prepare invoice support, track client payments, and follow up on outstanding balances per company policy.

• Change orders: draft CO documentation, gather approvals, track status, and ensure COs are billed and paid.

• Crew attendance / performance tracking: collect daily/weekly field updates and flag issues to the Director of Operations.

• Pipeline support (as needed): track and follow up project-related leads/items in the company pipeline and ensure clean handoffs.



Schedule & Availability



Full-time. Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT), with a 1-hour unpaid lunch. You must have reliable internet and be able to join calls during Pacific Time business hours.



Required Qualifications

• 2+ years experience in project coordination, construction administration, or operations support (construction preferred)

• Excellent written English and professional client communication.

• Strong follow-through: you close loops and don’t let tasks stall.

• Comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders and keeping records clean.

• Able to learn and enforce SOPs; comfortable with checklists and documentation.

• Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet suitable for video calls.



Preferred

• Experience supporting California residential construction (ADU, remodel, additions)

• Experience with permit/inspection scheduling and compliance documentation.

• Spreadsheet confidence (basic formulas, tracking logs).

• Experience with cost tracking, purchase orders, and change orders.

title: Phone Receptionist + Admin VA for Canadian Demolition Company | Night Shift | Long-Term
description:
SHIFT: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM Toronto time (currently 9:00 PM to 3:30 AM Philippine time), with a 30 minute unpaid break. The shift follows Toronto time year-round, so your PH clock shifts one hour when Canada changes daylight saving.



PAY: $7 to $8 USD/hour depending on experience, paid bi-weekly via Wise. 13th month pay included, pro-rated. Performance review and raise discussion at 6 months. This is a long-term role, not a project.



ABOUT US



We are an established demolition company in Toronto, Canada operating several brands across the Greater Toronto Area. You will be the first voice our customers hear.



THE JOB



Primary duty, always comes first: answer inbound calls from homeowners and contractors, run a structured intake script, log every call in our CRM (Google Sheets based), send follow-up text messages from templates, and book site visit appointments into our calendar. Calls come through a softphone app on your computer. The screen shows which brand the caller dialed and you answer with that brand's name.



Between calls: checklist work we provide step by step. Submitting our business listings to online directories (exact data and descriptions provided, copy-paste accuracy is critical), sending follow-up and review-request texts from templates, replying to text messages using our playbooks, building research lists in Google Sheets, and keeping the CRM clean.



You will NOT be asked to: sell, cold call, quote prices, write marketing content, manage Google Business Profiles, or make marketing decisions. The scripts and checklists are provided.



REQUIREMENTS



1. 2+ years of voice experience with US or Canadian customers (BPO, reception, dispatch, or customer service)

2. Clear, neutral accent. Canadian homeowners must understand every word without effort

3. Strong written English for text messages and CRM notes

4. Careful with details. Copy-paste discipline matters in this role

5. Quiet dedicated workspace, headset, and a computer that can run a softphone

6. Main internet 25+ Mbps AND a backup connection (pocket wifi or second ISP) AND a power backup plan

7. Comfortable working the night shift long-term

8. Reliable, on time, and honest when something goes wrong



Construction, home services, trades, or dispatch experience is a plus but not required.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications missing any item below are automatically rejected. This is the first test of the job: following instructions exactly.



1. Start your application with the word TUSK on the first line

2. A voice recording link (Vocaroo or similar), 60 to 90 seconds, ONE take, unscripted, answering both: (a) describe your most recent phone role with US or Canadian customers, (b) how do you handle an angry caller?

3. A screenshot of your internet speed test

4. One short paragraph describing your backup internet and backup power setup

5. Your resume



HIRING PROCESS



1. Voice screen (your recording)

2. Live mock call on video. You get our intake script 24 hours before so you can prepare

3. Paid test week at full rate

4. Ongoing role



We reply to every shortlisted applicant within 3 business days.
