title: Video editor for e-commerce
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue 



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type: 



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage. 



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

s

s or messages after completed jobs

Working Closely With Me

s

title: Website Designer & Developer for Professional Ballet Company — Project-Based
description:
Website Designer & Developer for Professional Ballet Company — Project-Based



We are looking for an experienced Website Designer & Developer to redesign and build a modern, high-performing website for a professional contemporary ballet company based in the United States.



Our organization creates professional dance experiences that combine movement, music, visual art, storytelling, and immersive elements. Our website needs to visually represent the caliber of our work while making it easy for audiences to discover performances, purchase tickets, support the organization, and learn more about our programs.



We are looking for a website that is beautiful, highly functional, SEO optimized, mobile responsive, video-forward, and FAST.



The Project



We need a complete redesign of our current website with a strong focus on:



Modern, visually impactful design

Excellent site speed and performance

SEO and Google search visibility

Easy video integration without slowing down the website

Mobile-first design

Clear navigation and user experience

Strong calls to action

Easy ongoing updates for our internal team



Our performances are highly visual, so video will be an important part of the website experience. We want to be able to incorporate performance trailers, background video, and other video content throughout the site while maintaining fast load times.



Website Functionality



The new website will likely include:



Homepage

Current season and performances

Individual performance landing pages

About the company

Artists/company dancers

School and training programs

Community programs

Support/donate pages

Sponsorship information

News/press

Contact

Ticket links and calls to action

Embedded or integrated video

 signup integration

Analytics and tracking



We also regularly launch new performances and events, so our team needs to be able to create and update landing pages without needing a developer every time.



SEO + Performance



This is extremely important to us.



We want someone who understands more than basic website design. You should have experience with:



Technical SEO

On-page SEO structure

Page titles and meta descriptions

Heading hierarchy

Image optimization

Schema/structured data where appropriate

Google indexing

Core Web Vitals

Mobile performance

Site speed optimization

Video optimization

Redirects and URL structure during a website migration

Google Analytics and Google Search Console



Our goal is to build a website that doesn't just look beautiful, it needs to perform well in search and convert visitors into ticket buyers, donors, students, and supporters.



Design Direction



We are looking for a site that feels:



Bold

Contemporary

Artistic

Editorial

Cinematic

Visually immersive

Professional without feeling corporate



Large photography and video should play an important role in the experience.



We do not want a generic performing arts template.



The website should feel like an extension of the performances themselves while remaining intuitive and easy to navigate.



Ideal Candidate



You should:



Have a strong portfolio of websites you have personally designed and/or developed

Understand both design and website functionality

Have experience building fast, responsive websites

Understand technical and on-page SEO

Know how to incorporate video without significantly affecting site speed

Understand responsive/mobile design

Be comfortable optimizing images and other media

Be able to recommend the best platform and technical approach for our needs

Communicate clearly and meet agreed-upon deadlines

Be available for revisions, testing, and launch support



Experience with performing arts, entertainment, fashion, museums, galleries, hospitality, luxury, nonprofit organizations, or other highly visual brands is a plus.



How to Apply



Please send:



A link to your portfolio

3 websites you have personally built that best demonstrate your abilities

Which website platform(s) you recommend for this project and why

How you would incorporate multiple videos into a website while keeping the site fast

A brief explanation of your approach to SEO when rebuilding an existing website

Your estimated timeline for a project like this

Your project rate or typical pricing structure

If you could see any ballet, dance performance, concert, or live show in the world, what would you choose?

About the Role



UFA is a Real Estate Investing / Wholesaling business based in New Jersey. We're hiring a detail-oriented Lead Research VA to find motivated-property-owner opportunities and turn raw public/property data into accurate, outreach-ready records for our acquisitions team.



This is a research and data role — you will NOT be negotiating deals or talking sellers into anything. Your job is to find, verify, and organize so our acquisitions caller can have great conversations.



What You'll Do — Find → Research → Verify → Skip Trace → Score → Load into CRM



- Pull 40–60 new property records per day

- Research ownership and confirm mailing/property address

- Identify owner type (individual, LLC, trust, estate, etc.)

- Find owner phone numbers and
 (when available)

- Check estimated property value and estimate mortgage/equity when data is available

- Check sale/foreclosure status when applicable

- Identify obvious liens/auction information from available public records

- Tag property type; flag vacant properties and absentee owners

- Identify potential vacant-land opportunities

- Remove obvious bad leads/duplicates and score each opportunity

- Load qualified leads into our CRM and prepare the next day's calling list



Hours & Schedule



Hours: 4–5 hours/day, Monday–Friday (20–25 hrs/week)

Schedule: Philippine evening / U.S. morning overlap preferred, where needed for handoff to our U.S.-based acquisitions team



Daily Targets



50 raw records pulled → 35 sufficiently researched → 25–30 contactable owners → 20+ high-quality, outreach-ready leads.



What We're Looking For



- Previous experience with U.S. real estate lead/property research

- Skip tracing experience

- Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills

- CRM experience (any major CRM)

- Excellent attention to detail — this role lives or dies on data accuracy

- Basic understanding of ARV (after-repair value) and equity concepts

- Familiarity with county/public property records

- Able to work independently and hit daily numbers without close supervision



Written English is more important than accent for this role — you'll be documenting research clearly, not speaking with sellers.



Compensation



Pay: $4–$6/hour, based on experience

Bonus: Optional performance bonus after closed deals

Payment schedule: Weekly



How to Apply



Please include:

- A short summary of your experience with real estate lead research and skip tracing

- Which CRMs and data/skip-trace tools you've used

- Your available hours (must overlap enough for daily handoff)

- The word "SKIPTRACE" at the top of your application, so we know you read the full post



We will ask finalists to complete a short paid test batch (research + score a small set of sample properties) before hiring.

title: Full-Time Content Operations Manager for Melbourne-Based Digital Marketing Agency
description:
Position Overview

We're a growing Melbourne-based SEO and digital marketing agency hiring an experienced Content Operations Manager to lead our content production across 10 active client accounts.



This is not a junior coordinator role or a full-time writing role. You'll own the workflow end-to-end — keyword assignment, content briefing, writer management, quality assurance, publishing coordination, indexation, and post-publish checks. You'll lead writers, VAs, and publishers, maintain clear deadlines and quality standards, resolve day-to-day blockers, and help improve how our content operation runs.



Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

This isn't "figure it out yourself" work — you'll have access to a world-class SEO system and SOP library, with structured workflows, templates, checklists, and QA standards for every stage of the pipeline. On top of that, you'll get:



-Full-time, long-term remote work

-Direct communication with the agency owner

-Real day-to-day leadership responsibility across writers, VAs, and publishers

-The authority to improve systems and hold the team accountable

-All required tools and access provided from day one

-A formal performance and pay review at 60–90 days

-An ongoing quarterly performance bonus structure — details discussed with the successful candidate

-A genuine path into broader SEO and operations leadership



What You'll Own



Content Planning + Briefs

-Review assigned keywords, existing pages, and project requirements before production begins.

-Confirm whether each task requires new content, a landing page, or an on-page SEO upgrade.

-Build detailed SEO content briefs — search intent, structure, required topics, metadata, internal links, acceptance criteria.

-Flag potentially misclassified work or unclear scope to the agency owner rather than changing it without approval.



Production + Team Leadership

-Assign work to writers, VAs, and publishers with clear owners, deadlines, and acceptance criteria.

-Maintain a visible production pipeline in Asana; monitor progress and resolve or escalate blockers early.

-Give direct, actionable feedback and confirm revisions are completed correctly.

-Coach team members when standards aren't being met; escalate recurring performance issues.

-Create accountability without micromanaging capable team members.



Editorial, SEO + Final QA

-Coordinate first-pass QA, then complete final QA before client review or publishing.

-Check search intent, accuracy, clarity, structure, grammar, and brief adherence.

-Confirm correct title tags, H1s, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and CTAs.

-Enforce retrieval-friendly formatting — direct answers, scannable sections, tables where they genuinely help.

-Use originality and AI-detection tools as quality signals, applying human editorial judgement on top.

-Rewrite small sections when necessary, without becoming the primary writer.



Publishing + Definition of Done

-Prepare clear WordPress handoffs — URLs, metadata, links, schema, images, layout.

-Review staging and live pages for formatting, links, mobile usability, and canonical setup.

-Request indexing in Google Search Console and monitor for issues.

-A deliverable is done when it's published, accessible, quality-checked, internally linked, schema-checked, submitted for indexing, and tracked.



Client Approvals + Reporting

-Consolidate client feedback into one actionable revision request; prevent conflicting instructions and unnecessary cycles.

-Distinguish between corrections, reasonable revisions, and requests that change approved scope — escalate scope changes before assigning more work.

-Report weekly on production volume, completed work, overdue items, blockers, and quality issues.



Workload

You'll manage content operations across 10 active clients, with a baseline of 4–6 deliverables per client each month (40–60 total). Work includes new service/landing pages, supporting SEO content (often ~4,000 words), on-page SEO upgrades, and metadata/internal-linking/schema tasks. You're responsible for pipeline and quality — you won't personally write all deliverables.



What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

-You can independently run the 10-client content pipeline.

-The dashboard accurately reflects status, owner, deadline, and blocker for every deliverable.

-40–60 monthly deliverables move through production without anything lost or forgotten.

-Final QA is consistent and catches issues before publication.

-Client approvals are organised with minimal unnecessary revision cycles.

-Published pages are checked, internally linked, submitted for indexing, and tracked.

-You raise risks before they become missed deadlines and recommend practical system improvements.



Must-Haves

Please apply only if you have:

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Proven experience managing SEO content production in an agency environment

-Experience leading writers, editors, VAs, or publishers

-Previous professional SEO writing or editing experience — you won't write day-to-day, but you need to know what good content looks like to QA it properly

-Strong knowledge of search intent and on-page SEO

-Excellent editorial judgement and attention to detail

-Confidence managing multiple clients, deadlines, and team members

-The ability to give clear feedback and maintain accountability

-Experience following structured systems while improving them

-Reliable internet, a suitable full-time remote setup, and some availability overlapping Australian Eastern Time



Nice-to-Haves

-WordPress publishing and live-page QA

-Google Search Console and indexation workflows

-Schema requirements and validation

-Internal-linking strategy

-Surfer or similar content optimisation tools

-Grammarly and Originality.ai

-ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI-assisted workflows

-Content structured for AI retrieval and answer engines

-Legal, real estate, or healthcare client experience 



Who Will Succeed in This Role

You're likely to succeed if you:

-Take ownership without waiting to be chased

-Communicate problems early

-Can lead a remote team firmly and respectfully

-Notice small errors before clients do

-Understand the difference between activity and completed delivery

-Protect approved scope while keeping work moving

-Balance SEO requirements with reader value and conversion goals

-Stay organised when many deliverables are active at once



This role won't suit someone who wants to focus mainly on writing, needs daily task-by-task supervision, or avoids difficult performance conversations.



Tools We Use

-Asana, Google Drive, WordPress, Google Search Console, Surfer (or equivalent), Grammarly, Originality.ai, ChatGPT, Claude. You don't need experience with every tool if you can demonstrate mastery of the underlying workflow.



Compensation and Working Arrangement

-US$10 per hour to start, full-time, 40 hours/week

-Paid fortnightly or monthly, your preference

-Formal performance and pay review at 60–90 days — increase to US$12/hr based on demonstrated quality, leadership, and pipeline performance

-Quarterly performance bonus structure — details discussed with the successful candidate

-Flexible schedule with agreed AEST overlap

-All required tools and access provided

-Long-term, permanent remote position



How to Apply

Start your application with the words BLUE MANAGER. Applications without this will not be considered.



Then complete our screening form: [
/?k=5DW57EJsxaoBV1F2IRMQ4g&d=
]



We will only review candidates who submit the completed form.



Hiring Process

-Application and screening-form review

-5-minute intro call — communication and fit

-15-minute technical interview — content operations, SEO QA, and team leadership

-Paid practical exercise — realistic agency work, scoped to 60–90 minutes

-Reference checks

-Offer to the successful candidate



This is a permanent, full-time role. We're ready to hire as soon as we find the right person.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Social Media Manager — Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week | Remote
description:
IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH



**Applications submitted through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.**



To apply, follow the instructions at the bottom of this post and
 your application directly to:







---



# PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is a **part-time position averaging approximately 20 hours per week.**



You will be expected to work during the **later portion of our U.S./Arizona business hours** so there is overlap with our team.



Because you will be working from the Philippines, these hours will fall during your evening/nighttime hours.



This is important.



Please only apply if you are comfortable consistently working this schedule.



---



# About the Role



LCS Productions is looking for a creative, organized, and proactive **Social Media Manager** to help grow our company across Instagram and
.



We are a real estate media company with a large library of professionally filmed content including:



* Luxury homes

* Real estate listings

* Realtors

* Agent branding videos

* Events

* Community content

* Photography

* Day-to-night videos

* Behind-the-scenes content



We already have a large amount of professionally produced media.



Your job will be to help us **turn that existing content into consistent, strategic social media posts that grow our audience and generate business.**



We are not looking for someone who simply uploads a Reel and checks a box.



We want someone who thinks about:



**Why would someone stop scrolling?**



**Why would someone watch this?**



**Why would someone follow us?**



**Why would someone share this?**



**How can this content eventually create a lead?**



---



# What You'll Be Responsible For



Your responsibilities may include:



* Managing Instagram and
 content

* Scheduling daily social media posts

* Creating monthly content calendars

* Selecting content from our existing video library

* Identifying older content that can be repurposed

* Cutting or requesting shorter versions of existing videos

* Turning longer videos into 15–30 second Reels

* Selecting strong opening shots

* Writing attention-grabbing hooks

* Adding or recommending on-screen text

* Writing captions

* Creating calls-to-action

* Selecting relevant hashtags

* Writing location-specific content

* Creating and scheduling photo carousels

* Planning Realtor collaboration posts

* Tagging agents and businesses correctly

* Organizing content assets

* Maintaining a posting schedule

* Monitoring comments and engagement

* Responding to basic comments when appropriate

* Identifying messages or leads that need our attention

* Tracking social media performance

* Reviewing which content performs best

* Monitoring follower growth

* Identifying trends and content opportunities

* Reporting results to ownership

* Helping improve future content based on performance



---



# The Main Goal



We don't want our social media pages to simply look like a portfolio of videos we've created.



We want them to become **real estate media channels people actually want to follow.**



That means mixing content such as:



* Beautiful homes

* Luxury properties

* Interesting rooms and features

* Realtors and personalities

* Realtor collaboration posts

* Events

* Local lifestyle content

* Day-to-night transformations

* Photography carousels

* Real estate media education

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Company work

* Social proof



The goal is to attract new followers while also showing Realtors and businesses the quality of work we provide.



---



# What We're Looking For



You should be someone who:



* Understands Instagram and

* Understands short-form video content

* Has strong written English

* Can write natural, conversational captions

* Understands that the first few seconds of a Reel are important

* Has a good eye for visually strong content

* Is organized

* Can manage a content calendar

* Can meet deadlines

* Can work without constant reminders

* Pays attention to details

* Can follow brand guidelines

* Is comfortable learning our style

* Is willing to test different ideas

* Can look at analytics and learn from them

* Is proactive

* Communicates clearly

* Can manage repetitive responsibilities consistently

* Takes feedback well

* Wants to improve over time



We are willing to train the right candidate.



You do not need to walk into this position knowing our exact strategy.



You **do** need to be willing to learn it and consistently execute it.



---



# Skills That Are a Plus



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* Meta Business Suite

* Social media scheduling

* Canva

* CapCut

* Final Cut Pro

* Short-form video editing

* Content calendars

* Copywriting

* Caption writing

* Real estate social media

* Realtor marketing

* Social media analytics

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* ChatGPT or AI content tools



You do not need experience with every program listed above.



Basic video editing skills are a strong plus, especially if you can quickly create shorter social-media cuts from finished videos.



---



# How We Think About Content



A beautiful video by itself is not always enough.



Every post needs a reason for someone to stop.



Instead of simply posting:



**“Check out this beautiful property.”**



We might create an opening such as:



**WAIT FOR THE BACKYARD**



**DAY OR NIGHT?**



**WOULD YOU CHANGE THIS?**



**LOOK AT THIS DETAIL**



**IMAGINE WAKING UP HERE**



The goal is to create curiosity, interaction, emotion, or conversation around the footage.



We want someone who is interested in learning **why content performs**, not simply posting more of it.



---



# You Will Be Expected to Think Ahead



For example:



If we have a beautiful 90-second listing video, don't automatically think of it as one post.



Think:



Could the backyard become its own Reel?



Could the kitchen become another?



Could we create a 15-second version?



Could we create a Realtor collaboration post?



Could the photos become a carousel?



Could the day and night footage become a comparison?



Could we use the property later for another hook?



That's the type of thinking we're looking for.



---



# Content Organization Is Important



We have a large library of content.



Part of this position will involve helping us keep track of:



* What has been posted

* What hasn't been posted

* Which agents were featured

* Which properties were featured

* Which posts performed best

* Which content can be reused

* Which hooks have been tested

* Which posts created followers

* Which posts created inquiries



We want our social media system to become more organized and more effective over time.



---



# Schedule



This position is approximately:



**20 hours per week**



You will be expected to work during the **later portion of our Arizona business day**.



Since this position is based in the Philippines, this will generally mean working during evening/nighttime hours.



You must be comfortable maintaining this schedule consistently.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



## DO NOT APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH



 your application directly to:







Use the subject line:



**SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER APPLICATION – [YOUR NAME]**



Please include:



1. Your resume

2. A short description of your social media experience

3. Links to any social media accounts you have managed

4. Examples of content you've created, if available

5. Confirmation that you can work approximately 20 hours per week

6. Confirmation that you can work during the later portion of Arizona/U.S. business hours

7. A link to your required video application below



---



# REQUIRED VIDEO APPLICATION



Please record a short video of yourself answering the questions below.



You can record it using your phone, webcam, Loom, or another simple recording method.



**We are not judging the production quality of your video.**



We want to learn how you communicate and how you think about social media.



Please answer:



### 1. Why are you interested in working with LCS Productions?



What interested you about this Social Media Manager position?



What are you looking for in your next role?



### 2. Tell us about your social media experience.



What platforms have you managed?



What types of businesses or accounts have you worked with?



What responsibilities did you personally handle?



### 3. Imagine we give you a beautiful 60-second video of a luxury home.



How would you turn that one video into multiple pieces of social media content?



Tell us what you would create and why.



### 4. Tell us about a social media post you've created or managed that performed well.



Why do you think it worked?



What did you learn from it?



If you don't have professional social media experience, choose a social media post you've seen online and explain why you believe it performed well.



### 5. How would you respond if several posts in a row received very low views?



What would you look at?



What would you change?



### 6. Are you comfortable working approximately 20 hours per week during the later portion of U.S./Arizona business hours?



Please explain why this schedule will work for you consistently.



Keep your video approximately **4–6 minutes**.



Upload your video using:



* Google Drive

* Dropbox

* YouTube Unlisted

* Loom

* Or another service where we can easily view it



**Please make sure the viewing permissions allow us to access the video.**



---



# What Happens Next



Applicants who appear to be a strong fit will receive a **short social media test before being invited to interview.**



The test may include:



* Reviewing one of our existing videos

* Creating several hook ideas

* Writing a caption

* Creating a CTA

* Selecting hashtags

* Suggesting how the video could be shortened

* Creating additional content ideas from the same property

* Organizing several posts into a sample schedule



We aren't looking for one exact answer.



We want to see:



**How you think.**



**Whether you understand attention.**



**How creative you are.**



**How carefully you follow instructions.**



**How you communicate.**



**Whether you can turn one piece of content into several opportunities.**



Candidates who successfully complete the test will then be invited to a **camera-on video interview.**



Please be comfortable communicating face-to-face over video.



---



# One Last Thing



We are not looking for someone whose entire strategy is:



**Post more often.**



We already have the content.



We need someone who can help us **use it better.**



Someone who notices what works.



Someone who tests new ideas.



Someone who stays organized.



Someone who understands that a beautiful video still needs a strong reason for someone to watch it.



Someone who can consistently execute a strategy.



And someone who becomes better at the job as they learn more about our company, our clients, and our audience.



If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.



###
 YOUR APPLICATION TO:







**Subject: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER APPLICATION – [YOUR NAME]**

title: Content Writer & Social Media Manager (Dog Niche, Long-Term)
description:
About the role:

We run a large Golden Retriever social media presence with a following in the millions. We are looking for one person to own our written content and help run our social channels as we grow. This is a long-term, full-time role, not a short project.



This role covers both article/blog writing and social media, and you will do both every week. A typical week looks like this:

- Write 3 to 5 articles. Research, draft, fact-check, edit, source images, optimize for SEO, manage affiliate links, and submit for review.

- Keep the social calendar filled a month ahead across
 and Instagram, so posts are scheduled well before they go out



The number of articles matters less than the standard they are held to. We would rather have three excellent posts than five rushed ones, and everything is reviewed before it goes live.



The writing covers Golden Retriever health, training, nutrition, grooming, puppies, gear and product guides, including affiliate content that is genuinely useful first and commercial second: product roundups, comparisons and reviews.



The social work covers:

- Building and maintaining the content calendar

- Turning published articles into posts

- Working with photos and videos submitted by our audience. Sorting through submissions, cleaning up and cropping images, and cutting phone video into short vertical clips with captions and music for Reels and Stories

- Creating simple graphics in Canva from our templates

- Scheduling everything

- Suggesting ideas based on what the audience responds to



Required experience:

These are requirements, not preferences. Please do not apply without them.

- Social media management, including running a content calendar.
 and Instagram specifically. You should have managed accounts, not just posted to them

- Writing web articles, blog posts or SEO content in English. You will need to show samples

- Affiliate marketing inside blog content and social posts. Experience doing both is a significant advantage. Tell us what you have worked on and what results you saw

- Excellent written English. This is the single most important requirement. Your writing will be read by an American audience. If your English is good but not excellent, this is not the right role for you

- Experience with dogs. You should know dogs from real life, not only from research. Experience with Golden Retrievers specifically is a strong plus

- Photo and short-form video editing. You should be able to take a phone photo or clip someone sent in and turn it into a post worth publishing. CapCut, Canva, or whatever tool you prefer

- Comfortable with WordPress

- Able to follow detailed written instructions carefully and consistently



Nice to have:

Rank Math or Yoast

Experience with a large
 page



A few honest notes:

You do not need to be an expert on the breed. You do need to research properly and never invent facts. You may use AI tools to help you write. We have no problem with that. But every draft must be fact-checked and edited by hand before you submit it. We can tell the difference between an edited draft and a copy-paste, and so can readers. This role does not include replying to comments or direct messages.



Working arrangement

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Flexible hours. We care about output and deadlines, not what time you are online

$650 USD per month, paid monthly, plus bonuses based on performance

Long-term. We want someone who stays and grows with this



How to apply:

Read this part carefully. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.

- Put "Golden Sunrise" as the first two words of your application. This is how we know you read the whole post

- Answer these three questions in your own words:

   1. What is one thing you would want to know before buying a puppy from a breeder?

   2. Describe one affiliate article or campaign you have worked on. What was it, and how did it perform?

   3. What tools do you currently use for writing, for social media, and for design?

- Send links or attachments for two writing samples in English. Articles are best. Please do not send anything you did not write yourself

- Send one example of a short video or edited photo you made for social media

- Tell us about your experience with dogs

title: Financial Controller with Ecommerce Experience
description:
About the Role



We are building an in-house finance function with an offshore team based in the Philippines and

are seeking an experienced Financial Controller to lead the finance function remotely. This is a

pivotal role responsible for overseeing all aspects of financial management, reporting, budgeting,

cashflow, and strategic financial analysis, as well as directly managing the company Bookkeeper.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Directors in Sydney to drive financial

performance and support business growth, with hours aligned to Australian Eastern Time. This is

a hands-on role ideal for someone with strong Xero skills, solid accounting fundamentals, and

experience in Australian businesses operating globally.



Key Responsibilities

Team Management

• Directly manage and mentor the in-house Bookkeeper, providing day-to-day guidance and

oversight

• Review and approve work prepared by the Bookkeeper including reconciliations, payroll, AP

batches, and Cin7 Omni updates

• Set priorities, manage workload, and ensure all finance team deadlines are consistently met

• Support the onboarding and ongoing development of the Bookkeeper

Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Prepare and deliver monthly management accounts including qualitative commentary and

analysis

• Manage and maintain the Fathom reporting platform showing variances between actual

results versus budget and last year and produce insightful financial dashboards

• Conduct balance sheet reconciliations on a monthly basis, including but not limited to,

PayPal, Shopify, Stripe and Afterpay clearing and receivable accounts and Cin-7 detailed

inventory ledger with inventory control account in Xero.

• Oversee quality control between the inventory system and the accounting system

• Liaise with external accountants for year-end compliance and tax return preparation



Budgeting & Forecasting

• Prepare the annual budget (simple version) based on prior year actuals with applied growth

rates

• Monitor, maintain, and roll forward the budget on a quarterly basis, replacing completed

months’ results with actual results

• Analyse variances between actual results and budget, and provide insights and

recommendations

• Prepare and manage the operational cashflow, aligning cash inflows and forecast outflows

Accounts Payable & Payroll Oversight

• Oversee accounts payable processes including bill entry, aged payables reporting, and

batch payment preparation (ABA files)

• Manage the AP system (e.g. Hubdoc, Lightyear) and ensure data integrity

• Prepare and approve fortnightly payroll processing and superannuation obligations

• Manage STP (Single Touch Payroll) fortnightly lodgements and year-end finalisation

• Coordinate annual Workers Compensation renewal and annual wages declaration

Systems & Compliance

• Manage Xero including integrations with all bank accounts, Cin7 Omni and payment

gateway systems

• Oversee syncing between Cin7 Omni and Xero regularly to identify any errors and resolve

discrepancies promptly

• Ensure compliance with GST, BAS, IAS, Payroll tax and other statutory obligations (in

coordination with external tax agent)

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records and documentation

Key Requirements

• CPA or CA qualified (or working towards)

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a Financial Controller or senior accounting role

• Experience supporting Australian businesses (understanding of GST, BAS, STP, and

superannuation obligations)

• Strong Xero experience is essential - Xero certification highly regarded

• Proficiency with reporting tools such as Fathom with the ability to build and modify financial

reports, as required

• Demonstrated experience working with consumer products and e-commerce businesses is

essential

• Demonstrated experience working within a global business with foreign currency reporting

and FX transactions as well as the ability to consolidate results of multiple entities

• Hands-on experience with inventory management systems; experience with Cin7 Omni is

highly desirable

• Strong understanding of Australian payroll legislation and STP obligations

• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

• Reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup

• High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities independently

• Prior experience in effectively managing and overseeing performance of all direct reports



What We Offer



• Competitive salary package commensurate with experience

• Full-time, stable remote role with an established Australian business

• Opportunity to build and lead the in-house finance function from the ground up

• Direct exposure to business strategy and senior leadership

• Collaborative and supportive team environment

• Work-from-home flexibility with consistent Australian business hours

title: Client Success Manager
description:
About Us

At ProfitWorks, we genuinely believe that our people are the heart of everything we do. We’ve focused on building a workplace that feels less like a corporate machine and more like a community, creating a space where you’re supported, heard, and actually excited to grow. We aren't big on empty promises and prefer to let our history speak for itself. We’re incredibly proud that two of our tea
mbers have been with our founder for 13 years, while many others are nearing their 6th anniversary. It’s a steady, welcoming environment where people don’t just pass through, they stay and thrive.



At ProfitWorks, we make sure our contractors can focus on what they do best by providing the security, support, and balance you deserve. To back that up, we offer a generous package including 80–120 hours of PTO, 7 paid holidays, 13th-month payroll, and life insurance up to ?100,000. Your well-being is a top priority, so we cover a paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan, your Annual Physical Exam (APE), mental health consultation reimbursements (up to ?20,000/year), and SSS, PhilHealth, or Pag-IBIG reimbursements.



Beyond financial and health security, we invest directly in your career through a comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program, clear performance goals with advancement compensation, and opportunities for advancement after proof of mastery. If you’re looking for a team that prioritizes real connections, long-term stability, and continuous support, we’d love to hear from you. Come say hi and see if ProfitWorks is the right fit for you!



Role Overview



The Client Success Manager (CSM) serves as a vital strategic pillar bridging client relationship management, end-to-end talent acquisition, and operational service delivery. Working in close alignment with the CEO, the CSM translates company vision into actionable operational and growth strategies. The CSM takes full accountability for managing the entire client lifecycle—from identifying high-value prospects, conducting initial discovery calls, and crafting tailored proposals, to overseeing offshore candidate screening, recruitment, and seamless onboarding.  



Beyond initial integration, the CSM acts as the primary client liaison, proactively managing client concerns, leading cross-functional teams (including Recruitment, HR, and Operations), and enforcing service quality through continuous performance monitoring, daily End-of-Shift reporting, and KPI tracking. By combining strategic workforce planning with hands-on process optimization, the CSM ensures exceptional service delivery, drives long-term client retention, and unlocks sustainable account growth across ProfitWorks' accounting and staffing solutions. 





Key Responsibilities



1. Client Engagement, Relationship & Account Growth

Lead discovery calls and business development conversations with prospects to understand hiring, accounting, and operational requirements.

Manage the full client journey, acting as the primary point of contact for all client inquiries, feedback, and strategic account planning.

Foster long-term relationships and drive client retention through proactive communication, regular workforce alignment, and exceptional service delivery.

Support proposal development, agreement management, and account expansion opportunities with existing U.S. clients.



2. End-to-End Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

Partner directly with clients to define staffing needs, draft custom job profiles, and establish recruitment timelines.

Oversee recruitment and candidate screening workflows alongside internal sourcing teams to match top-tier offshore talent to client requirements.

Facilitate seamless onboarding, system integration, and task handoffs between clients and placed offshore contractors.



3. Performance Monitoring, Quality Assurance & Operations

Establish, track, and analyze client and team KPIs, daily reports, and End-of-Shift summaries to evaluate performance.

Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, performance gaps, or service friction points, delivering data-driven solutions and process improvements.

Utilize project management tools (e.g., ClickUp, HubStaff, Time Doctor) to manage workload distribution, task execution, and team productivity.



4. Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Coordination

Collaborate closely across internal units—including Recruitment, HR, Operations, and Virtual Support teams—to ensure complete alignment with client expectations.

Lead internal syncs and alignment meetings to streamline communication, share feedback, and resolve challenges.

Provide coaching, support, and guidance to tea
mbers to maintain high service quality and continuous professional growth.





What We’re Looking For



Experience & Expertise

Experience: 3–5+ years in Account Management, Client Success, Operations Management, or offshore talent delivery.

U.S. Market Experience: Demonstrated background working directly with U.S.-based business owners, executives, or offshore staffing models.

Domain Context: Prior exposure to accounting/finance, construction, home services, mortgage, or non-tech client services is a strong advantage.



Skills & Tool Proficiency



Project & Ops Management: Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Time Doctor, Google Workspace, and MS Office.

Recruitment & Sourcing: Solid grasp of end-to-end recruitment pipelines, candidate screening, and workforce planning.

Communication: Superior written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence leading client presentations and discovery calls.

Strategic & Critical Thinking: Able to analyze complex client requirements, design scalable operational frameworks, and resolve problems independently.



Why You Will Love Working Here

Supportive Team & Mentorship: Work alongside a collaborative, growth-oriented team with clear guidance from implementation leadership.

Continuous Learning: Deepen your expertise daily with cutting-edge AI tools, automation platforms, and complex integration projects.

Career Growth: Real opportunity to progressively step into larger implementation, governance, and systems responsibilities over time.

Flexible Remote Work: 100% remote setup within a highly collaborative US-Philippines hybrid working environment.

Real Impact: Your work directly dictates how efficiently and successfully our business scales.



Perks: 

80-120 Hours of PTO 

 7 Paid Holidays 

 13th Month Payroll 

 Life insurance of up to Php100,000

 Paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan 

 Paid Annual Physical Exam (APE)

 Mental Health Consultation Reimbursement up to ?20,000/year (capped at ?2,000 per session for up to 10 sessions)

 Social Security System Reimbursement

 PhilHealth or PagIbig Reimbursement

Comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program 

Advancement after Proof of Mastery 

Performance Goals with advancement compensation 





We can’t wait to meet you and discover the value you’ll bring to our team! If this sounds like a role you’re excited about, apply now and help us continue building a workplace we all love.

title: Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist
description:
Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist



Remote — Philippines | Lyons Cards LLC



ABOUT LYONS CARDS



Lyons Cards LLC is a fast-growing, family-owned sports-card and live-commerce company based in St. Louis, Missouri.



We are building a modern sports-card business around:



* Live breaks

* Premium singles

* PSA/BGS/SGC graded cards

* Sealed sports-card products

* Repacks

* Shopify / 

* Whatnot live commerce

* Online marketplace sales

* Customer engagement

* Strategic inventory management



Our primary sports are football and basketball, with select baseball inventory.



We are looking for a highly capable Philippines-based team member who can help us turn inventory into revenue while keeping our online listings, customer inquiries and card inventory organized.



⸻



POSITION



Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist



This is not simply a data-entry job.



This person will help Lyons Cards with:



CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT + SALES + INVENTORY + LISTINGS + MARKETPLACE SUPPORT



The ideal person is extremely organized, fast, commercially minded, comfortable learning new software, and able to communicate with U.S. customers at a very high level.



⸻



ENGLISH REQUIREMENT — C2 MASTERY



C2-level English mastery is required.



You must be able to:



* Write naturally to U.S. customers

* Understand casual American English and slang

* Respond professionally without sounding scripted

* Handle negotiations

* Understand detailed instructions

* Recognize when a customer is serious versus simply asking questions

* Escalate unusual situations clearly

* Communicate confidently with management



Your written English should be nearly indistinguishable from that of a highly proficient native-level business communicator.



Please do not apply if your English level is below C2/near-native professional proficiency.



⸻



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CUSTOMER / MARKETPLACE SALES SUPPORT



Monitor and respond to customer inquiries across approved Lyons Cards channels.



These may include:



* 
 / Shopify

*

* Whatnot

* eBay

* Other approved marketplace channels

* Customer

* Social comments and direct messages



Responsibilities include:



* Answering product questions

* Responding to comments

* Responding to pricing inquiries

* Handling offers

* Following up with interested customers

* Helping convert inquiries into sales

* Providing basic shipping/order information

* Maintaining a professional Lyons Cards voice



The objective is not simply to answer messages.



The objective is to help produce sales.



⸻



2. OFFER / NEGOTIATION MANAGEMENT



Lyons Cards will establish pricing and negotiation guidelines.



You will be expected to:



* Know the current asking price

* Understand approved negotiation ranges

* Respond to reasonable offers

* Recognize serious buyers

* Avoid unnecessarily discounting inventory

* Escalate offers that fall outside your approved authority



Example:



If a card is listed at $500 and an offer falls within an approved range, you may be authorized to continue the negotiation.



If an offer falls below the approved range or involves an important card, immediately send the offer to Connor Lyons for a decision.



Do not guess.



Do not make unauthorized discounts.



⸻



3. CARD INVENTORY INTAKE



A major responsibility will be helping Lyons Cards rapidly load inventory into Card Dealer Pro, our inventory management system.



We are intentionally simplifying this process.



The goal is:



GET THE CARD INTO THE SYSTEM QUICKLY AND ACCURATELY.



You may receive batches of card photographs from Connor or another Lyons Cards team member.



Example:



Connor sends you 20–50 card photographs and basic instructions.



You then create/import the batch and make sure those cards are properly entered into inventory.



⸻



4. TWO PRIMARY INVENTORY BATCHES



Inventory will generally begin in two major categories:



GRADED / SLABS



Examples:



* PSA

* BGS / Beckett

* SGC

* Other approved grading companies



Important information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Grading company

* Grade

* Certification number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Selling price

* Status



RAW CARDS



Raw cards are cards that have not been professionally graded.



Information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Selling price

* Status



We do NOT want unnecessary data entry that slows down the operation.



Accuracy and speed are both important.



⸻



5. INVENTORY STATUS / USE



Cards may be assigned different jobs inside the company.



Examples:



AVAILABLE

Normal inventory available to sell.



HOLD

Do not sell without management approval.



REPACK

Reserved or considered for Lyons Cards repack products.



GRADE

Raw card intended for professional grading.



REVIEW

Management decision required.



You must make sure special inventory is not a
 sold.



⸻



6. PRICING SUPPORT



Market value — not historical purchase cost — drives our selling decisions.



Management will establish pricing using current card-market information and revenue-management principles.



You may be given a price directly by Connor or management.



Example:



Connor sends:



Card photos + $349 list price + AVAILABLE



Your responsibility is to enter the cards correctly and make sure the correct selling price/status appears in the system.



As you develop, you may assist with basic market research and comparable sales.



Final pricing authority remains with Lyons Cards management unless otherwise delegated.



⸻



7. SHOPIFY / E-COMMERCE SUPPORT



Card Dealer Pro is the primary inventory system.



Shopify / 
 is the consumer storefront.



You may help:



* Review products before they go live

* Verify images

* Verify titles

* Verify pricing

* Confirm availability

* Correct listing errors

* Organize collections

* Monitor customer inquiries

* Identify products that need updated pricing

* Ensure sold inventory is properly handled across channels



You should become comfortable working inside modern e-commerce software.



⸻



8. WHATNOT / LIVE-COMMERCE SUPPORT



Lyons Cards is building a significant live-commerce business on Whatnot.



You may assist with:



* Show listings

* Product setup

* Customer messages

* Auction preparation

* Post-show order review

* Buyer questions

* Sales follow-up

* Analytics

* Inventory reconciliation



You will not automatically be responsible for hosting shows.



Your job is to help the hosts and management operate efficiently behind the scenes.



⸻



9. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE



Lyons Cards is built around a simple principle:



WE ARE NOT TRYING TO WIN ONE TRANSACTION.



WE ARE TRYING TO WIN THE CUSTOMER.



We expect:



* Fast responses

* Professional communication

* Honest descriptions

* No misleading claims

* No aggressive pressure

* No unauthorized discounts

* Strong follow-up

* Respect for collectors

* Immediate escalation when something appears wrong



Customers should feel that Lyons Cards is organized, responsive and trustworthy.



⸻



10. SOFTWARE / SYSTEMS



You should be comfortable learning and using systems such as:



* Card Dealer Pro

* Shopify

* Whatnot Seller Hub

* eBay

* Google Sheets

* Google Drive

*

* Messaging platforms

* Basic image/file management

* Marketplace dashboards



Training will be provided on Lyons Cards-specific processes.



You must be comfortable learning technology quickly.



⸻



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* C2 / near-native English proficiency — REQUIRED

* Excellent written communication

* Strong attention to detail

* Fast computer skills

* Comfortable working with large numbers of images/files

* Strong organizational ability

* Reliable internet connection

* Ability to follow pricing/negotiation rules

* Strong judgment

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to recognize when management approval is required

* Comfortable learning new software

* Reliable and responsive

* Commercial/sales mindset



⸻



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



* Sports cards

* Trading cards

* Whatnot

* eBay

* Shopify

* Online selling

* Marketplace customer service

* Sales negotiation

* Inventory management

* PSA/BGS/SGC cards

* Sports knowledge

* E-commerce

* Live commerce



Sports-card expertise is preferred but not mandatory if you are highly intelligent, commercially minded and able to learn quickly.



⸻



IMPORTANT PERSONALITY TRAITS



We want someone who is:



* Fast

* Accurate

* Resourceful

* Commercially minded

* Calm under pressure

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable asking questions

* Not afraid to make decisions within established authority

* Able to recognize when NOT to make a decision

* Interested in becoming an important member of a growing company



We do not want someone who simply waits for instructions all day.



⸻



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



This role will eventually be measured on things such as:



* Response time

* Customer inquiries handled

* Sales conversions

* Offers converted into sales

* Inventory entered per hour

* Listing accuracy

* Inventory errors

* Pricing/listing errors

* Customer satisfaction

* Speed of inventory activation

* Marketplace follow-up

* Revenue supported



The ultimate goal is:



GET INVENTORY ACTIVE → GET IT IN FRONT OF CUSTOMERS → HELP TURN IT INTO REVENUE.



⸻



WORKING WITH MANAGEMENT



You will work closely with:



Connor Lyons

Owner / Operator / Product & Card Lead



Connor will provide card/product knowledge, pricing guidance and decisions on offers requiring approval.



You will also work with Lyons Cards management, operations, social-media and website personnel.



Clear communication is critical.



When escalating something, do not simply say:



“Customer has a question.”



Instead say:



Card: [exact card]

Listed Price: $___

Customer Offer: $___

Relevant information: ___

Decision Needed: Accept / Counter / Decline



Management should be able to understand the situation immediately.



⸻



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This role is being created while Lyons Cards is building its operating platform.



A strong performer may grow into responsibility for:



* Marketplace sales

* E-commerce management

* Inventory operations

* Pricing support

* Sales management

* Customer service leadership

* Live-commerce administration

* Marketplace analytics

* Team supervision



We want someone who can grow with the business.



⸻



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit.

2. Your English proficiency level.

3. Previous experience with online selling, Shopify, eBay, marketplaces or customer service.

4. Any experience with sports cards or collectibles.

5. Your available working hours in Philippine time.

6. Your computer/internet setup.

7. Your expected hourly/monthly compensation.

8. Answer this scenario:

title: Customer Success Specialist for US eBay/Poshmark Software Company (Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
SCHEDULE: Fixed shift covering 2pm-10pm US Eastern (2am-10am Philippine time). Hours may adjust somewhat as we figure out the best coverage, so you need to be flexible on schedule. Only apply if you can work these kinds of hours consistently.



Hi, I'm Bennett, founder of Dropanion. We build software that helps people run online reselling businesses on eBay, Poshmark, and other marketplaces. We're a small US company scaling fast, and I'm hiring one person to own customer success.



This is not a typical customer support job, so read this part carefully. Our customers aren't just users of a tool, they're people building real businesses. When they message us, they're asking things like "how many products should I list?" or "why isn't this getting sales?" To answer them, you need to actually understand the business model, not just the software. Your job is to become a genuine expert in eBay dropshipping, Poshmark, and how our software automates it. We'll train you with our full course, the same one our customers learn from, and you'll know the model inside and out before you ever answer a question alone. And the learning never stops: we're always expanding to new marketplaces and shipping new features, so you'll be picking up new platforms and new tools as we grow. If you're someone who gets bored once you've "learned the job," this isn't for you. If constantly learning new things sounds exciting, you'll love it here.



The other thing that makes this role different: we run an AI system that drafts most replies for you. You review what it wrote, fix anything that's off, and make the final call before it goes out. You'll be working with AI every single day and getting better at it than almost anyone in support roles right now.



One more thing that matters a lot to me: I'm hiring for the long term. I want someone who wants to grow with the company, gets better every month, and takes initiative to get things done without waiting to be told. Do this role well and there's a real path into bigger roles as we scale. If you're looking for a short gig between clients, this isn't it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Learn our software and the eBay/Poshmark dropshipping business model deeply (full training provided)

- Review, edit, and send AI-drafted replies to customer
s, texts, and WhatsApp messages

- Answer questions in our 
 community and make sure no customer question goes unanswered

- Help new customers get set up and moving in their first week

- Process refunds and cancellations using our automated flows, and try to save customers who want to leave

- Escalate anything unusual to me directly



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent natural written English and fluent spoken English. This is the number one requirement. You'll be writing to customers all day and talking with me directly, so your English needs to be genuinely strong, not just passable.

- Able to work the 2pm-10pm US Eastern shift (2am-10am Philippine time), with flexibility if hours need to adjust

- Sharp and self-driven: you can make judgment calls, learn a business model, and figure things out

- In it for the long term: you want to keep learning as we add new marketplaces and features, take on more, and grow into bigger roles here

- Comfortable using AI tools daily, or hungry to learn fast



NICE TO HAVE

- Customer support or customer success experience, especially SaaS or ecommerce

- Experience with eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, or online reselling

- Experience with 
 communities



Experience helps, but I care just as much about qualification and drive. If you're smart, hungry, and your English is excellent, apply even if your background isn't traditional support.



PAY AND SETUP

$800-1,200/month depending on experience and qualifications, paid twice monthly. Paid time off after your first 90 days. Long-term stable role, one company, room to grow as we scale.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word LIGHTHOUSE so I know you read the whole post. Then answer these:



1. What companies have you worked for, and what exactly did you do at each one? Be specific about your day-to-day, not just your title.

2. What do you know about eBay dropshipping or online reselling, if anything? It's fine if the answer is nothing, just be honest.

3. Have you used AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude? Tell me how you've actually used them.

4. Confirm you can work 2am-10am Philippine time as your regular shift (with some flexibility if hours adjust), and tell me where you want to be a year from now.



Applications that skip the word or the questions won't be read.
