Send your application to: 



Join us in building a team that treats every client file with care, precision, and integrity.

title: Video Lighting + DJI Osmo Consultant
description:
I am looking for an experienced video lighting and camera consultant to help me create a specific visual look for social media videos that I will be filming myself.



This is not a social media management position, and I am not looking for someone to create or manage my content.



I am specifically hiring someone for their technical and creative expertise to help me build the right filming setup, perfect my DJI Osmo settings, select the appropriate lighting, and teach me how to consistently recreate the look on my own.



The Look I Want to Achieve



My two primary visual references are:



Matthias Barker

Sabrina Zohar



I love the dark, warm, intimate, cinematic quality of their video content.



Rather than simply copying a preset or LUT, I want someone who understands cinematography and lighting well enough to look at reference videos from these creators and help me reverse-engineer what is creating that aesthetic.



The finished look should feel:



Dark and moody

Warm

Cinematic

Intimate

Sophisticated and elevated

High contrast without looking underexposed

Flattering to skin tones

Professional without looking overly produced

More editorial or documentary-style than traditional bright social media content

What I Am Hiring You to Do



I want to work with someone who can help me design and perfect my filming environment from the ground up.



That includes helping me determine:



DJI Osmo setup



Best resolution and frame rate

Shutter speed

ISO

Exposure

White balance

Color profile

Whether to use D-Log M

Whether ND filters are useful for my setup

Autofocus and other relevant settings

How to save or document settings so I can reproduce them consistently



Lighting



Key light selection and placement

Light angle and height

Intensity

Diffusion and softness

Fill versus negative fill

Whether I need a rim or hair light

Practical/background lighting

Color temperature

Controlling ambient light

Creating intentional shadows and contrast

Subject-to-background distance

Background exposure and depth



Equipment

I would like specific recommendations for any equipment I need to purchase, including lights, modifiers, stands, diffusion, negative fill, practical lights, ND filters, or other accessories.



I do not want an unnecessarily complicated studio. I want a repeatable setup that gives me a sophisticated result without requiring a production crew every time I film.



Composition and environment



Camera placement

Camera height and angle

Distance from camera

Framing

Lens/FOV choices available with the Osmo

Where I should sit or stand

Background design and depth

Placement of lamps or other practical lighting



Post-production guidance

I would also like guidance on how much of this look should be achieved in-camera versus through color correction or grading, including recommendations for maintaining a consistent look after filming.



The End Goal



At the end of the consultation, I want to be able to walk into my filming space, turn everything on, place the camera in the correct position, use predetermined settings, and consistently create videos that have the dark, warm, cinematic aesthetic I am looking for.



I am happy to pay someone for their expertise in helping me get this exactly right.



I do not need you to manage my social media, develop a content strategy, write scripts, post content, or become my ongoing videographer.



Think of this more as helping me build and dial in my personal content studio and teaching me how to use it.



Ideal Consultant



You would be a strong fit if you:



Have significant experience with DJI Osmo cameras

Understand manual camera settings and exposure

Have strong expertise in cinematic lighting

Can analyze reference videos and reverse-engineer how they were likely shot and lit

Understand negative fill, lighting ratios, diffusion, practical lighting, and creating depth

Understand color profiles and basic color grading

Can recommend equipment based on what is actually necessary rather than simply recommending more gear

Are comfortable teaching someone how to reproduce the setup independently



When responding, please send me examples of video work you have personally shot or lit, particularly work with a dark, warm, moody, cinematic, or editorial aesthetic.



Please also briefly describe your experience with DJI Osmo cameras and lighting design.  I can be reached here or at 
.

title: Junior Creative Strategist for Meta Ads | Retainer + % on Winning Ads + Equity Opportunity!
description:
We are not looking for someone who can generate 50 generic AI hooks.



We are looking for someone who can find the one idea strong enough to carry an entire ad campaign.



We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands and are looking for a Junior Creative Strategist who understands direct-response marketing, persuasive copywriting, and the importance of deep manual research.



This is an ongoing position with a fixed retainer, performance bonuses, and significant long-term growth potential. Exceptional performers may eventually have the opportunity to become a Creative Director, lead a brand, or participate in the ownership of one of our brands.



THE ROLE



Your job will be to research, develop, and manage new advertising concepts for
 and Instagram.



We believe that approximately 80% of creative strategy is research and 20% is execution. If the underlying concept is strong enough, most of the difficult work has already been done.



Your research may include:



* Successful competitor advertisements

* Viral organic videos

* TikTok and Instagram content

* Reddit posts and personal stories

* Customer reviews and comments

* Forums and online communities

* Emotional stories, frustrations, desires, and transformations

* Anything else that reveals what genuinely moves a particular audience



AI can assist with organizing information, but it cannot replace genuine manual research. We need someone willing to do the detailed and sometimes repetitive work required to uncover exceptional ideas.



YOUR WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES



Each week, you will:



1. Research and present approximately 20-25 strong advertising concepts.



2. Clearly explain the following for every concept:



* The target customer or avatar

* The central problem, desire, or emotion

* The relevant product USP

* The proposed advertising angle

* The source or inspiration

* Why you believe the concept could perform



3. Receive feedback on which concepts are approved or rejected.



4. Turn approximately 10-15 approved concepts into production-ready creative batches.



5. Write complete direct-response scripts for the approved concepts.



6. Provide strong hooks, reference clips, context, and clear instructions for our video editors.



7. Follow up with the editors and ensure that all assigned creatives are completed on time.



Our editors will handle the actual video production. Your responsibility is the idea, angle, research, copy, script, creative direction, and timely handoff.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Have experience writing scripts for Meta/Facebook advertisements

* Understand direct-response copywriting

* Know how to research audiences deeply

* Understand why different customer avatars respond to different USPs

* Be able to identify emotional stories and turn them into advertising concepts

* Understand hooks, awareness levels, objections, desires, and buying motivations

* Be comfortable creating bold, high-conviction marketing angles

* Know how to use strong and specific claims when they can be properly supported

* Understand that generic and overly safe advertising rarely wins competitive
 auctions

* Be highly organized and dependable with deadlines

* Be able to communicate clearly with video editors

* Have excellent written English

* Be open to direct feedback and frequent testing



You do not need ten years of experience. However, you must demonstrate strong research instincts, persuasive writing ability, and a genuine understanding of direct-response marketing.



This is not primarily a graphic design, video editing, or media buying position. It is a research, copywriting, and creative strategy position.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



The compensation structure includes:



* A fixed ongoing retainer

* An additional bonus based on the advertising spend generated by your creatives

* Access to our internal spend-tracking system



Our tracking system allows strategists to see exactly how much advertising spend their creatives generate. You will be able to monitor your results and corresponding bonus in real time.



For the right person, this can become much more than a standard freelance position.



Strong long-term performers may receive:



* Increased responsibility

* Higher compensation

* Creative Director opportunities

* The opportunity to lead a brand

* Potential equity or partial ownership opportunities under a separate agreement



INITIAL TRIAL



The position will begin with a paid two-week trial.



During the trial, we will primarily evaluate:



* The quality and depth of your research

* Your ability to identify promising concepts

* Your understanding of different avatars and USPs

* Your direct-response writing

* Your ability to turn research into clear, production-ready scripts

* Your reliability and communication



If the trial is successful, we would like to continue working together on an ongoing basis.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your proposal with the words “RESEARCH FIRST” so we know you read the complete job post.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have with direct-response advertising and Meta ad scripts?



2. Please share examples of scripts, concepts, or advertisements you have worked on. Include results where possible.



3. How do you normally research new advertising concepts?



4. Tell us about one advertising concept you discovered through manual research and explain why you believed it could work.



5. How do you determine which USP to use for a specific customer avatar?



6. What is your availability, and what fixed monthly retainer would you expect?



We are looking for someone ambitious who wants to become an exceptional creative strategist, not someone looking to complete only the minimum number of assigned tasks.

title: # Executive Assistant (Full-Time) — Remote
description:
# Executive Assistant (Full-Time) — Remote

-



## Who You're Working For



Dr. Z (Sajad Zalzala, MD) is a physician, health entrepreneur, and founder of several companies in the health optimization space. His primary focus right now is building **Optional Aging (OAA)** — a longevity health optimization platform. He also runs Root Causes Consulting (MCAS/chronic illness), serves as fractional Medical Director for SkinnyRx, and has consulting interests across a handful of other health ventures.. On top of that he's navigating ongoing medical licensing matters and managing a team of contractors.



In short: he's stretched thin. You exist to buy back his time so he can focus on the work that only he can do.



---



## What You'll Actually Do



### 1. Inbox & Communication Triage (daily)



Dr. Z manages multiple
 accounts (Gmail, Superhuman) and messaging channels (Slack, WhatsApp). You'll be his first line of defense.



- **Triage incoming
** across accounts — flag what needs his eyes, handle what doesn't, draft responses for his approval

- **Manage Slack** — monitor channels, flag important threads, respond to routine messages in his voice

- **Handle WhatsApp** — coordinate with clients, team members, and vendors; keep personal boundaries clear

- **Draft and send routine correspondence** — follow-ups, confirmations, thank-yous, scheduling notes

- **Maintain a zero-inbox discipline** using his preferred triage system



### 2. Calendar & Schedule Management (daily)



Dr. Z has recurring meetings, one-off consultations, legal deadlines, and a constant tug-of-war on his time. You protect it.



- **Manage Google Calendar** across all accounts — schedule, reschedule, cancel with clear rationale

- **Protect focus blocks** — no meetings during deep work hours unless pre-approved

- **Schedule OAA consultations** via SavvyCal/Calendly — ensure prospects are pre-qualified before they get his time

- **Prepare daily briefing** — what's happening today, who he's meeting, prep materials needed

- **Handle timezone coordination** across US, PH, and teams in other timezones



### 3. OAA Operations Support (weekly)



OAA is the flagship project. You're not building it, but you keep the engine running so he can build.



- **Manage Skool community** — onboard new members, respond to basic inquiries, escalate when needed

- **Track consultation pipeline** — who's booked, who showed, who converted, who went cold

- **Coordinate with the funnel implementer** — make sure landing pages, ads, and
 sequences are on track

- **Compile weekly OAA metrics** — ad performance, lead volume, conversion rate (he needs this for BrigEight/Burhaan calls)

- **GHL (GoHighLevel) admin** — update contacts, trigger workflows, basic automation checks



### 4. Vendor & Contractor Coordination (ongoing)



Dr. Z has a growing network of contractors and partners. Someone needs to keep the trains running.



- **Liaise with an existing part-time  medical VA on clinical admin tasks as needed

- **Coordinate with the funnel implementer** — track deliverables, flag delays

- **Track outstanding invoices and payments** — follow up on receivables

- **Research and vet new vendors** — tools, freelancers, agencies



### 5. Research & Documentation (as needed)



- **Competitive research** — what are other longevity/health optimization platforms doing? Summarize findings

- **Template creation** — build and maintain response templates for common inbox scenarios

- **SOP documentation** — document recurring processes so they're repeatable, not dependent on memory

- **Obsidian vault maintenance** — help organize notes, links, and references in Dr. Z's second brain



### 6. Personal & Travel Support (occasional)



- **Coordinate travel** — flights, hotels, ground transport (Hajj-level trips, conferences, etc.)

- **Track personal errands** — insurance reviews, vendor quotes, family logistics

- **Bill pay tracking** — monitor recurring subscriptions, flag unwanted charges



### 7. Legal & Licensing Admin (ongoing support)



This is sensitive work. You won't make decisions, but you'll track and remind.



- **Track license renewal deadlines** across multiple states  — maintain a renewal calendar

- **Organize supporting documents** for board applications and renewals

- **Monitor legal and financing case** — track where documents have been submitted, what's still pending

- **Maintain a compliance checklist** — CME hours completed, forms filed, deadlines met



---



## Who You Are (as a Candidate)



- You're highly organized and proactive — you don't wait to be told what to do

- You're fluent in written English (professional, clear tone)

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and can figure things out

- You're trustworthy with sensitive information (medical, financial, legal)

- You have reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup connection plan

- Experience with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs) is non-negotiable

- Bonus: experience with Slack, WhatsApp Business, GoHighLevel, Notion, or Obsidian



---



## Tools You'll Use



- **Gmail / Superhuman** —
 management via delegated access (no password sharing)

- **Google Calendar** — shared with edit permissions

- **Slack** — team communication

- **WhatsApp** — client and team messaging

- **GoHighLevel** — CRM and automation (basic usage)

- **Skool** — community platform

- **Google Docs / Sheets** — documentation and tracking

- **Obsidian** — knowledge management / second brain (basic reading/light editing)



---



## What Success Looks Like After 30 Days



- Inboxes are triaged daily; nothing older than 48 hours goes unaddressed

- Weekly to-do lists are properly managed

- Calendar is conflict-free and focus blocks are protected

- You can independently draft 80% of routine correspondence

- You know the key players and their roles

- You're proactively flagging things before they become urgent



---



## Why Work With Dr. Z



- You'll be a core operator in a fast-growing health optimization company, not a cog in a machine

- Direct mentorship from a physician-entrepreneur who values good operators

- Stable, long-term role with growth potential as OAA scales

- Work from home, flexible hours within the timezone overlap

- You'll learn a ton about health optimization, AI tooling, and digital business operations

title: Full-Time Meta Media Buyer for E-Commerce | Retainer + Performance Bonus
description:
We do not need a media buyer who hides behind complicated campaign structures.



We need someone who can look at the numbers, understand exactly what is happening, and make the correct decision quickly.



We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands across multiple niches. We are looking for an experienced Meta Media Buyer to take full-time responsibility for the performance and scaling of our advertising accounts.



This is a long-term position for an individual, not an agency. It should be your primary full-time role rather than one of many small client accounts.



HOW OUR SYSTEM WORKS



We use a straightforward campaign structure:



* ABO campaigns for testing

* CBO campaigns for scaling

* Automated creative launches

* Clear KPI targets and decision-making rules

* Approximately 100 new creatives tested across our brands each week



Our infrastructure and launch systems are already built.



Your value will come from reading the data, monitoring the accounts, identifying problems, making fast decisions, and scaling spend while maintaining the required KPIs.



We are not looking for someone who constantly introduces unnecessary campaign structures. We want someone who understands that excellent media buying comes down to disciplined execution, accurate data interpretation, and consistent account management.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



* Monitor all Meta advertising accounts daily

* Oversee multiple brands across different e-commerce niches

* Make sure automated launches run correctly

* Identify delivery, tracking, spending, or campaign issues quickly

* Evaluate new creatives inside our ABO testing structure

* Move proven winners into CBO scaling campaigns

* Increase or decrease budgets according to defined KPI targets

* Scale winning campaigns while protecting overall profitability

* Stop losing campaigns before they waste unnecessary budget

* Maintain a clear overview of performance across all brands

* Track daily and weekly results

* Communicate important changes, problems, and opportunities clearly

* Provide feedback about which creatives, angles, and audiences are performing

* Handle a high volume of approximately 100 new creatives per week

* Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy



The role is heavily focused on monitoring, analysis, decision-making, and execution. You will not need to spend your day manually building every campaign because our launch process is already automated.



WHAT YOU MUST UNDERSTAND



You must be comfortable working with metrics such as:



* CPA

* ROAS

* Break-even ROAS

* MER

* CPM

* CTR

* CPC

* Conversion rate

* Average order value

* Daily spend

* Budget allocation

* Creative-level performance

* Account-level profitability



You should understand the difference between short-term fluctuations and meaningful performance changes.



You must also know when to give a campaign more time, when to reduce spend, when to stop it, and when to scale aggressively.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Have proven experience managing Meta/Facebook advertising for e-commerce brands

* Have strong experience with both ABO testing and CBO scaling

* Be extremely comfortable with numbers

* Make decisions based on KPIs rather than emotions or guesses

* Be able to work across several advertising accounts without losing oversight

* Be a fast and disciplined executor

* Enjoy spending time inside Ads Manager, dashboards, and spreadsheets

* Be highly focused, ambitious, and results-driven

* Take ownership instead of waiting to be told about every small problem

* Be able to identify issues before they become expensive

* Be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

* Be available for consistent daily account monitoring

* Be comfortable performing light weekend checks when necessary

* Communicate clearly and reliably

* Have experience using AI to improve analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency



AI experience is valuable, but you must still be capable of interpreting the numbers and making decisions independently.



This role is best suited to someone who genuinely enjoys working. You should enjoy seeing campaigns improve, creatives begin spending, and brands scale as a result of your decisions.



If you prefer slow environments, limited responsibility, or managing many unrelated clients at once, this will probably not be the right position.



COMPENSATION



The compensation structure includes:



* A fixed ongoing retainer

* A tiered performance bonus based on advertising spend achieved while maintaining the agreed KPIs

* Increased compensation as responsibility and results grow



The better our brands scale within the required performance targets, the more you can earn.



You will have the opportunity to work with a variety of products and markets, see new creatives tested at a high volume, and play an important role in rapidly scaling multiple e-commerce brands.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



You will not be joining a slow corporate team or working on one account with a small number of monthly tests.



You will be part of a dynamic e-commerce team that:



* Launches and tests approximately 100 new creatives per week

* Operates multiple brands across different niches

* Makes decisions quickly

* Rewards measurable results

* Uses automation to remove unnecessary manual work

* Gives strong performers significant responsibility

* Provides the opportunity to scale alongside the company



We are looking for someone who wants to become a key long-term part of the team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your proposal with the words “NUMBERS FIRST” so we know you read the complete job post.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. How many years of Meta media-buying experience do you have?



2. What types of e-commerce brands have you worked with?



3. What level of monthly advertising spend have you personally managed?



4. Explain how you normally use ABO campaigns for testing and CBO campaigns for scaling.



5. Tell us about a campaign you successfully scaled while maintaining its required KPIs.



6. Which numbers do you check first when evaluating a newly launched creative?



7. How do you determine whether a weak result is temporary volatility or a real performance problem?



8. How have you used AI to improve your media-buying workflow?



9. Are you available for a full-time, long-term position?



10. What fixed monthly retainer would you expect?



We are looking for someone who loves numbers, moves quickly, takes ownership, and finds genuine satisfaction in seeing advertising accounts and brands scale.

title: Amazon Wholesale Catalog Analyst & Supplier Sourcing VA
description:
SOV Retail Group is looking for an experienced Amazon Wholesale Catalog Analyst & Supplier Sourcing Virtual Assistant.



This is not a basic data-entry position. We need someone who has previously worked with an Amazon Wholesale business, can analyze distributor catalogs, identify viable purchasing opportunities, source legitimate suppliers, and contribute practical experience to improve our operation.



The selected candidate will work directly with the company owners.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1. WHOLESALE CATALOG ANALYSIS



• Clean and organize distributor and manufacturer catalogs.

• Match supplier SKUs, model numbers and UPCs to the correct Amazon ASINs.

• Detect incorrect matches, variations, sizes, bundles and multipack differences.

• Review Keepa price, Buy Box and sales-rank history.

• Evaluate price stability, seller count, competition and Amazon’s presence on the listing.

• Estimate monthly sales and the realistic sales allocation available to our company.

• Calculate referral fees, FBA fees, preparation costs, inbound shipping, net profit, ROI and margin.

• Review minimum order quantities, case packs, availability, MAP and marketplace restrictions.

• Flag products involving hazmat, expiration dates, meltable inventory, oversized dimensions or other operational risks.

• Classify every analyzed product as BUY, TEST, WATCH or REJECT.

• Explain the reasoning behind every recommendation.

• Present the final shortlist in a clear and accurate Google Sheet.



A profitable calculator result alone does not make a product a good opportunity. The analysis must consider price history, demand, competition, seller behavior, Amazon presence, restrictions, inventory risk and all relevant costs.



2. SUPPLIER SOURCING AND ACCOUNT OPENING



• Research legitimate U.S. distributors and manufacturers.

• Verify whether suppliers accept e-commerce and Amazon resellers.

• Identify brands, product categories, territories, minimum orders and account requirements.

• Locate wholesale applications and relevant contacts.

• Complete account applications using approved company information.

• Contact suppliers professionally by
 and telephone.

• Request catalogs, price lists, terms, MAP policies and e-commerce policies.

• Follow up on applications and unanswered communications.

• Record every supplier, contact, response, document, status and next action in our Google Sheets supplier CRM.

• Provide a weekly report showing leads, applications, approvals, rejections, follow-ups, analyzed catalogs and blockers.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• At least one year of experience working with an Amazon Wholesale business.

• Previous experience analyzing wholesale distributor or manufacturer catalogs.

• Practical experience matching UPCs and supplier products to ASINs.

• Ability to interpret Keepa charts, not simply read current values.

• Experience calculating net profit, ROI and profit margin.

• Understanding of Amazon referral fees and FBA fulfillment fees.

• Understanding of SKU, UPC, ASIN, FNSKU, MOQ, case pack, MAP and MSRP.

• Strong Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel skills.

• Strong spoken and written English.

• Experience communicating with U.S. suppliers by
 and telephone.

• Ability to explain why a product should or should not be purchased.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Experience limited to Online Arbitrage or Retail Arbitrage does not qualify as wholesale catalog-analysis experience.



PREFERRED TOOLS



Experience with some of the following is preferred:



• Keepa

• Amazon Seller Central

• SellerAmp

• SmartScout

• InventoryLab

• Sellerboard

• SellerSnap

• Scan Unlimited, Analyzer.Tools or similar bulk catalog-analysis software



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Part-time: 20 hours per week.

• Monday through Friday, approximately four hours per day.

• At least two hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

• Starting compensation: US$7–US$8 per hour based on demonstrated experience.

• Paid practical assessment for finalists.

• Paid two-week trial period.

• Performance and compensation review after 60 days.

• Opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities based on performance.



EXPECTED CONTRIBUTION



We do not want someone who only copies information or depends entirely on automated software.



We want someone who can:



• Explain why a supplier is or is not worth pursuing.

• Identify false-positive products in catalog scans.

• Recognize missing costs and risks before recommending inventory.

• Explain what Keepa is showing and defend a purchasing recommendation.

• Share processes that worked for a previous Amazon Wholesale employer.

• Recommend practical improvements to our supplier and catalog workflow.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin the subject line of your application with:



CATALOG 2026



Applications without this phrase will not be reviewed.



Answer all the following questions:



1. Describe your most recent Amazon Wholesale role and the exact tasks you performed.

2. How many years of Amazon Wholesale experience do you have?

3. Describe the largest wholesale catalog you analyzed and approximately how many products it contained.

4. Explain your process for converting a supplier catalog into a shortlist of potential products.

5. Which tools have you used for catalog analysis?

6. What information do you examine in Keepa before recommending a purchase?

7. How do you match a supplier product to the correct ASIN when the UPC is missing or incorrect?

8. How do you detect a single-unit versus multipack mismatch?

9. Explain the difference between ROI, profit margin and net profit.

10. Describe a product that appeared profitable but that you rejected after completing your analysis.

11. How did you find and qualify distributors for your previous employer?

12. Approximately how many wholesale accounts did you help open?

13. Are you comfortable calling U.S. suppliers in English?

14. What hours can you work in U.S. Eastern Time?

15. Confirm whether you accept US$7–US$8 per hour for 20 hours per week.



Also include:



• A link to a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your Amazon Wholesale experience.

• A sanitized example of a wholesale catalog analysis you previously completed, if available. Remove all confidential information.

• A list of the Amazon and catalog-analysis tools you have personally used.



SELECTION PROCESS



Applicants will pass through the following stages:



1. Application and experience review.

2. English voice-recording review.

3. Interview and live Keepa questions.

4. Paid practical catalog-analysis assessment.

5. Paid two-week working trial.



During the paid assessment, finalists will analyze a sample wholesale catalog and provide:



• Correct product and ASIN matches.

• Keepa observations.

• Estimated demand and competition.

• Amazon fees and operating costs.

• Net profit, ROI and margin.

• Risks or restrictions.

• A BUY, TEST, WATCH or REJECT recommendation.

• A written explanation supporting each decision.



Candidates must be able to explain and defend their analysis. Generic, copied or fully AI-generated applications will not be considered.



This role can become a stable, long-term position for someone who is accurate, reliable, proactive and capable of contributing real Amazon Wholesale experience.

title: Static Creative Strategist (AI Image Generation) — DTC Menswear Brand
description:
Read this first

This is not a "generate images from a prompt" job. We've hired that profile before and it doesn't work for us.



We're looking for someone who thinks like a creative strategist and executes like an art director — someone who can look at a market, understand why an ad works, decide what we should make, and then produce it themselves using AI generation. The strategy and the execution are the same job here.



If you generate good-looking images but can't explain why an ad converts, this role isn't for you. If you understand direct response but your images look obviously AI-generated, it isn't either. We need both.



About us

ARES is a men's underwear brand doing high-volume DTC in the US and Worldwide market. We sell silk-blend boxer-briefs on Shopify and Amazon, and we acquire mainly through Meta Ads, Google, and Applovin. Creative is our number one lever — it decides whether we're profitable or not.



We produce a lot: ad statics, Instagram content, product page imagery. Almost all of it is AI-generated. That's a deliberate production system, not a shortcut. The standard is simple — the final image has to look like a real photoshoot. If someone can tell it's AI, it failed.



What you'll own

Ad statics — you research the market, decide the angle, and build the ad. Layout, hierarchy, copy overlay, visual concept. You bring us ideas, we don't hand you a shot list.

Instagram content — lifestyle and editorial imagery that reads as shot on set.

Product page images — sequential visual storytelling, one narrative beat per image with copy overlay. Not a product gallery.

Realism — skin texture, fabric behavior, lighting coherence, hands, faces, logo accuracy. You retouch and composite until the AI tells are gone.

Consistency — same product, same colorway, same brand codes across hundreds of images. Our product has precise specs that have to be right every single time.

What we need from you

On strategy:



You understand direct response. Hierarchy, focal point, where the eye lands, why one layout converts and another doesn't.

You research competitors and the broader market on your own, and you can defend a creative decision with reasoning instead of taste.

You can take a rough business objective ("we need a back-to-school offer") and come back with a concept, not a question.

On execution:



Deep command of AI image generation — Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Imagen, ComfyUI, whichever you genuinely master. You control the output, you don't roll the dice on it.

Structured, repeatable prompting.

Retouching and compositing (Photoshop or equivalent). Generation alone will not reach our quality bar — the finishing pass is what makes an image usable.

Photographic literacy: lighting setups, lens behavior, depth of field. The people who make AI look real are the ones who understand how a camera actually sees.

Volume without quality drop. We work in batches.

English communication, reliable turnaround, comfortable working from written briefs.

Bonus: apparel or underwear experience, anything where fabric rendering matters. Paid social creative experience.



How to apply

Answer these questions one by one. Applications that send a general pitch instead of answering will not be reviewed.



Ad thinking — Take an ad image you made that performed well. Why did it work? Walk me through what you decided visually and the intent behind each choice. If you have performance data, include it.



Strategy from scratch — You're given one line: "we need a static for a back-to-school offer." No further brief. Walk me through how you get from that sentence to a finished ad — your research, your decisions, your reasoning.



Realism method — What's your actual process for making an AI image undetectable as AI? Name the specific tells you hunt for and how you fix each one, from generation to final file.



Control and consistency — I need the same product, same colorway, same logo, across 100 images. How do you guarantee that? Describe your setup.



Failure case — Describe a project where the AI output kept failing on something specific. What was breaking, what did you try, how did you finally solve it?



Toolstack and day one — Which tools do you use daily and for what? If you started next week, what would your first two weeks look like?



Track record — Which brands or clients have you done this work for? Name them. Send a portfolio with AI-generated work where the AI isn't visible — and if you have before/after (raw generation vs final delivery), send that too. It's what I'm most interested in seeing.



Test: 

We don't hire off a portfolio. Shortlisted candidates get a paid test, and we agree the fee before you start.



We're not testing whether you can operate a generator. We're testing whether you can think about an ad and then build it yourself. Read the product section carefully — most of what we reject fails on product accuracy, not on artistic quality.



What to deliver

5 images. Format 4:5. Highest resolution you can produce.

Few brand asset for this test: 



Three are briefed. Two are yours.



Image 1 — Outdoor shoot, ancient Greek setting

A man wearing the boxer, an elegant woman beside him. Ancient Greek atmosphere — the brand is named after the Greek god of war, so the reference is ours to own.



How you interpret that is up to you: stone, light, landscape, styling, era treatment, mood. We want to see your taste and your restraint. It should look like an editorial fashion shoot, not a costume set.



Image 2 — Back-to-school sale

A sale creative built around the boxers. Back-to-school timing, US market.



Our offer structure: Buy 2 Get 2 Free ($59.99) · Buy 3 Get 5 Free ($89.99 — $11 a pair).



Two copy rules: never show a percentage discount, and never lead with the single-unit price. Frame the value through the bundle.



Image 3 — Professional studio shoot

A clean studio image. Pro lighting setup, controlled environment.



This is where we judge pure craft — lighting, fabric rendering, product accuracy. Nowhere to hide.



On these three: we want them to look genuinely different from each other. Different lighting, different energy, different treatment. Three variations of the same look tells us nothing. Range is what we're measuring.



Images 4 and 5 — Two Meta ads (your concept)

No brief. This is the real test.



Research the market — our category, adjacent DTC brands, what's running on Meta right now. Decide what angle we should be running. Then build two static ads for it.



You choose the angle, the layout, the copy, the format. Bring us ads you'd actually put spend behind.



Good luck.



Richard

CEO Ares Underwear

title: DME Rental & Reimbursement Specialist
description:
We are looking for a dependable and detail-oriented DME Rental & Reimbursement Specialist to join our Billing & Reimbursement Team. This position is responsible for monitoring active DME rental accounts and ensuring rentals are followed through from monthly billing to completion, continuation, or equipment return.



The specialist will work closely with Billing, Prior Authorization, and other departments to address expiring documentation, authorization requirements, Stop/Hold accounts, reimbursement issues, and other items that could delay or prevent payment.



Essential Responsibilities

• Review active DME rental accounts on the first business day of each month and maintain a 30/60/90-day tracking process for upcoming rental, CMN/order, and PAR expirations.

• Monitor rental months, allowable rental periods, authorization periods, and end dates to determine whether rental billing should continue or stop.

• Review the Stop/Hold Report, research the reason for the hold, and take the appropriate action to resolve the account.

• Create and follow up on tasks for CMN/order renewals, PAR continuation, and other documentation needed for continued rental.

• Review No Pricing Found and capped-rental conversion issues and make or coordinate the appropriate Brightree Price Table or Sales Order corrections.

• Review expired or completed rentals with open invoices and determine whether the account requires payer follow-up, claim correction, reconciliation, or an approved adjustment.

• Communicate with patients or authorized representatives regarding rental status and explain equipment-return requirements when applicable.

• Coordinate the return or pickup of company-owned rental equipment when the rental is discontinued or the patient is deceased and follow up until the equipment is accounted for.

• Review terminated rental accounts for possible patient credits or overpayments and coordinate refund review when applicable.

• Maintain clear and accurate Brightree account notes, tasks, stop dates, adjustments, equipment-return information, and follow-up documentation.

• Assist with rental account reviews and audits and bring recurring billing, documentation, reimbursement, or equipment concerns to Billing & Reimbursement leadership.

Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• 1–3 years of DME/HME billing, reimbursement, authorization, or healthcare revenue-cycle experience preferred.

• Experience with recurring and capped rental DME preferred.



Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance preferred.

• Working knowledge of CMNs, SWOs, prior authorizations, HCPCS codes, modifiers, rental periods, and DME billing requirements.

• Brightree or similar DME billing-system and electronic health information systems experience preferred.

• Comfortable researching payer portals, authorization information, claims, and account history.

• Demonstrated analytical, organizational, research, documentation, problem-solving, account reconciliation, and follow-up skills.

• Ability to independently manage a high-volume work queue and prioritize accounts based on deadlines.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, payer portals, Brightree, Availity, Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, dependable, and willing to take ownership of their accounts. The right candidate will not simply identify an issue and move on; they will research the account, determine what is needed, communicate with the appropriate department, and follow the issue through to resolution.

This position is a good fit for someone who understands how rental billing, documentation, authorizations, reimbursement, and equipment management work together within the DME revenue cycle.

Position: DME Rental & Reimbursement Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time

AI-Heavy Role | Lactation Practice | Long-Term | Full-Time



We are a busy and growing lactation consulting practice in Texas looking to hire TWO full-time Medical Virtual Assistants / Patient Coordinators to help manage our incoming patients and connect them with the right lactation consultant.



Our lactation consultants help moms and babies with breastfeeding, bottle-feeding, milk supply, painful feeding, babies struggling to latch or gain weight, pumping, and many other feeding concerns.



The families reaching out to us are often brand-new parents. They may be exhausted, overwhelmed, worried about their baby, or simply trying to figure out what to do next.



Because of that, kindness and sensitivity matter A LOT in this position.



You do NOT need to be a lactation expert — that's our job! But you do need to communicate with families in a way that is warm, patient, helpful, and reassuring.



We want a mom to feel like someone is taking care of her from the very first interaction with our practice.



The Job



Think of this position as our virtual front desk and patient coordinator.



Your main responsibility is simple:



Make sure every new patient gets connected with the right lactation consultant, receives a timely response, and nothing falls through the cracks.



When a new patient comes in, you will:



Review her intake information

Check her insurance information using our internal reference sheets

Use our customized ChatGPT/AI workflows to help determine the correct next steps

Check our lactation consultants' schedules and availability

Use our provider maps and Google Maps to determine which providers are geographically appropriate

Compare actual driving times between the patient's location and our providers for home visits

Match the patient with the appropriate lactation consultant based on location, availability, insurance, and other factors

Send warm, professional patient
s using our templates and AI systems

Connect the patient with the lactation consultant

Reassign the patient if the first provider is unavailable

Keep track of open patients and follow-ups so nobody gets forgotten



You are NOT expected to make medical decisions or answer complicated insurance questions.



We will give you systems, reference sheets, provider maps, templates, and AI workflows to help you know what to do.



If something doesn't fit our normal process, you escalate it to me.



The goal is for you to eventually handle the routine situations independently while I handle the unusual ones.



Geography Is an Important Part of This Job



Our lactation consultants provide home visits throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) area, which is a VERY large geographic area.



You do NOT need to know Texas geography when you start. We will provide maps showing where our providers are located and the areas they typically serve.



However, you MUST be comfortable using maps and understanding how locations relate to one another.



For example, a patient may live in an area served by several of our providers. You may need to use Google Maps to determine that one provider is 15 minutes away, another is 30 minutes away, and another is 50 minutes away.



Over time, we expect you to become familiar with our providers and the general DFW geography so matching patients becomes faster and easier.



If maps, directions, locations, and figuring out how far places are from one another are difficult for you, this probably will not be the right position.



AI & Technology Are a BIG Part of This Job



We use ChatGPT heavily in our daily workflow.



You will have customized AI workflows, instructions, and templates designed specifically for this job. ChatGPT will help you process information, follow our workflows, and create much of the patient communication.



However, you still need to be able to think.



AI is a tool — it does not replace good judgment.



You need to read what AI produces, make sure it actually makes sense, catch mistakes, and recognize when something doesn't seem right.



Please do NOT apply if you dislike technology, struggle to learn new software, or are uncomfortable using AI.



You don't need to be an AI expert when you start. You DO need to be someone who learns technology quickly and is excited about using AI throughout your workday.



Who I'm Looking For



More than anything, I need someone who is:



Excellent at written English

Kind and compassionate

Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Tech-savvy

Comfortable with ChatGPT/AI

Comfortable using maps, locations, and driving times

A quick learner

Dependable

Good at managing multiple things at once

Able to follow systems and instructions

Comfortable making routine decisions independently

Able to recognize when something needs to be escalated instead of guessing

Looking for a long-term, stable position for years to come



I do NOT want someone who needs to ask me what to do with every patient.



At the same time, I do NOT want someone who makes up an answer when they don't know.



I'm looking for someone who can learn to think:



I know how to handle this → I handle it.



Our system tells me how to handle this → I handle it.



This is unusual and doesn't fit our system → I ask for help.



That balance is VERY important to me.



Experience



Experience in any of these areas would be helpful:



Virtual assistance

Executive assistance

Customer service

Patient coordination

Healthcare administration

Medical virtual assistance

Scheduling or staffing coordination

Insurance

/inbox management

Client coordination



U.S. healthcare experience is a PLUS, but it is NOT required.



I would rather hire someone who has fantastic English, good judgment, excellent technology skills, and learns quickly than someone with years of healthcare experience who struggles with technology.



TWO Full-Time Positions Available



We are hiring two people who will learn and perform the same job.



Both coordinators will be trained on the same systems, providers, insurance workflows, maps, AI tools, and patient communication.



The primary difference between the two positions will be the schedule.



Position 1 — U.S. Weekday Coverage



Full-time | Approximately 40 hours/week



The primary schedule will be approximately:



Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Because our practice is in Texas, these will generally be overnight hours in the Philippines.



This person will primarily manage patients coming into our practice during the normal U.S. workweek.



Position 2 — U.S. Evening + Weekend Coverage



Full-time | Approximately 40 hours/week



This position will help cover the times when our weekday coordinator is not working.



The schedule will include U.S. weekend coverage (Friday/Saturday/Sunday) along with additional U.S. evening hours during the week to create a full-time schedule.



Because of the time difference, many U.S. evening hours fall during morning/daytime hours in the Philippines, so this schedule may be a great fit for someone who prefers not to work a traditional overnight Philippines shift.



There is some flexibility in how we build the exact 40-hour schedule with the right person.



You may work a combination of:



U.S. Friday/Saturday/Sunday coverage

U.S. weekday evening coverage

Additional scheduled hours as needed to reach approximately 40 hours



You will NOT be expected to be available 24/7. You will have an established schedule, and another coordinator will be working a complementary schedule.



Why We Are Hiring Two People



I don't want one person to be responsible for everything.



I want two people who know the same job, understand the same systems, and can support one another.



Having two coordinators allows us to provide better coverage throughout the week and gives both people someone else who understands exactly what they do.



Most importantly, it helps us make sure that when a tired or overwhelmed mom reaches out for help, someone is there to take care of her and get her connected with the right person.



Pay & Benefits



We are looking for people who want to become long-term members of our team, and we want to provide stability and consistency in return.



Full-time — approximately 40 hours per week

Paid weekly through Wise

Regular Philippine holidays are paid days off

13th-month pay is included

First-year 13th-month pay will be prorated based on your start date

Long-term, stable position with consistent work



Specific hourly pay will be discussed based on experience.



This Could Be a Great Fit If...



You enjoy organizing people and information.



You like figuring things out.



You're naturally the person who thinks, "Let me see if I can solve this," instead of immediately asking someone else what to do.



You enjoy technology and aren't intimidated by learning new systems.



You're good at looking at a map and figuring out how locations relate to one another.



You pay attention to little details.



You're kind to people — especially when they're stressed, tired, or overwhelmed.



You want to become really good at your job instead of simply completing a list of tasks.



And you're looking for a long-term position where you can learn a business, become an important part of the team, and take real ownership of your role.



How to Apply



Please send me a SHORT message answering these questions:



Which schedule interests you more: Position 1 — U.S. Weekdays or Position 2 — U.S. Evenings/Weekends? If you are open to either, please say so.

What are your preferred working hours in Philippines time?

Tell me briefly about any experience you have with customer service, scheduling, coordinating clients/patients, healthcare, insurance, or similar work.

Are you comfortable using ChatGPT and AI heavily throughout your workday?

Are you comfortable using Google Maps to compare locations and driving times and learning the geography of an area you've never personally lived in?



Please don't send me a long generic cover letter.



A short, genuine response answering the five questions above is perfect.



I'm looking for the right two people to join us long-term, learn our systems, and help us take really good care of the moms and babies who reach out to us for help.

title: Mortgage Assistant | Full-Time Remote
description:
# Mortgage Assistant | Full-Time Remote



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and experienced **Mortgage Assistant** to join our growing team.



This is a long-term remote position for someone who understands the mortgage industry, communicates well, pays close attention to details, and can help keep loans, clients, leads, and daily tasks organized.



If you have previous experience working with a **U.S.-based mortgage broker, loan officer, lender, or mortgage company**, we would love to hear from you.



## What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities may include:



* Assisting a Loan Officer with day-to-day mortgage activities

* Following up with borrowers, clients, real estate agents, lenders, and other parties

* Collecting and organizing borrower documents

* Reviewing files to make sure required documents and information have been received

* Updating loan files, client records, and our CRM

* Monitoring active loan files and following up on outstanding items

* Helping prepare files for submission to lenders

* Tracking loan milestones, conditions, deadlines, and closing dates

* Following up on lender and underwriting conditions

* Sending
s and text message follow-ups

* Scheduling appointments and calls

* Entering and maintaining accurate borrower and loan information

* Helping manage mortgage leads and follow-up

* Performing basic research when needed

* Keeping the Loan Officer updated on important tasks, deadlines, and issues

* Handling general administrative tasks related to our mortgage business



## Mortgage Experience



**Previous U.S. mortgage experience is strongly preferred.**



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



* Conventional loans

* FHA loans

* VA loans

* DSCR loans

* Non-QM loans

* Investment property financing

* Fix and Flip loans

* Commercial or multifamily loans

* Loan processing

* Loan officer assistance

* Mortgage brokerage operations



You do not need to know every loan program, but you should be comfortable learning mortgage terminology, guidelines, and processes quickly.



## What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable and consistent

* Comfortable communicating with U.S. clients

* Professional in written and spoken English

* Comfortable making and receiving phone calls

* Good at following up without being reminded

* Able to manage several tasks and loan files at the same time

* Comfortable working with deadlines

* Able to identify missing information or potential problems

* Willing to ask questions when something is unclear

* Able to follow systems and documented processes

* Comfortable learning new software

* Looking for a long-term position



We especially value someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities instead of simply waiting for the next task.



## Software Experience



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* GoHighLevel

* Mortgage LOS platforms

* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Excel

* Microsoft Office

* Calendly

* Slack

* Zoom



If you haven't used one of our systems before, that's okay. You should be comfortable learning new technology quickly.



## Work Schedule



**Full-Time Remote Position**



You must be available to work during U.S. business hours.



Exact working hours will be discussed during the interview.



You will need:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A dependable computer

* A quiet and professional workspace

* A backup internet option is preferred

* A headset suitable for client calls



## Compensation



Compensation will depend on your mortgage experience, communication skills, and overall qualifications.



There will be opportunities for increased responsibility and growth for the right person.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of our team.



## How to Apply



Please send the following with your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Tell us about your previous mortgage experience.

3. What type of mortgage company did you work for?

4. What loan programs have you worked with?

5. What mortgage-related tasks were you responsible for?

6. What CRM, LOS, or mortgage software have you used?

7. Are you comfortable speaking with borrowers and real estate professionals on the phone?

8. What hours are you available to work in U.S. Eastern Time?

9. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?

10. Please include the words **"Mortgage Team"** at the beginning of your application so we know you carefully read the entire job posting.



Please also include your **resume and a short voice recording introducing yourself and describing your mortgage experience.**



Applications that do not answer the questions above may not be considered.



We're looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, easy to work with, and interested in building a long-term career with our team.

title: Cleaning Business Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator
description:

STARTING PAY: $3-$5 USD per hour, depending on experience

INCENTIVES: Performance-based commissions and bonuses

GROWTH OPPORTUNITY: Potential to grow into a full-time Operations Lead role



ABOUT WALIS & CO.

We we believe in developing leaders, not micromanaging workers. If you are someone who thrives on ownership, wants to be part of a company that is scaling quickly, and enjoys being the operational engine behind a growing Australian business, you will thrive in this role.

title: Dispatch Operations Specialist
description:
We’re hiring our first dedicated Dispatcher to support our growing operations, particularly on a network of autonomous vehicles and food-delivery robots across U.S. markets. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day dispatch including monitoring live fleet operations, coordinating with field teams, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and helping build dispatch workflows that will support the operation as it scales. 



You’ll be working across multiple systems and communication channels, keeping track of what’s happening across different markets and jumping in when something needs attention. You’ll work closely with field operators and internal teams, make quick calls when issues come up, and speak directly with customers when needed. 



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable making quick decisions, switching between different tools, and working with both internal teams and external customers. You’ll be working closely with U.S.-based field teams every shift, so previous experience supporting U.S. operations remotely is a strong plus. Since this function is still being built, you’ll also have a real opportunity to help shape the workflows, escalation paths, and processes that the team will use as it grows.



What You'll Do

- Monitor fleet activity and alert channels across multiple platforms and markets, tracking robot and vehicle locations, battery levels, active tasks, and delivery status.

- Own operational issues through resolution by identifying and prioritizing issues as they arise, including stalled or  immobilized robots, unsafe conditions, missed tasks, and deliveries that fall off schedule.

- Contact the assigned field operator to resolve the issue, and follow established escalation procedures when they do not respond within the required timeframe.

- Coordinate backup coverage when the assigned operator is unavailable so that fleet operations continue without interruption.

- Continuously triage incoming alerts, messages, and fleet data, determining what requires immediate action and what can be handled through normal workflows.

- Prioritize and coordinate field service activity across markets, including battery swaps, robot recoveries, fleet interventions, and other service stops.

- Handle calls from drivers and supervisors on active runs who are unable to locate a delivery address or reach a customer, and resolve the issue on their behalf.

- Contact customers directly to confirm delivery locations, obtain access instructions, or complete a drop off.

- Document each i
, the actions taken, and any details relevant to future operations - such as gate codes, difficult access points, and recurring problem locations - and help pinpoint recurring patterns that can improve future workflows and customer technology.

- Contribute to the development of dispatch procedures, escalation paths, and operational documentation as the operation grows.

- Work across multiple customer platforms, dashboards, Slack channels, and internal tools, quickly building context even when information is spread across different systems.



What We're Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in dispatch, logistics, fleet operations, transportation, field operations, or another fast-moving operations environment.

- At least 1 year of experience working directly with a startup is highly preferred

- Experience supporting U.S.-based companies, customers, drivers, operators, or field teams, preferably in a remote or offshore setup.

- Hands-on experience coordinating drivers, field workers, technicians, couriers, vehicles, deliveries, or other moving resources.

- Strong real-time problem-solving skills. You can assess a situation quickly, figure out what needs to happen, and take action without waiting to be told every step.

- Comfortable handling multiple tasks, systems, and communication channels at the same time, as well as piecing together information across multiple tools when troubleshooting an issue.

title: Calling ALL MASTER OUTBOUND CALLERS
description:
We help local businesses grow. Part of what we do involves helping our clients open new office locations in new cities, which means every new market comes with a space that has to be found, called, negotiated and secured.



We have already built an AI system that finds the locations. It hands you a list of live options in the target city with the details attached. What it cannot do is pick up the phone.



That is your job.



The Role



You are the caller and the negotiator. Every day you open your list of AI-sourced locations and start dialling.



You confirm the space is real and still available, get the numbers out of the landlord, push for better terms, and build a short list of the strongest options. Those options go to the account manager, who presents them to the client. Once the client picks one, you go back to the landlord and get the deal closed.



This is a phone-heavy role. You will dial, a lot. Some days you will make 40 to 60 calls to find the one landlord who will do a short-term deal at the right number. If cold calling drains you, this is not your role. If you like the hunt and you like winning on price, you will love it.



What You'll Do

Work through a daily list of AI-sourced office locations and call every one

Speak to landlords, property managers, commercial agents and coworking operators to confirm availability, pricing and terms

Negotiate hard on monthly rate, term length, deposit, break clauses and signage rights

Push for month-to-month or short-term agreements wherever possible

Package the best two or three options per market and hand them to the account manager with clear notes on terms and cost

Close the deal on whichever option the client selects

Run the paperwork through to signature and confirm the start date

Coordinate setup: address verification, key handover, signage, mail and utilities where needed

Keep a live tracker of every location, its status, terms, cost and renewal date

Report weekly on calls made, options presented, locations secured and average cost per location

Who This Is For



Must have:



Fluent, natural spoken English with a neutral North American phone presence. You are calling US landlords and property managers all day. They need to be comfortable with you inside the first 10 seconds

Proven phone experience: cold calling, appointment setting, leasing, property management, real estate, B2B sales or collections

You genuinely enjoy negotiating. You do not flinch when someone tells you the price is the price

Organised enough to run 15 to 20 open locations at once without losing track of a single one

Able to work US business hours. Landlords answer the phone 9 to 5 their time, so this one is non-negotiable

Reliable internet, a quiet place to call from, and a decent headset



Nice to have:



Commercial real estate, leasing or property management background

CRM experience

Experience negotiating in a US market specifically

What We Offer

$800 to $1,300 USD per month depending on experience

Performance bonus per location secured, plus a bonus tied to how far under target you land the monthly rate

Direct access to the founder. You will be working with me on this, not through three layers of management

Tools that do the boring part for you. No hunting through listings, no building your own lists. You call, you negotiate, you close

Full-time and long-term. Every client we sign adds locations to your pipeline

A very clean scorecard: locations secured, cost per location, days to close. Hit those and you will do extremely well here

How to Apply



Applications that skip any of these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the words MONTH TO MONTH so we know you read this properly.



2. A short intro. Who you are, what phone work you have done, and why this role suits you.



3. A 2 to 3 minute voice recording. Role play this scenario, improvising both sides:



You are calling a property manager about a 250 sq ft office listed at $900 per month on a 12 month lease. Your job is to get them to a month-to-month arrangement at under $700. They will resist. Get the deal.



We are listening for your phone presence, how you handle the pushback, and whether you can hold a friendly tone while still asking for the thing.



4. Answer in writing: what is the toughest negotiation you have ever won, and what did you actually say to turn it?



Shortlisted applicants go to a live call with the founder, then a paid trial task on a real market.

title: Virtual Site Civil & Land Development Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Virtual Site Civil & Land Development Engineer to provide remote engineering and technical support for residential, commercial, and industrial land development projects.



The ideal candidate has practical experience in site civil design, grading, drainage, land development, earthwork, and civil plan review, with the ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with project managers, designers, contractors, surveyors, and other engineering professionals in a remote environment.



This position is primarily focused on virtual technical work, including reviewing plans, preparing and reviewing civil layouts, analyzing grading and drainage, performing quantity takeoffs, coordinating design information, and supporting project development from the office.



Key Responsibilities



Site Civil & Land Development



Review architectural, civil, survey, and site development plans.

Develop and/or review site layouts, grading plans, drainage plans, and earthwork plans.

Analyze existing and proposed site conditions.

Review site access, elevations, slopes, drainage patterns, and constructability.

Assist in preparing land development plans for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

Identify potential design conflicts and recommend practical engineering solutions.



Grading & Drainage



Review proposed grading and ensure appropriate slopes and drainage patterns.

Analyze site elevations, contours, spot elevations, swales, channels, and drainage structures.

Review stormwater management and surface drainage concepts.

Evaluate cut-and-fill requirements and earthwork quantities.

Identify potential grading issues that may affect drainage, accessibility, constructability, or project cost.



Geotechnical Coordination



Review available geotechnical and soil investigation reports.

Identify grading and site preparation requirements based on geotechnical recommendations.

Review soil stability, compaction, excavation, fill, and site preparation considerations.

Coordinate geotechnical requirements with civil/site development plans.

Flag potential geotechnical concerns for further review by the appropriate geotechnical professional.



Quantity Takeoffs & Cost Support



Perform civil/site development quantity takeoffs from drawings and specifications.

Quantify earthwork, excavation, fill, concrete, drainage, utilities, paving, and other civil components where applicable.

Assist with estimates, budgets, scopes of work, and bid documentation.

Review contractor or subcontractor quantities and identify discrepancies.

Support project managers and estimators with technical civil information.



Remote Plan Review & Coordination



Conduct detailed technical reviews of drawings, specifications, and project documents.

Provide markups and comments using digital collaboration and PDF review tools.

Coordinate remotely with project managers, architects, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders.

Attend virtual meetings and provide technical input when required.

Maintain organized project files, calculations, markups, and supporting documentation.

Track design comments, revisions, RFIs, and other technical items.



Required Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field.

Professional engineering license/registration is preferred.

Experience in site civil engineering, land development, grading, drainage, or earthwork.

Strong ability to read and interpret civil, architectural, structural, survey, and geotechnical plans.

Understanding of grading, drainage, site development, and earthwork principles.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Performance Creative Designer – Meta Ads / DTC
description:
# Performance Creative Designer – Meta Ads / DTC



**Full-Time | Remote | DTC / eCommerce**



We are looking for a **Performance Creative Designer** to create high-performing paid social advertisements for a growing U.S. supplement/eCommerce brand.



This is **NOT a traditional graphic design position** and is not a social media posting role.



We are looking for someone who understands **direct-response advertising** and can turn marketing ideas, customer pain points, hooks, and offers into ads designed to generate clicks and purchases.



## What You'll Do



* Create **static image ads for Meta 
 & Instagram)**

* Edit **short-form video ads** using UGC, product footage, stock footage, voiceovers, and existing content

* Create multiple creative variations from a single advertising concept

* Develop different hooks, headlines, layouts, and visual approaches for testing

* Turn customer pain points and product benefits into compelling advertisements

* Research competitors using the **Meta Ad Library**

* Study successful DTC advertisements and identify new concepts we can test

* Work with our team to develop new advertising angles

* Create fast iterations of winning creatives

* Review basic advertising performance data such as CTR, CPC, CPA, CVR, and ROAS

* Use performance data to help determine what creative should be produced next

* Organize creative tests and maintain a library of ads we've tested



## Types of Creative You'll Produce



You should be comfortable creating:



* Direct-response static ads

* UGC-style video ads

* Product-focused ads

* Problem/solution ads

* Educational ads

* Testimonial/review creatives

* Comparison creatives

* Native/social-feed-style ads

* Founder-led creative

* Short-form video with captions, hooks, B-roll, and voiceovers



We care much more about **whether an advertisement performs** than whether it wins a design award.



## What We're Looking For



**Required:**



* Strong graphic design skills

* Strong short-form video editing skills

* Experience creating Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertisements

* Understanding of direct-response advertising

* Ability to create ads quickly and test multiple ideas

* Experience with tools such as Photoshop, Figma, Canva, Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar

* Strong English comprehension

* Ability to take an idea and turn it into finished creative without constant direction

* Organized and comfortable working in a testing environment



**Strongly Preferred:**



* Experience working with DTC/eCommerce brands

* Experience with supplements, health/wellness, fitness, or consumer products

* Understanding of Meta advertising metrics

* Experience creating ads that have generated measurable sales

* Experience researching competitors through Meta Ad Library

* Understanding of hooks, customer awareness, pain points, offers, and landing-page message matching



## What Success Looks Like



We don't want someone who simply waits for us to say:



*"Make this graphic."*



We want someone who can think:



*"This customer has this problem. Let's test three different ways of communicating that problem, create several ads for each concept, see what performs, and then iterate on the winner."*



Your job is to help us **constantly test and discover better advertising creative.**



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A link to your portfolio.

2. **5 examples of paid social ads you've personally created** — preferably DTC/eCommerce.

3. At least **2 static ads and 2 video ads**.

4. Tell us which ad you've created performed best and **what metric you used to determine that it performed well**.

5. Tell us what **CTR, CPA, CVR, and ROAS** mean.

Shift: 12:00 AM – 8:00 PM Philippine Time (PHT).

Flexibility to extend coverage during major breaking news events when necessary.

Enjoy opportunities for professional growth within a growing international media organization.

We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.

What You Bring

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it
