title: Real Estate Acquisitions Manager — Ground-Floor Hire, Commission Upside
description:
Read the whole post before you apply. This is not a call-center gig, and it's not for someone who needs to be told what to do every day. If you already know — not hope, know — that you can pick something up, execute it well without hand-holding, and figure out the rest as you go, keep reading.



About the Role



UFA is a Real Estate Investing / Wholesaling business based in New Jersey. We're hiring one person into a role that starts as a hands-on Acquisitions Caller and is designed to grow into an Acquisitions Manager — someone who eventually helps run the calling side of the business and manages teammates we add under them.



We are not hiring a manager on day one. We're hiring someone who will personally do the work — calling, qualifying, and closing motivated sellers — and prove, in real numbers, that they can be trusted to run more than just their own desk. If you do that, the title, the pay, and the team you lead all grow with you.



The First 30-90 Days — This Is the Hard Part



Early on, this is on you. You'll take direction, learn the property types and the offer logic, and execute the daily calling and qualification work described below — largely on your own, without someone checking in on every step. We'll set the direction and the standards; how you hit them day to day is on you.



Once you've proven you can run this without being managed line by line, this role opens up: you'll help build out and lead the team — starting with the next hire we bring on.



What You'll Personally Own (Day-to-Day Work)



- Call new leads and return inbound calls

- Follow up with previous prospects on a set cadence

- Send compliant texts where appropriate

- Ask seller qualification questions and record motivation, timeline, price expectations, and property condition

- Determine whether a mortgage exists and approximate balance owed

- Determine occupancy and identify any foreclosure/auction deadlines

- Schedule callbacks and categorize leads by motivation level

- Immediately escalate hot sellers so we can move fast

- Update the CRM after every single conversation



The 10 Questions You'll Be Asking Every Seller



1) Why are you considering selling? 2) What condition is the property in? 3) Is anyone currently living there? 4) How quickly would you like to sell? 5) What are you hoping to get for it? 6) Is there currently a mortgage? 7) Approximately what is owed? 8) Are there liens/taxes/other known balances? 9) If we could solve the problem, what would you need to move forward? 10) Who else needs to approve the sale?



Hours & Schedule



Hours: 5 hours/day, 4 days/week (20 hrs/week) to start

Calling window: Primarily U.S. Eastern Time



Daily Targets



60-100 outbound call attempts/day, aiming for 15+ actual owner contacts, 5+ meaningful conversations, 2+ potentially motivated sellers, and 1+ qualified lead.



What We're Looking For



- Excellent, natural conversational English — this is non-negotiable

- Previous experience cold calling U.S. sellers, ideally in real estate

- Comfortable discussing distressed property situations with empathy and respect

- Thick skin — able to handle rejection and stay consistent

- Doesn't sound scripted or robotic on the phone

- Strong, disciplined follow-up habits

- CRM experience (any major CRM)

- Able to recognize genuine motivation vs. a lead that's going nowhere

- Sticks to authorized talking points — does not negotiate outside approved boundaries

- Genuinely wants to manage and build a team eventually — not just work a shift

- Comfortable with ambiguity in the first 90 days, and can take a direction and run with it without needing every step spelled out



Compensation — Built to Reward Ownership, Not Just Hours



Base pay: $6/hour, 5 hours/day, 4 days/week (20 hrs/week) to start. This is intentional: the real upside here is performance-based, not the hourly rate.

Manager commission: 5% commission on all closed deals, as the acquisitions manager — ongoing, not a one-time bonus.

60-day contract bonus: Additional 5% bonus if you get any deal to a signed contract within your first 60 days. The contract does not need to close within that 60-day window — it just needs to be signed.

90-day growth trigger: If our first deal closes within your first 90 days, your base pay is boosted and we bring on the next hire — your first teammate — with you starting to help lead them.



In short: the faster and better you perform, the faster your pay grows and the faster you're managing people instead of just making calls.



How to Apply



Please include:

- A short voice or video intro (even 60 seconds) so we can hear your spoken English

- Your experience cold calling U.S. homeowners or sellers

- Which CRMs and dialers you've used

- Your available hours (must overlap with U.S. Eastern Time calling windows)

- One example of a time you were given a goal with little instruction and figured out how to hit it on your own

- The word "OWNERSHIP" at the top of your application, so we know you read the full post



Finalists will complete a live seller role-play as part of the interview.

title: Remote Sales Agent — Performance-Based Pay,  Base + Commission Structure
description:
Type: Full-Time, Remote, 8-Hour Daily Shift

Markets: United States, Australia, Canada, South Africa

Compensation: $40/day base when target is hit | 10% of gross sales when target is missed | 20% commission on all sales above $300/day



The Opportunity



We are building a lean, high-performance remote sales team. You will be calling warm prospects from our existing database across four English-speaking markets. No cold scraping. No blind dialing. Real leads, real conversations, real money.

We pay for results. Hit the daily target and you earn a strong guaranteed base plus commission. Fall short and you still get paid but at a reduced performance rate. The floor is low, the ceiling is high, and the math rewards consistency.



What You Will Do



Dial cold prospects from our provided database (US, AU, CA, ZA,)

Follow structured scripts, handle objections, and close deposits, We will provide sales tracking links

Work a consistent 8-hour shift aligned to your assigned market timezone

Submit a brief end-of-day sales report



Compensation Structure — Read This Carefully



We operate on a straight performance model with two clear paths every single day. If you hit the daily sales target of $300 or more during your 8-hour shift, you earn a guaranteed base pay of $40 for that day, plus a 20% commission calculated on every dollar of sales above the $300 threshold. For example, if you close exactly $300 in sales, you take home $40. If you close $400, you earn the $40 base plus $20 in commission for the $100 excess, totaling $60. At $500 in sales, you receive $40 base plus $40 commission on the $200 above target, giving you $80 for the shift. Push further to $750 and your daily pay becomes $130, made up of the $40 base and $90 commission on the $450 excess. At $1,000 in daily sales, you walk away with $180, composed of the $40 base and $140 commission on the $700 above target.



If you do not hit the $300 target, the $40 base does not apply. Instead, you are paid 10% of your total gross sales for that day. This means a day with $100 in sales pays $10, a day with $200 in sales pays $20, and a day with $250 in sales pays $25. There is no minimum floor beyond what you produce, and there is no cap on what you can earn when you exceed target. All earnings are calculated per completed 8-hour shift and paid out on a weekly basis.



Shift & Schedule



This is an 8-hour per day role, 5 to 6 days per week. Your shift timing will be aligned to your primary market. The US market runs on night shift Philippines and India time. The Australia and Asia market runs on day or evening shift. The Canada market is similar to the US with some flexibility. The South Africa market runs mid-day to evening shift. We will assign you to the market that best fits your accent and availability.



What You Need



You must speak fluent, clear English and sound natural and trustworthy to Western customers. Prior sales or call center experience is required, with a B2C or B2B closing background preferred. You need reliable high-speed internet, a noise-canceling headset, and a quiet workspace. You must commit to a full 8-hour daily shift — this is not a gig you squeeze in between other jobs. You must maintain strict CRM discipline, meaning every call, note, and outcome must be logged. You need a self-driven work ethic; you are remote, and your results are your attendance record.



The Math Is Simple



Hit $300 in an 8-hour shift and walk away with $40 guaranteed plus a 20% kicker on everything extra. Miss the target and you still eat, but you eat based on what you closed: 10% of the day's gross sales. We don't micromanage. We don't make excuses. We pay what the numbers say. Apply now. Let's build something together.

What Are You Selling?



We provide full-service management for Airbnb and short-term rental property owners.

We Sign the Client ? You Get Paid AGAIN

We are targeting approximately $1,200+ USD/month in earnings for a productive rep, but there is no fixed earnings ceiling.

You don't need to be an Airbnb expert.

What we DO need is someone who can sell.

Confident speaking English with US customers

Hungry to make money and grow with a company

Why This Opportunity Is Different



We aren't selling a $20 product.



One good conversation can turn into a client worth thousands of dollars per year to our company.



Some owners have one property.



Others have 5, 10, or more.



That's why we want our sales rep participating in the upside.



Find better opportunities. Build relationships. Bring us valuable clients. Make more money.

title: Highly Wanted: Experienced CS Rep (Don't Reply If Inexperienced)
description:
Hi! We're Just Jenny, a beauty and wellness brand. We sell skincare tools, patches, serums and supplements to customers across Europe, and most of them are women in their 40s, 50s and 60s who just want to feel good in their own skin again.



Small team, no corporate nonsense, and a healthy amount of orders coming in every single day.



Those orders come with questions. "Where's my package?" "Can I change my address?" "How do I actually use this thing?" "I want my money back." That's where you come in.



We're looking for someone who takes real ownership of the inbox. Not someone who fires off canned replies, but someone who reads what the customer actually wrote, answers like a human being, and turns a grumpy "refund me now" into "oh nice, thanks for sorting that out."



One thing up front: this role is for people who have already done it. If you're brand new to customer support, we're not the right first stop for you.



What you'll be doing



Running the daily customer inbox in CommSlayer

Answering order and shipping questions, chasing track & trace, and staying on top of our suppliers and fulfilment partner when a package goes missing

Handling refund and return requests. Solve the actual problem first, reach for the refund button last

Filing and winning chargebacks in Shopify Payments and PayPal: gathering the evidence, writing the response, submitting well before the deadline

Answering product questions. Our customers are often trying something like this for the first time, so a little reassurance goes a long way

Spotting patterns. If 15 people
 about the same product this week, we want to hear it from you before we see it in the numbers



The two numbers we care about



Refund rate and chargeback rate. Keeping both as low as humanly possible, without ever being difficult with a customer, is basically the whole job. If that sounds like a fun puzzle instead of a headache, you're going to like it here. And yes, there's a bonus tied to it.



What we're looking for



1–2+ years in customer support for an e-commerce or dropshipping brand. You know what a "where is my order" wave feels like

Real hands-on experience with chargebacks and disputes. Not "I've heard of them" but "I've won them"

Comfortable, natural written English. Warm and clear, not stiff and corporate

Reliability. This is a daily job, weekends included. Not a "I'll batch it on Friday" situation

Experience with CommSlayer is a big plus. Used Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze or Richpanel instead and you pick things up fast? Still apply

Nice to have: Shopify experience, and any tools you've used to fight disputes



The details



Part-time to start, around 2–4 hours a day, 7 days a week (weekends are lighter)

Competitive hourly rate plus a bonus structure tied to your refund and chargeback numbers. Do the job well and you earn more

Nothing in the inbox sits longer than 10 hours. That's the one hard rule

100% remote. Beyond that response time, you pick your own hours

Room to grow, and we mean it. As our volume goes up we'll give you more hours and review your rate along with it. The plan is for this person to grow into owning our whole support operation, and eventually to help us build out the team

Long-term. We're not looking for a two-month patch

Start date: ASAP



How to apply



Skip the cover letter, we won't read it. Send us a 30-second video instead.



Film it on your phone, don't overthink it, and don't script it word for word. We're not judging your camera. We just want to hear you talk. In those 30 seconds, tell us:



Who you are

Why you want to work with us

Why you're better than other CS reps



That third one is the one that matters. Be specific. "I'm hardworking and detail-oriented" tells us nothing. "I brought a client's chargeback rate from 1.2% to 0.4% in four months" tells us everything.



Then add two lines of text with your message:



How many chargebacks you've handled, and roughly what your win rate was

Which helpdesk tools you've actually worked in



Start your message with the word PACKAGE, so we know you read this far.



If your video lands well, we'll set up a short call.

title: RingRadar Outbound Sales Development Representative
description:
Hours: 5 days a week, Monday through Friday, 9am–5pm EST

Location: Remote



About RingRadar

RingRadar is one of the fastest-growing event management software companies for horse shows in America. Designed to simplify and streamline horse show operations, RingRadar allows competitors to easily enter events, pay online, and view real-time schedules and results. On the backend, event organizers can manage every aspect of the competition, including setting up the event, organizing schedules, inputting results, and handling finances — all in one easy-to-use, web-based platform. Our mission is to make horse shows stress-free for organizers, participants, and spectators alike.



Job Overview

We are looking for a confident, persistent, and highly organized Outbound Sales Development Representative to introduce RingRadar to horse show organizers and generate new sales opportunities.



This is an end-to-end outbound sales development role. You will research horse shows and organizations, identify the appropriate decision-makers, build and maintain prospect lists, make outbound calls, qualify potential customers, and conduct product demonstrations for interested prospects.



Your primary responsibility will be to create new sales opportunities for RingRadar. You will contact prospective customers by phone, learn how they currently manage their shows, explain how RingRadar may be able to help, and schedule and conduct online product demonstrations.



This role requires someone who is comfortable making a high volume of calls, speaking with new people throughout the day, handling rejection professionally, following up consistently, learning our product in depth, and confidently presenting it to prospective customers.



You will be responsible for managing prospects through the initial outbound process—from identifying them through completing the demonstration and coordinating the appropriate next steps.





Key Responsibilities

Prospect List Building: Research upcoming horse shows, equestrian organizations, and other potential customers using websites, event calendars, association directories, social media, search engines, and other online sources.

Contact Research: Identify the show managers, organizers, secretaries, or other decision-makers responsible for selecting event management software.

Contact Information Collection: Find and verify accurate phone numbers,
 addresses, event details, and other relevant information for each prospect.

CRM Data Entry: Add new prospects to our CRM with accurate, complete, and consistently formatted information.

Outbound Calling: Make cold calls to horse show organizers and other qualified prospects across the United States.

Prospecting Outreach: Use phone calls, voi
,
, and text messages when appropriate to establish contact and generate interest.

Appointment Setting: Schedule discovery calls and online product demonstrations with interested prospects.

Product Demonstrations: Prepare for and conduct online demonstrations of the RingRadar platform, tailoring each presentation to the prospect’s needs, current processes, and show type.

Discovery: Ask thoughtful questions during demonstrations to understand the prospect’s challenges, requirements, buying process, and level of interest.

Objection Handling: Respond confidently and professionally to common questions, concerns, and objections during both cold calls and product demonstrations.

Next-Step Coordination: Establish a clear next step after each demonstration, such as scheduling a follow-up conversation, providing additional information, preparing pricing, or involving another member of the RingRadar team.

Follow-Up: Make timely follow-up calls and send personalized
s or text messages to prospects who have expressed interest or completed a demonstration.

Pipeline Management: Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects at different stages of the outbound sales process and ensure that promising opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

Additional Outreach: From time to time, assist with similar prospect research, list building, outbound outreach, demonstrations, or operational tasks for our sister software product.

Additional Team Support: From time to time, assist with other tasks based on the team’s needs, which may include customer support, software testing and quality assurance, documentation, data entry, and general operational work.





Qualifications

At least 1 year of experience in cold calling, appointment setting, outbound sales, lead generation, business development, product demonstrations, or a similar role.

Excellent spoken and written English.

A clear, professional, and friendly phone presence.

Comfortable researching prospects and building lead lists independently rather than relying entirely on prebuilt lists.

Resourceful in finding decision-makers and accurate business contact information online.

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and speaking with prospective customers throughout the day.

Able to remain positive, persistent, and professional when prospects are busy, uninterested, or initially resistant.

Strong listening skills and the ability to have a natural conversation rather than simply reading from a script.

Able to communicate a software product’s value clearly and concisely.

Comfortable learning a software platform in depth and demonstrating it over video calls and screen sharing.

Confident answering questions and guiding prospective customers through a structured but conversational product demonstration.

Comfortable asking questions, qualifying prospects, handling objections, and requesting a specific next step.

Highly organized and disciplined about prospecting, recording notes, scheduling follow-ups, and maintaining accurate CRM records.

Comfortable learning and using calling software, CRM systems,
, calendars, video conferencing platforms, spreadsheets, and online research tools.

Reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet home workspace, a professional-quality headset, and a computer capable of conducting reliable video demonstrations.

Able to work consistently from 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

Receptive to feedback, coaching, call reviews, demonstration reviews, and ongoing improvement.



Bonus Qualifications

Experience selling or demonstrating B2B software or SaaS products.

Experience owning multiple stages of the outbound process, from prospect research through product demonstration.

Experience calling small-business owners, event organizers, or association leaders in the United States.

Experience using a sales CRM such as Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar platform.

Experience with outbound calling software, sales dialers,
 outreach, or SMS follow-up.

Experience using online research tools to identify companies, events, decision-makers, and contact information.

Familiarity with the equestrian or horse show industry.

Experience researching prospects and building, cleaning, and prioritizing lead lists.

A track record of meeting prospecting, appointment-setting, demonstration, or sales pipeline targets.





Why Join RingRadar?

Opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, industry-transforming company.

Work remotely while making a direct impact on horse shows across the country.

Collaborate with a passionate, dedicated team that values innovation and customer success.



Compensation



Compensation for this independent contractor role includes:



Base compensation: $600 USD per month.

Demo commission: $10 USD for each completed qualified product demonstration.

Monthly target: 40 completed qualified demonstrations, equivalent to $400 in target commission.

On-target earnings: $1,000 USD per month when the monthly target is achieved.

Uncapped commission: There is no limit on the number of qualified demonstrations for which commission may be earned.



To qualify for commission, a demonstration must be attended by a legitimate prospective customer who reasonably fits RingRadar’s target customer profile. The representative must conduct the demonstration, record appropriate notes and outcomes in the CRM, and complete any required follow-up steps.



Commission is paid for completed qualified demonstrations, not merely for demonstrations that are scheduled but not attended.



Performance expectations may be adjusted during the initial training and ramp-up period as the representative learns the product and outbound process.

title: Virtual Patient Care Coordinator – UK Oculoplastic & Eyelid Surgery Clinic (Remote, Philippines)
description:
IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word EYELID so we know you read this post. Applications without it are deleted.



We are the Eyelid Wellness Group, a private eyelid surgery clinic in the UK led by a Professor of oculoplastic surgery.



We are hiring a full-time Patient Coordinator to be the main point of contact for our patients: answering calls, booking, confirming, rescheduling and cancelling consultations and procedures, planning and coordinating surgical days with the surgeon and theatre team, managing the surgeon's diary, chasing consent confirmations and payments, handling patient complaints and concerns calmly and professionally, and making post-operative check-in calls.



We are not looking for a freelancer to pass through. We are looking for a long-term partner in the business: someone who grows with us, knows our patients, and becomes the person the whole team relies on. In return you get full training over 3-4 paid weeks (with a training manual, scripts and templates for every situation), ongoing support, and a UK doctor on the team who you can go to directly with any problem or question. You will never be asked to answer medical questions yourself, and you will never be left out of your depth: anything clinical goes straight to the doctors, and anything you are unsure about, you ask. We would always rather you ask twice than guess once.



WORKING HOURS (fixed, non-negotiable):



Monday to Friday: 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM Philippine time (9:00 AM to 4:00 PM UK time; one hour later November to March)

No weekend work required.

Total about 35 hours/week. You must be available for every hour of this schedule.

You follow the UK calendar, not the Philippine one. You work on Philippine public holidays; you have UK bank holidays off.



PAID TIME OFF & SICK LEAVE:



10 paid PTO days per year. Planned PTO should be requested at least 7 calendar days in advance and won't be unreasonably denied. Up to 3 unused PTO days can be carried over into the following year.

7 paid sick days per year, available from your very first day, including during training and probation. No advance notice needed for genuine emergencies or unexpected illness. Sick days do not carry over or convert to cash.

Unpaid leave can be requested for time needed beyond your paid allowance, with reasonable notice.



REQUIREMENTS:



Excellent spoken and written English of the highest calibre. We expect crystal clear pronunciation and natural fluency. You will speak with UK patients all day, including people recovering from surgery, and you will sometimes need to manage complaints and difficult conversations calmly. Your English will be assessed live on a video call and in your application video. Your accent must be clear and easy for UK patients to understand; candidates whose videos show clear, confident, top-tier spoken English will be preferred.

Genuine patience and a calm, empathetic manner. You will be dealing with worried, anxious, or unhappy patients, including complaints, and how you handle that matters as much as how you sound.

Your own laptop (not shared), headset, and a private, quiet room. Patient calls are confidential medical conversations and must not be overheard.

Stable internet of at least 25 Mbps down / 5 Mbps up, PLUS a working backup (mobile data/pocket wifi) and a plan for power outages. If your connection drops, our patients' calls go unanswered, so this is essential.

At least 2 years in admin, customer service or coordination with direct customer contact. Medical, dental or clinic experience is a big advantage.

You will need to be self-sufficient, organised and proactive, and able to see and sort out logistical and admin problems before they reach the clinical team or directors. We need someone who is 2 steps ahead.

This is an exclusive full-time commitment during your working hours. Individuals only: no agencies, and no arrangement where someone else does any part of the work. The person we interview is the person who does the job, and identity is verified at contract and randomly on camera afterwards.

You must be able to provide two references from previous employers or clients, with contact details we can actually call. These will be checked before any offer is confirmed.

Independent contractor: you are responsible for your own taxes.



HOW WE WORK (read carefully before applying):

Working time is logged in time-tracking software with periodic screenshots during working hours. All business calls are recorded. Cameras are on for all Zoom meetings (which are also recorded and transcribed). You will have a daily catch-up with the director, and you must outline your agenda for the day at each one. There are clear KPIs (answer speed, response times, task completion) and a short end-of-day report.



Performance is reviewed weekly, especially in the first months. If KPIs are consistently not met after feedback and support, the contract will be ended. We are honest about this upfront: if you deliver, this is a stable, well-paid long-term role with a supportive team; if monitoring or KPIs are not for you, please do not apply.



OUR STANDARDS:

We are a high-end private surgical clinic. Our patients pay premium fees and expect flawless service, and we expect the same standard from our coordinator and all our staff. To be clear upfront about what ends the contract:



Working for other clients during our paid hours. Your full attention belongs to our patients while you are on the clock. Time tracking makes this visible, so please do not apply if you run multiple jobs in the same hours.

Dishonesty of any kind: covering up mistakes, padding hours, or claiming work was done when it was not. Mistakes are fine and expected, especially in training; hiding them is not. Tell us early and we will fix it together.

Rudeness, coldness or impatience with patients or staff. Many of our callers are anxious or recovering from surgery. Warmth and patience are not optional extras in this role; they are the role.

Repeated carelessness or incompetence: wrong details in bookings, unanswered calls, missed follow-ups, ignoring messages or instructions from our surgeons and doctors, ignoring the training materials. We give full training, clear scripts and honest feedback, and we expect you to apply them.



If you consistently deliver, you will be paid at the top of the market, treated with respect, and have a stable long-term role. We hold ourselves to the same standards we ask of you: clear instructions, prompt pay, and honest feedback.



PAY: Training pay is $600 USD/month (75% of the post-training rate) for your first 3-4 weeks while you complete training. Once training is complete and the role officially begins, pay is $800 USD/month for the following 4-month probationary period. Once probation is successfully completed (around 5 months after you start, once training is included), pay rises to $900 USD/month. Paid reliably every two weeks via PayPal or Wise (your choice): that's $276.92 per pay period during training, $369.23 per pay period during probation, and $415.38 per pay period once probation is complete. We want a long-term partner, and people who deliver will be duly rewarded.



TO APPLY, send all seven items:



The word EYELID at the top of your application

Your CV

A video recording made specifically for this application, 3 minutes (Loom link or unlisted Google Drive/YouTube link), speaking in English. In the video you must:

(a) say our clinic name, Eyelid Wellness Group, and today's date;

(b) tell us why you want this specific role - go into detail please, including why you think you would be good for the job;

(c) confirm on camera that you can work 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday; and

(d) show us the workspace you would be working from and that you have the appropriate equipment

We are assessing both the calibre of your spoken English and your natural patience and tone in this video: speak as though you were calmly reassuring a nervous or unhappy patient.

Confirmation you can work every hour of the schedule above, including Philippine public holidays

Confirmation you are comfortable with the monitoring described above

A screenshot of a speed test from your working location

A screenshot of a typing test result from 
 or 
 showing at least 45 WPM



Generic videos recorded for other jobs, videos missing any of the four points, or applications missing ANY of the seven items will not be reviewed. No exceptions.



WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU ARE SHORTLISTED:

So you know the full process upfront:



English test: you will have 72 hours to complete the free EF SET English test at 
 and send us your certificate. Minimum score C1.

Live video interview from your actual working setup: you will show and use your laptop, headset, private room, internet connection and backup connection live on the call.

Scenario testing: mock patient calls and short written exercises, so we can see how you actually work.

Paid trial shift (4 hours), paid whether or not you are hired.

Any offer is subject to: NBI clearance, government ID verification, your two references checking out, and a signed confidentiality and data protection agreement. Training starts once these are complete.

You will have to sign a formal contract and an NDA before starting work with us.

No work can commence until we have established contact and have received your two references.



If something goes wrong; a mistake, an emergency, a problem at home you MUST tell us the same day. Going silent is the one thing we cannot work with as we have patient care to consider, and any unexplained disappearance will end the contract.



We test thoroughly because this role sits inside a surgical pathway. We do this because we expect the highest levels of safety, efficacy and competence from all our staff and wider team.

title: Full Time Phone Appointment Setter | Base + Commission
description:
Full-Time Phone Appointment Setter | Base + Commission



SUMMARY



We’re looking for an experienced, hungry Phone Appointment Setter to take ownership of an established warm lead pipeline for a fast growing online education company serving primarily US and Canadian customers.



This is not a brand new offer or an empty CRM.



You’ll be stepping into a proven multi-seven-figure sales operation with an experienced closing team, paid advertising, existing customers, previous applicants, aged opportunities, and active lead pipelines already generating revenue.



Our closers can close.



We need someone who can pick up the phone, create conversations, reactivate opportunities, and consistently fill their calendars.



Just as importantly, we need someone with a true speed-to-lead mentality.



When a fresh inbound lead registers, begins an application, or triggers a notification inside Slack, your instinct should be:



“Call them now.”



We want someone who stays aware of what is happening throughout the workday and is ready to jump on fresh inbound opportunities while the prospect is still engaged.



This is a full-time position with a guaranteed base plus performance-based commission and significant upside for someone who produces.



WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING



You’ll primarily be contacting warm opportunities already inside our ecosystem, including:



• Existing customers and VIP opportunities

• Previous applicants

• Aged leads and reactivation opportunities

• Fresh inbound leads

• Leads who registered but did not complete an application

• Leads who began an application but stopped partway through

• Prospects who have previously engaged with our company



This is not traditional cold calling to random purchased lists.



These are people who already know us, have engaged with us, registered, applied, purchased, or previously expressed interest.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make up to 100 to 150 outbound calls per day when call volume requires it

• Consistently generate qualified appointments for our closing team

• Monitor Slack and CRM notifications throughout your working hours

• Respond quickly when fresh inbound opportunities enter the pipeline

• Call incomplete applicants while they are still actively considering the opportunity

• Work warm lead lists aggressively without needing constant supervision

• Follow up through phone, SMS, voi
, and other approved channels

• Reactivate previous leads and opportunities inside our CRM

• Quickly evaluate prospects against company qualification criteria

• Conduct appointment confirmation and follow-up calls

• Build rapport and create a strong first impression before prospects meet with a closer

• Maintain accurate notes, dispositions, callbacks, and next steps inside Close CRM

• Ensure opportunities do not fall through the cracks

• Complete daily KPI reporting and maintain visibility into performance



REQUIREMENTS



• Minimum 6 months of sales, appointment setting, SDR, telemarketing, or outbound phone experience

• Previous phone-based sales experience is required

• Excellent spoken English is required

• Near native North American English pronunciation with a clear, neutral accent

• Must be extremely comfortable speaking naturally with US and Canadian prospects over the phone

• Strong phone presence, conversational ability, confidence, and rapport-building skills

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day

• Proven ability to turn conversations into booked appointments

• Strong speed to lead mentality

• Comfortable monitoring Slack and CRM notifications throughout your working hours and reacting quickly when opportunities appear

• Highly independent, self-managed, and accountable

• Comfortable being measured on activity and results

• Able to work North American business hours

• Experience working inside a CRM

• Reliable computer, professional headset, reliable high-speed internet, and quiet working environment



STRONGLY PREFERRED



• 2+ years of sales experience

• Previous high-ticket appointment setting experience

• Experience with coaching, education, consulting, or business opportunity offers

• Experience working warm lead databases and reactivation campaigns

• Experience booking calls for high-ticket closers

• Experience in a speed-to-lead environment

• Close CRM, HubSpot, GHL, Salesforce, or similar CRM experience

• Proven history of meeting or exceeding appointment setting KPIs



COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY



This position includes:



• Competitive guaranteed hourly base compensation

• 2% commission on collected revenue generated from deals attributable to appointments you book

• Uncapped performance-based earning potential

• Opportunity for increased compensation based on demonstrated performance



The better you perform, the more you can earn.



You’ll be stepping into an established sales operation with:



• A proven multi-seven-figure offer

• An experienced high-ticket closing team

• Paid advertising generating new opportunities

• An existing customer and VIP database

• A large CRM of previous leads and applicants

• Proven reactivation and upgrade pipelines

• Established scripts, processes, and sales infrastructure



We are NOT looking for someone who logs in, makes a few calls, and waits for the day to end.



We want someone who sees a fresh Slack notification and thinks:



“Let me call them before someone else does.”



And someone who looks at an active CRM and thinks:



“Give me the pipeline and let me work.”



TO APPLY



Please include a Loom video with your application.



Your Loom should cover:



• Your previous appointment setting and phone sales experience

• The approximate number of outbound calls you were accustomed to making each day

• Your previous appointment setting KPIs and results

• Your experience working warm leads and reactivation campaigns

• Your experience responding to fresh inbound leads

• Why you believe you would excel in this position



IMPORTANT: We will use your Loom to evaluate your spoken English, phone presence, pronunciation, confidence, and communication style.



Please speak naturally in the video rather than reading from a prepared script.



To show that you carefully read the entire posting, include the word “PIPELINE” at the beginning of your application.



Applications without the requested Loom video will not be considered.
